66448.recognize_zh: 三個分葉中性球各自被一圈呈放射狀排列的紅血球包圍（neutrophil-erythrocyte rosette），旁邊另有一個未形成花環的中性球作對照，此現象提示紅血球表面有抗體覆蓋，見於自體免疫溶血性貧血（AIHA）。
features: Three segmented neutrophils each ringed by a complete circle of adherent, radially oriented red cells (rosettes)
An adjacent free neutrophil without attached red cells, showing that rosetting is selective rather than a smear-thickness artifact
Rosetting neutrophils have normal nuclear segmentation and cytoplasm; no intracytoplasmic red cells seen
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis, occasional small dense forms and a rare crenated cell
Adequate platelets; no red cell agglutinates
66448.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows three neutrophils each surrounded by a ring of closely adherent erythrocytes, forming neutrophil-erythrocyte rosettes, while a neighboring neutrophil is free of attached red cells. The rosetting neutrophils show normal segmentation without evident erythrophagocytosis. Background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional small dense forms and a rare crenated cell; no agglutinates are present. Findings are suggestive of immunoglobulin- or complement-coated red cells, as in autoimmune hemolytic anemia.

ddx.vs: Agglutinates are irregular red cell clumps without a central neutrophil and disperse on warming.
Phagocytosed red cells lie within neutrophil or monocyte cytoplasm rather than as an external ring.
In satellitism the ring is composed of platelets around neutrophils and is associated with EDTA pseudothrombocytopenia.

66256.recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆有核紅血球（NRBC），核圓而染色質濃縮，周圍紅色細胞質內散布細小藍黑色點狀顆粒（basophilic stippling）；背景有大量低色素、靶形與碎片狀紅血球，另見第二顆 NRBC 與 Howell-Jolly 小體，符合重度β地中海貧血的抹片。
features: Nucleated red blood cell with a small round, dense pyknotic nucleus and polychromatic cytoplasm containing multiple punctate blue granules (basophilic stippling)
Additional NRBCs present in the field (right and upper left)
Marked anisopoikilocytosis with hypochromic cells, target cells, irregular fragments and bizarre poikilocytes
Numerous red cells contain fine dot-like inclusions; one red cell contains a round magenta Howell-Jolly body
Scattered platelets; a segmented neutrophil at the upper right edge
66256.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with hypochromic red cells, target cells, fragmented and bizarre poikilocytes, and circulating nucleated red blood cells. The central nucleated red cell has a condensed round nucleus and cytoplasm containing multiple punctate basophilic granules consistent with basophilic stippling. Many red cells show fine dot-like inclusions, and a Howell-Jolly body is seen in one cell, suggesting hyposplenism or prior splenectomy. Findings are consistent with a severe thalassemic process such as beta-thalassemia major, as provided clinically.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are fewer, clustered at the cell periphery and Prussian blue positive, whereas basophilic stippling is diffuse and iron-negative.
Lead poisoning shows coarse stippling with milder microcytosis and without the marked target cells, fragments and numerous NRBCs seen here; blood lead level separates them.
This hereditary hemolytic anemia shows prominent stippling in otherwise less dysmorphic red cells, and enzyme assay rather than morphology distinguishes it from thalassemia.
Parasites have a chromatin dot with a ring or cytoplasm, not uniform punctate blue granules scattered through the cell.

exam.answer_en: Nucleated red blood cell with basophilic stippling in severe beta-thalassemia — marked anisopoikilocytosis, target cells, NRBCs and a Howell-Jolly body
pearls_zh: 考法：中央細胞問「有核紅血球」及胞質藍點名稱（basophilic stippling），再問背景診斷；答 beta-thalassemia major/重度地中海貧血。
Basophilic stippling 為聚集的 ribosome（RNA），iron stain 陰性；Pappenheimer bodies 為含鐵顆粒，Prussian blue 陽性。
Howell-Jolly body 提示脾切除或功能性脾臟低下；地中海貧血病人脾切除後感染與血栓風險上升。
診斷：Hb electrophoresis/HPLC（HbF、HbA2 上升）與基因檢測；台灣常見 beta 突變如 IVS-II-654、CD41/42。
治療重點：規律輸血與 iron chelation（deferoxamine、deferasirox、deferiprone）；luspatercept 可減少輸血需求。
exam.pitfall_zh: Basophilic stippling 易與 Pappenheimer bodies 混淆；stippling 均勻散布整顆細胞且鐵染色陰性，Pappenheimer 顆粒少、聚集於邊緣且 Prussian blue 陽性。

quiz.q: 中央有核紅血球胞質內的藍色小點是什麼？其成分為何，鐵染色結果如何？
quiz.a: Basophilic stippling；聚集的 ribosome/RNA，鐵染色陰性。

66128.recognize_zh: 一顆分葉嗜中性球的整個細胞質被大量粗大、深紫紅色的顆粒填滿，顆粒密到部分遮住三葉細胞核；在沒有感染證據且為持續性時，這種粗顆粒即 Alder-Reilly 小體，單看一張圖則需與毒性顆粒（toxic granulation）鑑別。
features: Segmented neutrophil with three to four nuclear lobes and mature clumped chromatin
Cytoplasm densely packed with coarse, dark purple to lilac granules obscuring the background cytoplasm and partially overlying the nucleus
Granules are uniformly distributed without Döhle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuoles
Cell size within normal neutrophil range
Background red cells normocytic and normochromic; one small platelet
66128.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil whose cytoplasm is densely filled with coarse, dark purple, uniformly distributed granules that partially obscure the nuclear lobes. No Döhle bodies or cytoplasmic vacuolation are present, and the background red cells are unremarkable. Similar granules in lymphocytes and monocytes, persistence over time and the absence of infection would support Alder-Reilly anomaly. Findings are consistent with Alder-Reilly anomaly in the stated context, which should prompt evaluation for a mucopolysaccharidosis.

ddx.vs: Toxic granulation is transient, accompanies infection with Döhle bodies, vacuoles and left shift, and does not involve lymphocytes.
Chediak-Higashi granules are few, very large irregular inclusions rather than numerous uniform coarse granules.
Eosinophil granules are larger, refractile and orange-red in a bilobed cell, and basophil granules are blue-black and usually overlie the nucleus in a less segmented cell.
G-CSF causes coarse granulation with Döhle bodies and a left-shifted myeloid series, with a history of growth factor therapy.

exam.answer_en: Alder-Reilly anomaly — segmented neutrophil with cytoplasm densely packed by coarse dark purple granules, without Döhle bodies or vacuoles
pearls_zh: 考法：指粗顆粒中性球問「toxic granulation 還是 Alder-Reilly」；答題關鍵是持續存在、無感染、且淋巴球與單核球也有顆粒。
Alder-Reilly 顆粒為沉積的 mucopolysaccharide（glycosaminoglycan），與 mucopolysaccharidoses 相關（如 Hurler、Hunter 症候群）。
顆粒本身不影響中性球功能，臨床重點在找出潛在的溶小體儲積症（尿 GAG、酵素檢測）。
中性球顆粒異常對照：Chediak-Higashi 為少數巨大顆粒（LYST），May-Hegglin 為 Döhle-like 包涵體合併巨大血小板（MYH9）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 toxic granulation 混淆；毒性顆粒為暫時性，伴感染、Döhle bodies、空泡與左移，且不出現在淋巴球。

quiz.q: 此中性球粗顆粒若長期存在且淋巴球也有，稱為何種異常？與哪類疾病相關？
quiz.a: Alder-Reilly anomaly；mucopolysaccharidoses。

65744.recognize_zh: A 圖為小球性低色素紅血球並見標靶細胞與異形紅血球；B 圖超活體染色（new methylene blue）中箭頭所指紅血球內布滿均勻細小藍點，像高爾夫球表面，即 HbH 包涵體；C/D 圖 HPLC 在最前段（約 0.37 分鐘）出現快速洗出的異常峰，符合 HbH。
features: Hypochromic microcytic red cells with target cells, poikilocytes and some crenated forms; platelets present (A)
Supravital stain: red cell uniformly filled with fine, evenly spaced blue-green inclusions giving a golf-ball appearance (arrow, B)
Increased reticulocytes with reticular/granular precipitate and scattered larger dark blue bodies on supravital stain (B)
HPLC chromatogram with a sharp fast-eluting peak near the injection front (C)
Peak table: 'Unknown' peak at retention time 0.37 min (6.2%) with low HbA2 (1.3%) (D)
65744.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows hypochromic microcytic red cells with target cells and poikilocytosis. Supravital new methylene blue staining demonstrates increased reticulocytes and red cells containing numerous fine, evenly distributed inclusions producing a golf-ball appearance, characteristic of precipitated HbH (β4 tetramers). HPLC shows a sharp peak eluting within the first minute (retention time 0.37 min, 6.2%) with low HbA2 (1.3%), consistent with a fast-migrating variant such as HbH; quantitation is limited because the sample was post-transfusion. Findings are consistent with HbH disease (α-thalassemia with three α-globin gene deletions or equivalent); confirmation by α-globin gene analysis is recommended.

ddx.vs: Beta-thalassemia trait shows microcytosis with target cells but has elevated HbA2 (>3.5%) and no golf-ball HbH inclusions.

ddx.dx: Heinz bodies (G6PD deficiency or unstable hemoglobin)
ddx.vs: Heinz bodies are fewer, larger, peripheral inclusions often attached to the membrane, unlike the numerous fine evenly dispersed HbH inclusions.
Iron deficiency causes microcytic hypochromic cells and pencil cells but no HbH inclusions or fast HPLC peak, and HbA2 may be low-normal.
Hb Bart's also elutes early on HPLC but predominates in neonates/hydrops and does not form golf-ball inclusions in adult red cells.

exam.answer_en: HbH disease — microcytic hypochromic red cells, golf-ball HbH inclusions on supravital stain, and fast-eluting HbH peak on HPLC
pearls_zh: 考法：多格組圖，指超活體染色中高爾夫球樣紅血球問內含物；答 HbH（β4 tetramer）inclusions，診斷 HbH disease。
基因型通常為三個 α-globin 基因缺損（--/-α）；台灣與東南亞常見 --SEA 缺失。非缺失型如 Hb Constant Spring 合併者（HbH-CS）臨床常較嚴重。
HbH 包涵體需將血液與 brilliant cresyl blue 或 new methylene blue 共同孵育才出現；Heinz bodies 則較大、少、貼近膜。
α-thalassemia 的 HbA2 正常或偏低，與 β-thalassemia trait 的 HbA2 上升（>3.5%）相反；輸血後檢體會影響定量判讀。
HbH disease 遇氧化性藥物、感染或發燒可誘發急性溶血；雖多非輸血依賴，仍需監測鐵過載。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把網狀紅血球的網狀沉澱或 Heinz bodies 誤認為 HbH 包涵體；HbH 為均勻細密布滿整顆紅血球的藍點（高爾夫球狀），網狀紅血球為不規則絲網狀。

quiz.q: B 圖箭頭所指紅血球內均勻細點的高爾夫球樣外觀代表什麼？典型 α-globin 基因型為何？
quiz.a: HbH（β4）inclusions；三個 α 基因缺損（--/-α）。

65680.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中細胞核間距寬、細胞質淡染呈「荷包蛋」（fried-egg）樣的單一淋巴球浸潤，CD20 瀰漫陽性、BRAF V600E 陽性；cyclin D1 在毛狀細胞弱而不均，另見 CD138 陽性漿細胞散在，符合毛細胞白血病合併漿細胞腫瘤。
features: PB: rare small lymphoid cell with irregular cytoplasmic outline suggestive of fine projections; background red cells without other abnormal cells
BM biopsy H&E: hypercellular with diffuse infiltrate of small cells with widely spaced oval to reniform nuclei and abundant clear cytoplasm ('fried-egg' appearance) and extravasated red cells
CD20: diffuse strong membranous staining of the infiltrate
BRAF V600E: strong granular cytoplasmic positivity in the neoplastic cells
Cyclin D1: weak to moderate, variable nuclear staining in many cells with scattered strongly positive nuclei
CD138: scattered and small clusters of positive plasma cells (approximately 10-15%)
65680.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows rare lymphoid cells with irregular cytoplasmic borders suggestive of hairy projections. The bone marrow biopsy is hypercellular and diffusely infiltrated by small lymphoid cells with widely spaced round to reniform nuclei and ample pale cytoplasm, imparting a fried-egg appearance, with interstitial red cell extravasation. The infiltrate is strongly CD20-positive and BRAF V600E-positive with weak, variable cyclin D1 expression, while CD138 highlights a separate interstitial population of plasma cells that show strong cyclin D1. Findings are consistent with classic hairy cell leukemia with a concomitant plasma cell neoplasm (smoldering myeloma with IGH::CCND1).

ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes have polar projections, marrow infiltrate is nodular/intrasinusoidal, and cells are BRAF V600E-, annexin A1- and usually CD103/CD25 negative.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia variant / splenic B-cell lymphoma with prominent nucleoli
ddx.vs: Cells have prominent nucleoli, CD25 and annexin A1 are negative, and BRAF V600E is absent.
Strong uniform cyclin D1 and SOX11 with CD5 expression and IGH::CCND1 in the B cells, unlike weak variable cyclin D1 in HCL.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma as the sole process
ddx.vs: Would lack the CD20+ BRAF V600E+ fried-egg B-cell infiltrate that explains the pancytopenia here.

65680.stain: Giemsa (PB); H&E; IHC: CD20, BRAF V600E, cyclin D1, CD138

65616.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞極多，以各階段顆粒球增生為主，嗜中性球核分葉異常（假 Pelger 樣低分葉、染色質團塊化、分葉不規則）明顯，母細胞不多，並見核分離的小型發育不良巨核細胞；搭配無單核球及嗜鹼性球增多、BCR::ABL1 陰性與 SETBP1/ASXL1 突變，符合非典型 CML。
features: Hypercellular BM aspirate particle with marked granulocytic proliferation across all maturation stages (panel A)
Dysgranulopoiesis: neutrophils with abnormal nuclear segmentation, including hyposegmented pseudo-Pelger forms and bizarre, irregularly lobated nuclei (panel B)
Hypogranular cytoplasm in some mature neutrophils
Blasts present but not increased (panel C)
Dysplastic megakaryocyte with two widely separated round nuclei (panel D)
No conspicuous increase in monocytes, eosinophils or basophils
65616.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears are hypercellular with a marked granulocytic proliferation showing a full spectrum of maturation. There is prominent dysgranulopoiesis, predominantly abnormal nuclear segmentation with pseudo-Pelger-Huët and bizarrely lobated neutrophils, and some hypogranular forms. Blasts are present at low numbers without increase, and megakaryocytes include dysplastic forms with widely separated round nuclei. Monocytes and basophils are not increased. In the context of neutrophilic leukocytosis with circulating immature granulocytes, absent BCR::ABL1, JAK2, CALR, MPL and CSF3R alterations, and SETBP1/ASXL1/EZH2 mutations, findings are consistent with atypical chronic myeloid leukemia (MDS/MPN with neutrophilia).

ddx.vs: Shows basophilia, a myelocyte bulge and small hypolobated megakaryocytes without prominent dysgranulopoiesis, with BCR::ABL1 fusion.
Consists of mature neutrophils without significant dysplasia or circulating immature granulocytes (<10%) and typically carries CSF3R T618I.
Requires persistent absolute monocytosis (≥0.5 × 10^9/L and ≥10% of WBC), whereas monocytes are only 2% here.
Reactive left shift shows toxic granulation without true dysplasia, and lacks clonal SETBP1/ASXL1 mutations.

65424.recognize_zh: 粗針切片呈模糊結節狀排列，高倍下許多淋巴球的細胞質有透明空泡把核擠到一側，形似印戒細胞；CD20、CD10、BCL6、BCL2 陽性，CD21 顯示濾泡樹突細胞網，Ki-67 低，指向濾泡性淋巴瘤帶印戒樣細胞。
features: Panel A: needle core with vaguely nodular lymphoid proliferation
Panels B-C: small to intermediate lymphoid cells with cleaved, eccentric nuclei and clear cytoplasmic vacuoles producing signet ring-like morphology
Panels D, G: BCL6 and CD10 positivity accentuated in nodules
Panels E-F: diffuse membranous CD20 and BCL2 positivity
Panel H: CD21 highlights expanded follicular dendritic cell meshworks
Panel I: low Ki-67 proliferation index (<10%)
65424.describe_en: Needle core biopsy of the abdominal mass shows a lymphoid proliferation with a vague nodular growth pattern. At high power, the nodules are composed of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with cleaved nuclei, many of which have eccentric nuclei displaced by clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, imparting a signet ring-like appearance; tingible body macrophages and mantle zones are not identified. The neoplastic cells are positive for CD20, CD10, BCL6, and BCL2, with CD21-positive follicular dendritic cell meshworks and a low Ki-67 index. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma, low grade, with signet ring-like cells.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are cytokeratin-positive and contain mucin (mucicarmine/PAS-D positive), whereas these cells are CD20/CD10-positive lymphocytes.
Reactive follicles have polarization, tingible body macrophages, mantle zones and BCL2-negative germinal centers with high Ki-67, all absent here.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytoid/monocytoid cells
ddx.vs: MZL is CD10- and BCL6-negative and colonizes follicles, unlike the CD10/BCL6-positive neoplastic follicles here.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell neoplasm with Mott cells
ddx.vs: Mott cells contain eosinophilic immunoglobulin globules (Russell bodies) and are CD138-positive rather than CD20/CD10-positive with clear vacuoles.

65424.stain: H&E, IHC: BCL6, CD20, BCL2, CD10, CD21, Ki-67

65168.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一大片黏在一起的小圓腫瘤細胞，核互相擠壓（nuclear molding），左側夾雜淡粉紅、細絲狀的纖維基質（neuropil），符合神經母細胞瘤骨髓轉移。
features: Large cohesive syncytial-like aggregate of small to medium round cells with high N:C ratio
Nuclear crowding and molding within the aggregate
Pale pink fibrillary (neuropil-like) matrix at the edge of the cluster
Scattered single tumor cells and disrupted cells around the cluster
Faded magenta staining limits chromatin and nucleolar detail
65168.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large cohesive aggregate of small to medium round cells with high N:C ratio, nuclear crowding, and molding. Pale pink fibrillary material resembling neuropil is present at the edge of the cluster, and additional single tumor cells and smudged cells are scattered in the background. The faded staining limits assessment of chromatin and nucleoli, and rosette formation cannot be confirmed. In correlation with flow cytometry showing a CD45-negative, CD56-positive population, findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma involving the bone marrow.

ddx.vs: Small cell carcinoma shows similar molding but occurs in adults, lacks neuropil, and is cytokeratin (dot-like) positive.
Ewing sarcoma clusters lack neuropil and are CD99 membranous positive with EWSR1 rearrangement.
Leukemic blasts are discohesive CD45-positive cells that do not form molded clusters with fibrillary matrix.

ddx.dx: Bone marrow particle with normal hematopoiesis
ddx.vs: Normal particles show a mixed population of granulocytic, erythroid and megakaryocytic cells with fat, rather than a monotonous molded small round cell population.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic neuroblastoma in bone marrow — cohesive small round cell aggregate with nuclear molding and neuropil-like matrix
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍先找成團聚集，問 nuclear molding 與淡粉紅纖維基質（neuropil）；Homer Wright rosette 也是常見考點。
分期評估需雙側骨髓抽吸加切片；切片配合 IHC 偵測腫瘤比單純抽吸敏感。
風險分層要素：年齡、MYCN amplification、組織學分類（INPC／Shimada）、11q aberration、DNA ploidy。
小圓藍細胞 IHC 鑑別：neuroblastoma PHOX2B+；Ewing CD99+/NKX2.2+；rhabdomyosarcoma desmin/myogenin+；lymphoma／leukemia CD45+。
exam.pitfall_zh: 正常骨髓顆粒易被誤為腫瘤團；正常顆粒含多系列、不同成熟階段細胞與脂肪，腫瘤團細胞單一且核互相擠壓。

quiz.q: 圖中腫瘤細胞核彼此擠壓、互相塑形的現象稱為什麼？
quiz.a: Nuclear molding

65232.recognize_zh: 目鏡拍攝的高密度抹片，大量中型單核細胞，核呈腎形、凹陷或分葉（部分似花瓣狀），細胞質淡灰量少；形態上看不出典型漿細胞的核偏位與核旁淡染區，屬於不典型、分葉核的腫瘤性漿細胞，需依 CD38/CD138/kappa 表現確認為漿細胞白血病。
features: Densely cellular field of monotonous medium-sized mononuclear cells
Reniform, indented, bilobed to cloverleaf-like lobulated nuclei
Finely granular chromatin without obvious nucleoli at this resolution
Scant pale grey cytoplasm; perinuclear hof and eccentric nuclear position not evident
Background filled with small refractile droplets and red cell ghosts; eyepiece photograph with limited resolution
65232.describe_en: Photomicrograph taken through the eyepiece shows a densely cellular smear composed of monotonous medium-sized mononuclear cells with few red cells. The cells have scant pale cytoplasm and reniform, indented or lobulated nuclei with finely granular chromatin; conventional plasma cell features such as eccentric nuclei and a perinuclear hof are not appreciated. Background refractile droplets are likely artifactual and image resolution is limited. The morphology is nonspecific, but together with the reported CD38+/CD138+ kappa-restricted phenotype, it supports plasma cell leukemia with atypical lobulated nuclei.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells have similarly lobulated nuclei but condensed chromatin, a CD4+/CD25+ T-cell phenotype and HTLV-1 positivity.
Monocytic blasts and promonocytes have folded nuclei with more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and are CD14/CD64-positive and CD138-negative.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid/pleomorphic leukemic phase
ddx.vs: Blastoid MCL cells have irregular nuclei but are CD19/CD20-positive B cells with cyclin D1 and lack CD138.

65104.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 HHV8（LANA-1）免疫染色：一個濾泡的外圍套區與生發中心周緣有許多細胞核呈棕色點狀陽性的大細胞，濾泡外則幾乎陰性，這種濾泡內外圍分布的 HHV8 陽性漿母細胞是 HHV8 相關多中心 Castleman 病的確認依據。
features: Numerous cells with granular/speckled brown nuclear staining for HHV8 LANA-1
Positive cells concentrated in a ring within the mantle zone and periphery of a small follicle
Positive nuclei are large, consistent with plasmablasts
Only rare scattered positive cells in the surrounding interfollicular tissue
Negative background small lymphocytes with blue hematoxylin counterstain
65104.describe_en: Lymph node section immunostained for HHV8 (LANA-1) shows numerous large cells with speckled nuclear positivity arranged predominantly around the periphery of a small follicle, involving the mantle zone and outer germinal center. Only rare positive cells are seen in the interfollicular region, and the positive cells form clusters rather than confluent sheets. The background small lymphocytes are negative. Findings are consistent with HHV8-infected plasmablasts of HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease.

ddx.dx: HHV8-positive diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS
ddx.vs: In HHV8+ DLBCL the LANA-1-positive plasmablasts form confluent sheets effacing nodal architecture rather than a mantle-zone ring around a preserved follicle.
KS shows LANA-1 positivity in spindle cells lining slit-like vascular spaces, not in large lymphoid plasmablasts around follicles.
Extracavitary PEL forms sheets of anaplastic HHV8+ cells that are usually EBV-positive and lack B-cell antigens, rather than follicle-associated plasmablasts.
iMCD has similar follicular changes but is HHV8 LANA-1-negative.

exam.answer_en: HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease — HHV8 LANA-1+ plasmablasts concentrated in the follicular mantle zone
pearls_zh: 考法：這是 IHC 圖，問染的是什麼（HHV8 LANA-1，點狀核染色）、陽性細胞位於哪裡（mantle zone 的 plasmablasts）與對應診斷。
HHV8 陽性 plasmablasts 常呈 IgM lambda 表現（型態上單型但多為 polyclonal/oligoclonal），可進展為 HHV8-positive DLBCL, NOS。
病毒產生 viral IL-6（vIL-6），造成發燒、淋巴結腫大、脾腫大、血球低下與 CRP 上升；多見於 HIV 感染者，常合併 Kaposi sarcoma。
治療以 rituximab 為基礎，嚴重者合併 etoposide 或 liposomal doxorubicin；可監測血漿 HHV8 viral load。siltuximab 用於 HHV8 陰性的 idiopathic MCD。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 idiopathic MCD 或 TAFRO 混淆，兩者 H&E 型態可相似；關鍵是 LANA-1 陽性，iMCD 的診斷前提即為 HHV8 陰性。

quiz.q: 此淋巴結免疫染色呈棕色點狀核陽性的是哪個病毒抗原？陽性細胞主要分布於濾泡哪一區？
quiz.a: HHV8 LANA-1；mantle zone（plasmablasts）。

65040.recognize_zh: 高倍下淋巴結內多個大型擴張的淋巴管腔，腔內充滿均質粉紅色蛋白質性淋巴液（含人工裂隙），管壁只有薄層內皮與周圍小淋巴球；右上方另見一條充滿紅血球的擴張血管，可與含淋巴液的管腔區分。
features: Markedly dilated lymphatic channels filled with homogeneous eosinophilic proteinaceous lymph with cracking artifact
Thin, flat endothelial lining without atypia or multilayering
Enlarged, congested blood vessel packed with red cells at the upper right
Cuffs of small mature lymphocytes surrounding the dilated channels
Loose stroma with scattered histiocytes and endothelial cells in the upper left
65040.describe_en: Lymph node section at high power shows several markedly dilated lymphatic channels filled with homogeneous eosinophilic proteinaceous lymph and lined by flat, bland endothelium. An enlarged, congested blood vessel packed with red cells is present at the upper right, contrasting with the lymph-filled spaces. Small mature lymphocytes cuff the channels, and no atypical cells, spindle cell proliferation or granulomas are seen. Findings are consistent with nodal lymphangiectasia (dilated lymphatic sinuses), a reactive/obstructive change.

ddx.dx: Vascular transformation of lymph node sinuses
ddx.vs: Vascular transformation replaces sinuses with anastomosing blood-filled capillary channels and sinusoidal fibrosis, usually due to venous obstruction, whereas these channels contain lymph rather than red cells.
Lymphangioma forms a discrete mass of interconnecting lymphatic spaces with smooth muscle in the walls and lymphoid aggregates, rather than diffuse dilatation of pre-existing sinuses.
Kaposi sarcoma shows spindle cell fascicles with slit-like red-cell-filled spaces and HHV-8 LANA-1 positivity, not wide channels with bland flat endothelium.

64272.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的大型原始細胞呈圓核、細緻染色質並有核仁，細胞質深藍嗜鹼性且邊緣有多個細胞質泡突（blebs），這種深藍細胞質加泡突的原紅血球樣原始細胞是純紅血球白血病的特徵。
features: Large blasts with round central to slightly eccentric nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and one or more nucleoli
Intensely basophilic, deep royal-blue cytoplasm with a paler perinuclear zone in some cells
Multiple small cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopod-like projections at the cell border
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods in the blasts
Background includes mature neutrophils, a small lymphocyte, erythrocytes and a few degenerated/smudged cells
64272.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows several large blasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin and visible nucleoli, surrounded by a rim of intensely basophilic, agranular cytoplasm with prominent cytoplasmic blebs. Auer rods are not seen, and a few mature neutrophils and red cells are present in the background. These cells resemble proerythroblasts; when such cells constitute the dominant population (erythroid precursors at least 80% with at least 30% proerythroblasts), the findings are consistent with pure erythroid leukemia, to be confirmed with E-cadherin, CD71, glycophorin A and TP53 studies.

ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts also have basophilic cytoplasm with blebs, so CD61/CD42b positivity versus E-cadherin/CD71/glycophorin positivity is needed to separate them.
Parvovirus-infected pronormoblasts show large glassy intranuclear inclusions with an otherwise hypoplastic erythroid series, rather than sheets of malignant blasts.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles rather than blebs and are CD19/CD10/sIg positive.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic neoplasm or metastatic small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Plasmablasts show eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and are CD138 positive, and small round cell tumors form cohesive clusters negative for erythroid markers.

exam.answer_en: Pure erythroid leukemia — proerythroblast-like blasts with deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm and cytoplasmic blebs
pearls_zh: 考法：指著深藍胞質帶泡突的大型原始細胞問「屬哪一系」；形態上無法單靠 Wright 染色確定，須用 IHC/flow 證明紅血球系。
診斷門檻（WHO 5th 稱 acute erythroid leukaemia）：erythroid precursors ≥80%，其中 proerythroblasts ≥30%。
紅血球系標記：E-cadherin（早期原始細胞較敏感）、CD71、glycophorin A（成熟度高者陽性）、CD235a；MPO 陰性。
遺傳：幾乎都帶 biallelic TP53 異常與 complex karyotype，預後極差；ICC 2022 歸入 AML with mutated TP53。
PAS 可見紅血球前驅細胞呈塊狀（globular）陽性，是傳統細胞化學考點。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 acute megakaryoblastic leukemia 混淆：megakaryoblast 同樣深藍胞質並有泡突，但 CD41/CD61/CD42b 陽性、E-cadherin 與 glycophorin A 陰性；也須排除 parvovirus B19 巨大原紅血球（核內毛玻璃包涵體）。

quiz.q: 圖中深藍胞質帶泡突的原始細胞，若要證明其為紅血球系，應選哪些 IHC 標記？此病最常伴隨哪個基因異常？
quiz.a: E-cadherin、CD71、glycophorin A；TP53（多為 biallelic，合併 complex karyotype）。

64720.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片高倍下為瀰漫浸潤的中型母細胞樣細胞，核形不規則、扭曲拉長或摺疊，染色質細緻、核仁小，細胞質少而淡，缺乏發炎細胞與壞死，需配合 CD123/CD4/CD56/TCF4 確認 BPDCN。
features: Diffuse monotonous infiltrate of medium-sized blast-like cells
Irregular nuclei: elongated, folded, indented and twisted contours
Finely dispersed chromatin with small inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale to lightly eosinophilic agranular cytoplasm
Scattered small round mature lymphocytes; little inflammatory background and no necrosis or angioinvasion in this field
64720.describe_en: High-power H&E section of the skin shows a diffuse, dense dermal infiltrate of medium-sized, blast-like cells. The cells have irregular, often elongated or folded nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli, and scant pale cytoplasm. Eosinophils, neutrophils, necrosis, and angiodestruction are not seen in this field, and the overlying epidermis is not included. The morphology is nonspecific among blastic hematolymphoid neoplasms; in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD4+, CD56+, CD123+, TCF4+, TCL1+; MPO- and lineage-specific markers negative), findings are consistent with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Monocytic leukemia cutis can look identical and may express CD4/CD56, but it expresses lysozyme, CD14/CD163 or MPO and lacks the strong CD123/TCF4/TCL1 coexpression of BPDCN.
ENKTL is CD56+ but shows angiocentric necrosis, cytoplasmic CD3 and EBER positivity, whereas BPDCN is EBV-negative and CD123+.
Lymphoblastic lymphoma expresses TdT with B or T lineage markers (CD19/CD79a or cCD3), whereas BPDCN lacks lineage markers (TdT may be focally positive) and expresses CD123/TCF4.
Merkel cell carcinoma has salt-and-pepper chromatin with nuclear molding and is keratin (CK20 perinuclear dot) positive, unlike the CD45+/CD123+ BPDCN cells.

64144.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中多顆巨核細胞聚集成群，細胞中等大小、細胞質豐富粉紅，但核呈單一圓形或卵圓形、不分葉（non-lobated），這種「小型單核／低分葉巨核細胞群聚」是 del(5q) 骨髓分化不良症候群的特徵。
features: Cluster of medium-sized megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm
Nuclei round to oval, non-lobated or hypolobated, with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Megakaryocytes appear normal to increased in number
Background hypercellular marrow with maturing granulocytes and erythroid precursors
Interspersed adipocytes; no increase in blasts appreciable at this power
64144.describe_en: H&E section of the bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and a loose cluster of megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes are medium-sized with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and characteristically round to oval, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei. No sheets of blasts are evident in this field. Findings are consistent with the dysplastic megakaryocytes of myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q); confirmation requires cytogenetics/FISH for 5q deletion.

ddx.vs: ET megakaryocytes are large to giant with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei, not small non-lobated forms.
PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with hyperchromatic, cloud-like, bulbous nuclei in dense clusters, often with fibrosis.

ddx.dx: Micromegakaryocytes of other MDS or CML
ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are much smaller (lymphocyte-to-myeloblast size) with scant cytoplasm, whereas 5q- megakaryocytes are medium-sized with abundant cytoplasm; separation relies on cytogenetics.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm (MDS/AML) with inv(3)/t(3;3) MECOM rearrangement
ddx.vs: inv(3)/t(3;3) myeloid neoplasms also have small hypolobated megakaryocytes but show different karyotype and often increased blasts.

exam.answer_en: MDS with isolated del(5q) — loose cluster of medium-sized megakaryocytes with round non-lobated/hypolobated nuclei
pearls_zh: 考法：切片中一群巨核細胞，問核有何異常與關聯遺傳；答 non-lobated/hypolobated 小圓核，聯想 del(5q)。
確診需 karyotype 或 FISH 5q31/5q33 探針證明 5q deletion；並計數 blast（MDS-5q 為骨髓 <5%、周邊 <2%）。
del(5q) MDS 常見血小板正常或升高、大球性貧血；lenalidomide 可使多數輸血依賴者脫離輸血。
需檢測 TP53：del(5q) 合併 TP53 突變（尤其 multi-hit）預後差，ICC 2022 將 TP53 multi-hit 另歸為 MDS with mutated TP53。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 ET 或 PMF 的巨核細胞群聚：ET 為大型 staghorn 過度分葉核，PMF 為深染雲朵狀核；此處群聚巨核細胞核卻呈單一圓形，屬 del(5q) 型發育不良。

quiz.q: 此群聚巨核細胞具單一圓核，下一步應以什麼檢查確認診斷？
quiz.a: Karyotype 或 FISH 檢測 del(5q)（並計數 blast、檢測 TP53）。

64080.recognize_zh: 頸部顯影 CT（冠狀切與橫切）可見左側頸部多顆腫大、成串甚至融合的淋巴結，部分內部呈低密度（壞死），並往下延伸到左鎖骨上區；廣泛頸部淋巴結病變本身不具特異性，需切片才能確診 T 淋巴母細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Contrast-enhanced CT of the neck, coronal (left) and axial (right) reconstructions
Multiple enlarged, rounded left cervical lymph nodes forming a chain from the upper neck to the supraclavicular region
Some nodes show central low attenuation suggestive of necrosis
Nodes displace surrounding soft tissue but airway remains patent on the axial image
Right side of the neck shows no comparable nodal enlargement on these slices
Non-morphologic image: tissue diagnosis required
64080.describe_en: Contrast-enhanced CT of the neck in coronal and axial planes demonstrates extensive left-sided cervical lymphadenopathy, with multiple enlarged, rounded, partly confluent lymph nodes extending from the upper neck toward the supraclavicular region. Several nodes show central low attenuation suggestive of necrosis. The airway is patent on the axial slice, and the contralateral neck shows no comparable nodal enlargement on these images. The findings indicate bulky nodal disease but are not specific; excisional biopsy is required, and in this case histology and immunophenotyping established T-lymphoblastic lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Also presents with cervical and mediastinal adenopathy, but biopsy shows CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed inflammatory background.

ddx.dx: Metastatic squamous cell carcinoma of head and neck
ddx.vs: Necrotic cervical nodes are classic for SCC; biopsy shows cytokeratin/p40-positive squamous cells, often HPV-associated (p16+).
Produces necrotic, matted nodes with rim enhancement; biopsy shows caseating granulomas with acid-fast bacilli or positive mycobacterial culture/PCR.
Imaging cannot separate them; DLBCL is CD20+ large cells without TdT, while T-LBL is TdT+ cytoplasmic CD3+ lymphoblasts.

64016.recognize_zh: 中央一團由十多個深紫色小圓點狀裂殖子（merozoite）聚集而成的成熟裂殖體，旁邊有一小塊聚集的深棕黑色瘧色素，符合間日瘧（P. vivax）裂殖體；此張看不清宿主紅血球輪廓與 Schüffner dots。
features: Mature schizont composed of a cluster of approximately 16 or more discrete merozoites
Each merozoite has a small dense chromatin mass with scant cytoplasm
Single clumped dark brown-black pigment mass at the edge of the cluster
Host red cell outline and Schuffner stippling not clearly discernible (possibly ruptured or out of focus)
Surrounding uninfected red cells normal in size, somewhat overlapped; a platelet at lower left
64016.describe_en: Thin blood film (Giemsa stain, high power) shows a mature malarial schizont consisting of a compact cluster of numerous merozoites, estimated at 16 or more, with a coalesced dark pigment mass at one edge. The host red cell membrane and any stippling cannot be clearly appreciated in this image, and the surrounding red cells are unremarkable. The high merozoite number with irregular grape-like clustering and clumped pigment is compatible with Plasmodium vivax schizont, although species assignment is best supported by enlarged host cells with Schuffner dots in other fields.

ddx.vs: P. malariae schizonts contain fewer (6-12) merozoites, often in a rosette around central pigment, within a normal-sized red cell.
Falciparum schizonts (8-24 merozoites) are rarely seen in peripheral blood and occur with numerous small rings, typically signaling severe infection.
Ovale schizonts usually contain fewer (6-14) merozoites within an oval, fimbriated red cell with James dots.
Platelet aggregates are granular and pink-purple without discrete uniform chromatin dots or golden-brown hemozoin pigment.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium vivax mature schizont — ≥16 merozoites in an irregular cluster with a coalesced pigment mass
pearls_zh: 考法：數 merozoites 判斷物種；P. vivax 成熟 schizont 常 12–24 個，P. ovale 較少（約 8 個），P. malariae 約 6–12 個且常呈 rosette 排列。
Schizont 破裂釋出 merozoites 對應臨床發燒；P. vivax 與 ovale 紅血球週期約 48 小時（tertian），P. malariae 約 72 小時（quartan）。
周邊血出現 P. falciparum schizont 較少見，若大量出現提示高寄生蟲負荷或嚴重感染；vivax 則周邊血常見各期。
本圖宿主紅血球與 dots 不清楚，物種判斷應以同片中其他 enlarged RBC 與 Schüffner dots 佐證，考試答題要說明依據。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 gametocyte 或 P. malariae 的 rosette schizont 混淆：gametocyte 只有一團 chromatin；malariae schizont merozoite 數較少、排成花瓣狀圍繞中央色素，宿主紅血球不變大。

quiz.q: 圖中含多顆 merozoites 與集中色素團的是哪一期？merozoite 數目多（≥16）較支持哪一物種？
quiz.a: 成熟 schizont；Plasmodium vivax。

63952.recognize_zh: 兩格中的淋巴球都比周圍紅血球大很多，細胞質豐富淡藍色，邊緣被相鄰紅血球擠壓成扇貝狀並呈較深藍色的邊緣（Downey II 型反應性淋巴球），這是傳染性單核球增多症的典型形態。
features: Large reactive lymphocytes, clearly larger than surrounding red cells, with low to moderate N:C ratio
Round to irregular or indented nuclei with moderately condensed but open chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Abundant pale blue cytoplasm with irregular outlines and pseudopod-like extensions
Cytoplasm scalloped around adjacent red cells with basophilic accentuation at the cell margin
Background red cells normochromic without significant poikilocytosis
63952.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered large lymphocytes in a background of normochromic red cells. These cells have round to irregular nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and abundant pale blue cytoplasm that spreads around and is indented by adjacent red cells, with deeper basophilia at the cytoplasmic edges. The population is heterogeneous in nuclear shape and cytoplasmic extent, favoring a reactive rather than neoplastic process. Findings are consistent with reactive (Downey type II) lymphocytes and, with a positive heterophile test, with infectious mononucleosis.

ddx.dx: Other reactive lymphocytosis (CMV, acute HIV, toxoplasmosis, drug reaction)
ddx.vs: The morphology is identical, so heterophile antibody, EBV serology and other viral testing are needed to assign the cause.
LGLs are persistent, monotonous cells with round nuclei and discrete azurophilic granules, lacking the scalloped basophilic cytoplasmic margin.
Neoplastic cells are monomorphic with fine chromatin or nucleoli, and flow cytometry shows clonality, unlike this heterogeneous reactive spectrum.
Monocytes have gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and folded, lacy nuclei without the deep blue edge hugging adjacent red cells.

exam.answer_en: Infectious mononucleosis — heterogeneous reactive (Downey type II) lymphocytes with abundant cytoplasm scalloped around RBCs
pearls_zh: 考法：指著大型淋巴球問是反應性還是腫瘤性；答反應性（Downey II），依據為胞質豐富、邊緣被紅血球擠壓成扇貝狀且邊緣較深藍，細胞群形態多樣。
EBV 感染時增生的非典型淋巴球主要是反應性 CD8+ T 細胞（對抗受感染 B 細胞），不是 B 細胞。
診斷：heterophile antibody（Monospot）；幼兒常偽陰性，此時查 EBV VCA IgM；另可見肝功能異常與輕度血小板低下。
臨床連結：脾腫大者短期避免接觸性運動以防脾破裂；誤用 ampicillin/amoxicillin 常出現皮疹。CMV、急性 HIV、弓形蟲可造成類似血片。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤判為白血病或淋巴瘤細胞；反應性淋巴球形態多樣、由小到大連續過渡，腫瘤細胞則單一形態，必要時以 flow 確認無克隆性。

quiz.q: 圖中淋巴球屬於哪一型 Downey 反應性淋巴球？在 EBV 感染中這些細胞主要是哪一種淋巴球？
quiz.a: Downey type II；反應性 CD8+ T 細胞

63888.recognize_zh: 中央這顆大細胞有深藍色（強嗜鹼性）細胞質，周邊排成一圈清楚空泡，核圓、染色質細緻、N:C 比高，是帶空泡的前紅血球母細胞（proerythroblast）；在紅血球再生不良（red cell aplasia）的背景下要想到 parvovirus B19 或藥物/銅缺乏。
features: Large cell with high N:C ratio and a round, centrally placed nucleus
Finely granular, dispersed chromatin without obvious prominent nucleoli
Intensely basophilic (deep blue) agranular cytoplasm
Numerous discrete clear vacuoles arranged in a rim at the cytoplasmic periphery
Adjacent granulocytic precursors (granulated myelocyte-like cell, band and segmented forms) for size comparison
63888.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large erythroid precursor with a round nucleus, finely stippled chromatin and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The cytoplasm contains multiple distinct, peripherally distributed clear vacuoles. Neighboring granulocytic precursors show normal granulation. The cell is morphologically a vacuolated proerythroblast; in the setting of red cell aplasia, this finding raises parvovirus B19 infection, drug toxicity (e.g., chloramphenicol, linezolid), copper deficiency or alcohol as causes, and correlation with viral studies and clinical history is recommended.

ddx.vs: B19-infected pronormoblasts are strikingly enlarged with glassy intranuclear viral inclusions and cytoplasmic 'dog-ear' pseudopods, whereas vacuolation alone is nonspecific and B19 is confirmed by PCR.

Leukemic proerythroblasts can have vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm but form a sheet with ≥30% of marrow cells and marked dyserythropoiesis, unlike an isolated vacuolated precursor in an aplastic erythroid series.

Burkitt cells also have deep blue vacuolated cytoplasm but show multiple nucleoli, coarser clumped chromatin, lipid vacuoles overlying the nucleus and a B-cell phenotype (CD19/CD10+), versus CD71/glycophorin+ erythroid lineage.
Vacuolated erythroid and myeloid precursors with ringed sideroblasts on iron stain and low serum copper or a drug history favor these toxic/nutritional causes.

63824.recognize_zh: 數顆嗜中性球的細胞質中可見亮藍綠色、邊界清楚的折光性包涵體（右上與左下各一顆最明顯），不同於淡藍模糊的 Döhle body；在肝衰竭、乳酸中毒的重症病人出現這種藍綠色結晶（俗稱「green crystals of death」）通常代表預後很差。
features: Neutrophils containing one or more discrete, bright blue-green, refractile cytoplasmic inclusions
Inclusions are sharply demarcated and distinct from the fine pink-violet neutrophilic granules
Neutrophils mostly segmented to band forms with coarse granulation
Numerous crenated red cells (echinocytes) and occasional polychromatophilic cells
Platelets scattered with a small platelet clump at the upper left
63824.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several neutrophils, including band and segmented forms, some of which contain discrete bright blue-green refractile cytoplasmic inclusions. The inclusions are well circumscribed and differ from Döhle bodies and toxic granules. Red cells show numerous echinocytes, and platelets are present with a small clump. In a critically ill patient with liver failure, these findings are consistent with blue-green neutrophil (and monocyte) inclusions, which are associated with acute liver injury, lactic acidosis and high short-term mortality and should be communicated to the clinical team.

ddx.vs: Döhle bodies are pale grey-blue, poorly defined, non-refractile patches at the cytoplasmic periphery, not bright sharply outlined green crystals.
Bacteria and yeast appear as uniform dark-purple rods, cocci or budding forms, often within vacuoles, rather than irregular blue-green refractile material.

ddx.dx: Hemozoin (malaria pigment) or hemosiderin in phagocytes
ddx.vs: Malaria pigment is brown-black and Prussian blue-negative, and hemosiderin is golden-brown on Romanowsky stain and Prussian blue-positive, unlike blue-green crystals.
Cryoglobulin deposits are pale blue amorphous extracellular or phagocytosed globules related to cold exposure and a paraprotein, not refractile green crystals in liver failure.

63760.recognize_zh: α1-spectrin 免疫染色中，脂肪空泡之間成群的紅血球前驅細胞幾乎完全陰性（只見藍色核），僅少數血竇內紅血球呈棕色陽性，插圖放大亦為陰性，與前一張 glycophorin A 強陽性形成對比，表示前驅細胞缺乏 α-spectrin 表現。
features: Erythroid precursors in clusters between adipocytes are essentially negative for alpha-1 spectrin
Inset (100x) shows unstained precursor cells with only hematoxylin-stained nuclei
Rare brown staining limited to small groups of mature erythrocytes within sinusoids
Faint nonspecific granular background staining
Marrow cellularity and architecture similar to the glycophorin A-stained section
63760.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for alpha-1 spectrin shows erythroid precursors, which are abundant and glycophorin A-positive on a parallel section, to be essentially negative, as confirmed at high power in the inset. Only rare small groups of mature erythrocytes in sinusoids show brown staining. The discordance between preserved glycophorin A and absent alpha-1 spectrin indicates markedly reduced alpha-spectrin expression in erythroid precursors, a finding that points to an erythroid membrane cytoskeletal defect and should be correlated with red cell morphology, ektacytometry and molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Would also fail to stain mature red cells and external positive controls, whereas rare erythrocytes here stain appropriately.
Suggested by alpha-spectrin deficiency; confirmed by elliptocytes/poikilocytes on smear, ektacytometry and SPTA1 sequencing rather than by marrow IHC alone.
Aberrant marker loss in neoplasia accompanies atypical immature erythroblasts, which are not evident in this maturing erythroid population.

63696.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的紅血球內有一小群聚集、深藍紫色、大小不一的細小顆粒，偏向細胞一側，這是含鐵的 Pappenheimer bodies；它們呈多顆成簇，與單一大顆的 Howell-Jolly body 或均勻分布的嗜鹼性點彩不同。
features: Small cluster of fine, irregular dark basophilic granules within a single red cell (arrow)
Granules clustered toward one side of the cell rather than evenly dispersed
Another red cell with a tiny similar granule; most red cells lack inclusions
Several crenated (echinocytic) red cells and one larger bluish polychromatophilic cell
Platelet present; no nucleated cells in the field
63696.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a red cell containing a small cluster of fine, irregular, dark basophilic granules located toward one side of the cell (arrow), consistent with Pappenheimer bodies. A few other red cells contain isolated similar granules, while most are free of inclusions. Scattered crenated red cells, likely artifactual, and a polychromatophilic cell are also present. Confirmation of iron content can be obtained with a Prussian blue stain (siderocytes); Pappenheimer bodies are seen in sideroblastic anemia, hemoglobinopathies, lead poisoning and post-splenectomy states.

ddx.vs: A Howell-Jolly body is usually a single, larger, round, dense purple nuclear remnant rather than a cluster of small irregular granules, and is Prussian blue negative.
Basophilic stippling consists of fine or coarse granules evenly dispersed throughout the whole red cell and is iron negative.
Platelets and precipitate lie in a different focal plane, often extend beyond the red cell outline and are not confined within the cell.
Parasites have defined ring or tetrad forms with cytoplasm and chromatin dots rather than clumped irregular dark granules.

exam.answer_en: Pappenheimer bodies — cluster of fine basophilic iron-containing granules at the periphery of a red cell
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指紅血球一側成簇的細小深藍顆粒，要你與 Howell-Jolly body、basophilic stippling 區分；三者成分分別為鐵、DNA、RNA（核糖體）。
確認：Prussian blue 染色陽性，含這類鐵顆粒的無核紅血球稱為 siderocyte；Wright 染色看到的是含鐵顆粒與蛋白質的複合物。
臨床連結：sideroblastic anemia、MDS with ring sideroblasts、thalassemia、鉛中毒、脾切除後；脾臟正常時會把這些顆粒 pitting 移除。
看到 Pappenheimer bodies 且伴貧血，下一步常考骨髓鐵染色找 ring sideroblasts。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 basophilic stippling：stippling 為均勻散布全細胞的細點、Prussian blue 陰性；Pappenheimer bodies 少數成簇偏一側且含鐵。Howell-Jolly body 則為單顆較大圓點。

quiz.q: 如何證實箭頭所指紅血球內的顆粒含鐵？含這類顆粒的紅血球稱為什麼？
quiz.a: Prussian blue 染色陽性；siderocyte

63632.recognize_zh: 左上 H&E 可見淡粉紅色的類上皮組織球聚集（epithelioid granuloma），周圍是深染的非典型淋巴樣細胞；TdT 與 CD3 在腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫強陽性，顯示為 T 淋巴母細胞；CD34 圖中主要是血管內皮染色，腫瘤細胞染色不明顯。
features: H&E: sheets of small to medium hyperchromatic atypical lymphoid cells adjacent to a pale eosinophilic aggregate of epithelioid histiocytes (granuloma)
TdT: diffuse strong nuclear positivity in the neoplastic infiltrate, with a negative granulomatous area
CD3: diffuse positivity in the neoplastic lymphoid cells
CD34: strong staining of endothelial cells lining vessels; neoplastic cells show at most faint/equivocal staining in this panel
Four-panel composite of H&E and immunohistochemistry on a tissue/core biopsy
63632.describe_en: Composite figure of a tissue biopsy. The H&E panel shows sheets of small to medium hyperchromatic atypical lymphoid cells surrounding pale eosinophilic aggregates of epithelioid histiocytes forming non-necrotizing granulomas. Immunohistochemistry shows diffuse nuclear TdT and diffuse CD3 staining of the lymphoid infiltrate, establishing an immature T-cell phenotype. The CD34 panel shows strong endothelial staining, with the neoplastic cells largely negative or only faintly stained in this field, so CD34 positivity stated in the legend is not clearly demonstrated. Findings are consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma with an associated epithelioid granulomatous reaction.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes around infectious granulomas are TdT-negative, and the lymphoid cells are not sheet-like atypical blasts.

ddx.dx: Thymoma (type B) with TdT+ immature T cells
ddx.vs: Thymoma contains cytokeratin-positive epithelial cells within the TdT+ T-cell population, unlike lymphoblastic lymphoma.
Hodgkin lymphoma shows CD30+/CD15+ Reed-Sternberg cells in a mixed background, and the surrounding lymphocytes are mature TdT-negative T cells.
Lennert lymphoma has epithelioid histiocyte clusters with mature CD3+ T cells that are TdT-negative and CD34-negative.

63568.recognize_zh: 臨床照片：小腿上散布多個圓形、如打孔般的小潰瘍與已癒合的萎縮性疤痕，其中兩個仍有紅色肉芽與結痂，其餘中央呈銀白色、周圍環繞暗褐色色素沉著，呈現反覆發作不同時期的鐮刀型貧血腿部潰瘍。
features: Multiple (about eight to ten) small, round, punched-out lesions scattered over the lower leg
Two active ulcers with red granulation tissue and yellow-brown crust
Several healed lesions with shiny, silvery-white atrophic centers
Prominent rings of dark brown hyperpigmentation surrounding both active and healed lesions
Lesions at different stages of evolution, without visible cellulitis or necrosis
63568.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows multiple small, round, punched-out ulcers and scars scattered over the lower leg. Two lesions are active, with red granulation tissue and crusting, while the remainder show silvery atrophic centers consistent with healed ulcers. All lesions are surrounded by rims of dark hyperpigmentation, and they appear to be at different stages of evolution. There is no visible surrounding cellulitis or necrotic eschar. In a patient with sickle cell anemia and hemolysis, the findings are consistent with recurrent sickle cell leg ulcers.

ddx.vs: Livedoid vasculopathy produces small painful ulcers healing as white atrophie blanche scars with livedo reticularis, and biopsy shows vessel wall fibrin thrombi.
Ecthyma lesions are purulent, crusted punched-out ulcers with positive cultures and respond to antibiotics.
Pyoderma gangrenosum ulcers are larger with undermined violaceous borders and heal with cribriform scars.
These produce indurated nodules that ulcerate with raised borders and are diagnosed by biopsy with organisms, smear or PCR.

63440.recognize_zh: 血片中大量紅血球表面有突起，多數細胞保有中央淡染、突起短而大致均勻分布，更像棘狀紅血球（echinocyte, burr cell）；僅少數細胞呈濃縮、突起不規則的棘紅血球（acanthocyte）樣。腎衰竭病人最常見的是 echinocyte，判讀時需注意區分。
features: Many red cells with surface projections
Majority show short, fairly evenly spaced spicules with retained central pallor (echinocyte/burr cell pattern)
A minority are smaller, denser cells with fewer irregularly spaced projections (acanthocyte-like)
Scattered platelets and a small lymphocyte
No schistocytes, spherocytes, or red cell inclusions evident
63440.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cells with surface projections. Most of these cells retain central pallor and have short, relatively uniform, evenly distributed spicules, a pattern typical of echinocytes (burr cells); only a minority are smaller, dense cells with fewer irregular spiky projections resembling acanthocytes. A small lymphocyte and platelets are present, and schistocytes are not seen. In this patient with renal failure, the findings are most suggestive of echinocytosis (burr cells), with only a subset of cells meeting acanthocyte criteria; drying artifact from slow smear preparation should also be excluded. The title of acanthocytes is therefore only partly supported by this image.

ddx.dx: Echinocytes (burr cells) of uremia or artifact
ddx.vs: Echinocytes have 10-30 short, regular, evenly spaced projections with preserved central pallor, whereas acanthocytes are dense, lack central pallor, and have 2-20 irregular projections of varying length.

ddx.dx: True acanthocytosis in liver disease or abetalipoproteinemia
ddx.vs: Spur cell anemia and abetalipoproteinemia show dense contracted cells with irregular thorny projections throughout the smear together with clinical liver disease or lipid abnormalities.
Fragmented cells show horn-like projections from a ruptured vacuole and sharp angular edges, with thrombocytopenia in MAHA.
Seen as spiculated cells mainly after splenectomy with chronic hemolysis and a low PK enzyme assay rather than renal failure.

63376.recognize_zh: 一個約兩倍紅血球大的芽細胞（blast），核染色質細緻、胞質少且偏藍，胞質內包著一整顆完整的紅血球把核擠到一邊，這就是芽細胞的吞噬紅血球（erythrophagocytosis）。
features: Single medium-sized blast, roughly twice the diameter of a red cell
High N:C ratio with finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not distinct
Scant deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm rim
Intact engulfed red cell within the cytoplasm indenting the nucleus
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules seen
Background of normochromic red cells without other leukocytes in field
63376.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a medium-sized blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and a thin rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm. The cytoplasm contains an intact phagocytosed red cell that indents the nucleus. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are seen. In the context of immunophenotyping confirming B-lineage, findings represent erythrophagocytosis by B-lymphoblasts, an uncommon finding in B-ALL.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, folded nuclei and nonspecific esterase positivity; lineage must be confirmed by flow cytometry.
This AML shows prominent erythrophagocytosis by monocytoid blasts with MPO/NSE positivity and the characteristic translocation.
Histiocytes are larger with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm and mature chromatin rather than blast chromatin.
An overlapping red cell lies in a different focal plane and lacks a surrounding cytoplasmic rim or nuclear indentation.

63184.recognize_zh: 周邊血中有一顆中到大型細胞，核質比很高、染色質細緻均勻、只剩一圈淡藍細胞質且無顆粒，是母細胞；背景紅血球有橢圓形、淚滴與鋸齒狀等異形，並有大型血小板，符合 MDS 背景。
features: Single medium to large blast, about twice the diameter of adjacent red cells
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale, agranular cytoplasm
Round nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved
No Auer rods identified
Background poikilocytosis (elliptocytes, teardrops, echinocytic forms) with occasional large, hypogranular-to-granular platelets
63184.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating blast with a round nucleus, finely dispersed chromatin, very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and a thin rim of agranular cytoplasm; no Auer rods are seen. The background red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with elliptocytes, teardrop cells and spiculated forms, and there are occasional large platelets. In the context of a myelodysplastic neoplasm, findings are consistent with circulating blasts; the peripheral blast percentage should be enumerated as it affects classification.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant basophilic cytoplasm that hugs red cells and more condensed chromatin than this fine-chromatin blast.
Lymphoma cells usually show nuclear irregularity or clefting with coarser chromatin, and flow cytometry shows mature B- or T-cell phenotype without CD34.
Pronormoblasts have deeply basophilic cytoplasm and more coarsely granular chromatin rather than a pale agranular rim.

63120.recognize_zh: A、B 圖血片中箭頭指出核偏位、細胞質深藍豐富並有核周淡區的漿細胞樣淋巴球／漿母細胞；C 圖流式顯示 CD19+ B 細胞佔淋巴球 32%，其中 93% 為 CD38+IgM+，代表 EBV 感染時的反應性漿母細胞增生。本圖未顯示噬血現象。
features: PB smear (A, B): circulating plasmacytoid lymphocytes/plasmablasts with eccentric round nuclei (arrows)
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear pallor (hof) and irregular cytoplasmic borders
Moderately condensed chromatin without prominent nucleoli; background red cells unremarkable
Flow (C): CD19+ B cells comprise 32% of lymphocyte gate, 93% of which are CD38+ IgM+
A minor CD19+ subset (4%) with lower SSC is predominantly IgM+ CD38− (79%)
No hemophagocytosis is depicted in this composite
63120.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasmablast-like cells with eccentric nuclei, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, and perinuclear hofs (panels A and B, arrows). Flow cytometry (panel C) demonstrates an expanded CD19-positive B-cell population (32% of lymphocytes), the majority of which co-express CD38 and surface IgM, consistent with an activated plasmablastic phenotype; a smaller CD19-positive subset is IgM+ CD38−. Light-chain analysis is not shown, so clonality cannot be assessed from this figure, and hemophagocytosis itself is not illustrated. In a patient with EBV-triggered HLH, these findings are best interpreted as a reactive EBV-driven plasmablastic B-cell response, but relapse of B-cell lymphoma should be excluded given the history.

ddx.dx: Relapsed B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Lymphoma would show kappa or lambda light-chain restriction and a persistent clonal IGH rearrangement, not assessable on this figure.
PCL cells are CD19-negative, CD138+, CD38 bright with cytoplasmic light-chain restriction, unlike these CD19+ IgM+ plasmablasts.
LPL is also IgM+ with plasmacytoid cells but is monotypic, MYD88 L265P mutated, and chronic rather than an acute post-viral surge.

ddx.dx: Reactive atypical lymphocytes of infectious mononucleosis
ddx.vs: Classic mononucleosis cells are predominantly CD8+ T cells with abundant cytoplasm scalloping around red cells, rather than CD19+ CD38+ plasmablasts.

63056.recognize_zh: 富細胞的骨髓抹片中有許多顆粒稀少的單核型未成熟髓系細胞（白箭頭），夾雜細胞質深藍、核偏心的漿細胞（藍箭頭），以及細胞質呈藍綠色的海藍組織球（紅箭頭）；在治療後病人出現這種組合，提示治療相關骨髓腫瘤。
features: Cellular aspirate with marrow particles and fat spaces
Increased mononuclear hypogranular immature myeloid cells with round nuclei and moderate pale blue cytoplasm (white arrows)
Occasional plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (blue arrows)
Large histiocyte with abundant sea-blue to blue-green cytoplasm and eccentric nucleus (red arrow), with additional similar histiocytes nearby
Numerous small dark erythroid precursors and lymphocytes in the background
63056.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows an increase in mononuclear, hypogranular immature myeloid cells with round nuclei and pale blue cytoplasm, reported to be MPO-positive. Occasional plasma cells and scattered sea-blue histiocytes with abundant blue-green cytoplasm are present, the latter reflecting increased cell turnover. Precise blast enumeration is not possible from this field. In a patient with prior cytotoxic therapy, findings are consistent with a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm; blast percentage, dysplasia assessment and cytogenetics are required for classification.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so distinction rests on documented prior cytotoxic or radiation therapy.
Myeloma shows sheets of clonal CD138+ plasma cells, whereas plasma cells here are only occasional and the dominant population is MPO-positive myeloid.
True Gaucher cells have wrinkled-tissue-paper cytoplasm in a non-neoplastic marrow, whereas pseudo-Gaucher and sea-blue histiocytes here accompany a myeloid neoplasm.
Regenerating marrow shows synchronous, orderly maturation with granulated promyelocytes and resolves on follow-up, without persistent hypogranular blasts.

62992.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 IgG 免疫染色下，大量細胞質強陽性、核偏位的漿細胞散布於淋巴球之間，局部成群聚集；這是評估 IgG4 相關病變時計算 IgG4/IgG 比值的分母染色。
features: Numerous cells with strong cytoplasmic IgG staining and eccentric, unstained nuclei (plasma cell morphology)
Plasma cells distributed diffusely between small lymphocytes, with denser clusters in some areas
Background small lymphocytes negative with blue hematoxylin counterstain
Faint extracellular/interstitial staining from background immunoglobulin
No sheets of atypical large cells visible
62992.describe_en: IgG immunostain of the lymph node shows numerous IgG-positive plasma cells with strong cytoplasmic staining scattered diffusely among small lymphocytes, forming small clusters in areas. Background lymphocytes are negative, and there is light interstitial staining from extracellular immunoglobulin. This stain serves as the denominator for the IgG4:IgG ratio; together with the IgG4 stain it supports an IgG4-rich plasmacytosis, here occurring in a lymph node from a patient with systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Requires increased IgG4+ plasma cells (typically >100/HPF and IgG4:IgG >40%) on the paired IgG4 stain; IgG alone cannot establish it.
Reactive plasmacytosis shows abundant IgG+ plasma cells but a low IgG4:IgG ratio on the companion stain.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Neoplastic plasma cells show light-chain restriction on kappa/lambda ISH, whereas this population would be polytypic.

62864.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片可見一顆有核紅血球（正色性正母細胞），背景紅血球大小不一且形狀多變：有棘狀/鋸齒狀紅血球、碎片、淚滴狀與不規則形紅血球，符合 CDA II 的紅血球大小不等與異形。
features: Nucleated red blood cell (orthochromatic normoblast) in the center of the field
Anisocytosis with mixed normal-sized and smaller red cells
Poikilocytosis including crenated/echinocytic cells, irregular fragments and teardrop-like forms
Some red cells contain fine punctate inclusions of uncertain nature
Platelets present; no leukocytes other than the nucleated red cell
62864.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows moderate anisopoikilocytosis with crenated and echinocytic red cells, irregular fragments and occasional teardrop-like forms. A nucleated red blood cell (orthochromatic normoblast) is present, and a few red cells contain fine punctate inclusions whose nature cannot be determined at this resolution. Platelets are present. These nonspecific findings of a dyserythropoietic or hemolytic process are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II in the appropriate marrow and genetic context.

ddx.vs: HS shows spherocytes lacking central pallor with an increased reticulocyte count and positive EMA binding, whereas CDA II has inappropriately low reticulocytes and binucleate marrow erythroblasts.
Thalassemia shows marked hypochromic microcytosis, target cells and basophilic stippling with abnormal hemoglobin electrophoresis.
Leukoerythroblastosis includes immature myeloid cells and prominent teardrop cells, with marrow fibrosis or infiltration on biopsy.

62800.recognize_zh: 多顆淋巴球的細胞質內有一小團粗大、紫紅色的顆粒，常聚集在淡色空泡區內（Gasser cells），嗜中性球也可見較粗的顆粒，符合黏多醣症（Sanfilippo syndrome）的 Alder-Reilly 異常。
features: Small to medium lymphocytes with a focal cluster of coarse, dark purple-red (metachromatic) cytoplasmic granules, often within a clear vacuole-like halo (A, B, D, E, F)
Lymphocyte nuclei with mature condensed chromatin and no nucleoli
Neutrophil with coarse, dense azurophilic granules throughout the cytoplasm (C)
No Döhle bodies or vacuolization suggesting infection
Background red cells and platelets unremarkable
62800.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytes with mature chromatin that contain discrete clusters of coarse, deeply staining metachromatic granules, frequently surrounded by a clear halo (Gasser cells). A neutrophil displays coarse dark azurophilic granulation. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable, and Döhle bodies or toxic vacuolization are not seen. Findings are consistent with Alder-Reilly anomaly in the setting of mucopolysaccharidosis (Sanfilippo syndrome).

ddx.vs: Toxic granulation affects neutrophils only, accompanies Döhle bodies and vacuoles in infection, and does not produce granule clusters in lymphocytes.
Chédiak-Higashi shows giant, fused peroxidase-positive granules in granulocytes and lymphocytes rather than clusters of fine-to-coarse metachromatic granules in vacuoles.
LGLs have abundant pale cytoplasm with few fine azurophilic granules scattered rather than a dense cluster in a halo.

ddx.dx: Batten disease (neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis) vacuolated lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Batten disease shows sharply punched-out empty vacuoles in lymphocytes without metachromatic granules.

exam.answer_en: Alder-Reilly anomaly in mucopolysaccharidosis (Sanfilippo syndrome) — lymphocytes with clustered metachromatic granules in vacuoles (Gasser cells)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指「淋巴球胞質內一團粗大紫紅顆粒」問名稱（Alder-Reilly anomaly／Gasser cells），並問與哪類代謝病相關（黏多醣症）。
顆粒為溶酶體內未分解的 glycosaminoglycans，toluidine blue 染色呈 metachromatic；可見於 Hurler、Hunter、Sanfilippo 等 MPS。
Sanfilippo syndrome = MPS III，體染色體隱性，堆積 heparan sulfate，以進行性神經退化為主、體表異常較輕；Hunter（MPS II）則為 X-linked。
篩檢：尿液 GAG 定量與電泳；確診靠酵素活性與基因檢測。
Alder-Reilly 顆粒本身不影響白血球功能，臨床意義在於提示潛在的溶酶體儲積症。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 toxic granulation；中毒性顆粒只見於嗜中性球且伴 Döhle bodies 與空泡，Alder-Reilly 顆粒則也出現在淋巴球並聚集於空泡內。

quiz.q: 圖中淋巴球胞質內成團的紫紅顆粒稱為何種異常？提示哪一類疾病？
quiz.a: Alder-Reilly anomaly；mucopolysaccharidosis（如 Sanfilippo syndrome）

62736.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片高倍下一個組織球的胞質被大量淡藍色、針狀到棒狀、交錯排列的結晶填滿，核被遮蔽，周圍為一般造血細胞，這種「胞質滿是結晶」的外觀即 crystal-storing histiocytosis。
features: Single large histiocyte with abundant cytoplasm expanded by crystalline material
Numerous pale blue to grey-blue, needle-shaped to rod-like crystals in a haphazard, criss-crossing arrangement
Nucleus partly obscured by the crystalline inclusions
No phagocytosed red cells or nucleated cells within the histiocyte
Surrounding hematopoietic precursors and red cells without an obvious plasma cell excess in this field
62736.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a large histiocyte whose cytoplasm is packed with numerous pale blue, elongated needle- to rod-shaped crystalline inclusions arranged haphazardly and partially obscuring the nucleus. No hemophagocytosis is present. Surrounding hematopoietic cells show no obvious excess of plasma cells in this field, although resolution limits assessment. Findings are consistent with crystal-storing histiocytosis; evaluation for an underlying monoclonal gammopathy or lymphoplasmacytic neoplasm is warranted.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm with fine striations rather than discrete, sharply outlined needle-shaped crystals.
Show similar fine striated cytoplasm to Gaucher cells without discrete refractile crystals, and are associated with high cell turnover.
Contain coarse blue-green granules of ceroid rather than elongated crystals.

ddx.dx: Crystalline inclusions in plasma cells (Fanconi-type myeloma)
ddx.vs: The crystals lie within plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hof, not within CD68-positive histiocytes.

62672.recognize_zh: BCL2 染色中，一大片密集的中小型淋巴細胞呈細胞質/核周強陽性，包括結節內的細胞；生發中心細胞正常應為 BCL2 陰性，所以結節內 BCL2 陽性支持濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Dense sheet/nodule of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with strong cytoplasmic and perinuclear BCL2 staining
Positivity present in the vast majority of cells within the nodular area
Nuclei round-to-slightly irregular, unstained centrally (ring-like pattern)
Fewer positive cells in paler peripheral areas with scattered negative larger cells and endothelium
No clear BCL2-negative germinal center within the nodule
62672.describe_en: BCL2 immunohistochemistry shows a dense nodular population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with strong cytoplasmic and perinuclear BCL2 expression throughout, without a BCL2-negative germinal center. The less cellular peripheral areas contain scattered negative cells. Since normal germinal center B cells are BCL2 negative, BCL2 expression in CD10/BCL6-positive follicles indicates neoplastic follicles. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers are BCL2 negative, with positivity only in mantle cells and intrafollicular T cells.

ddx.dx: Follicular colonization by marginal zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: MZL cells are BCL2 positive but CD10 and BCL6 negative, so correlation with germinal center markers is required.
PTFL is typically BCL2 protein negative or weak and lacks BCL2 rearrangement, unlike this strong expression.

exam.answer_en: Follicular lymphoma — BCL2 protein expressed by neoplastic follicle cells (normal germinal centers are BCL2-negative)
pearls_zh: 考法：問「結節內 BCL2 陽性代表什麼」；正常生發中心 B 細胞 BCL2 陰性，結節內陽性提示腫瘤性濾泡（t(14;18) 使 BCL2 過度表現）。
判讀陷阱：濾泡內 T 細胞與 mantle zone B 細胞本來就 BCL2 陽性，需對照 CD3 與 CD10 分布，確認陽性的是生發中心細胞。
BCL2 IHC 陰性不能排除 FL：BCL2 基因突變可使部分抗體殖株（如 clone 124）偵測不到，可改用 E17/SP66 殖株或 FISH。
BCL2 陰性／弱的 FL 型：pediatric-type FL、testicular FL、多數 primary cutaneous follicle center lymphoma、部分帶 1p36 deletion 的 FL。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把濾泡內 T 細胞或 mantle 細胞的 BCL2 陽性當成腫瘤陽性；需確認陽性細胞位於 CD10+ 生發中心內且非 CD3+ T 細胞。

quiz.q: 反應性生發中心 BCL2 應為陽性或陰性？圖中結節內 BCL2 陽性支持何診斷？
quiz.a: 陰性；follicular lymphoma

62608.recognize_zh: 高倍下成片漿細胞樣細胞，核偏位、染色質粗顆粒並有小核仁，細胞質豐富嗜雙染，夾雜大型非典型漿細胞；形態單一，符合漿細胞瘤樣 PTLD。
features: Sheets of discohesive plasmacytoid cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate pleomorphism with scattered large atypical plasma cells, one with abundant dense eosinophilic cytoplasm
Occasional binucleate forms; perinuclear hof in some cells
Thin fibrovascular septa; no polymorphous small lymphocyte background
62608.describe_en: High-power view shows diffuse sheets of atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, small nucleoli and abundant amphophilic cytoplasm. There is mild to moderate pleomorphism with scattered enlarged and binucleate plasma cells. A polymorphous admixture of small lymphocytes, immunoblasts and eosinophils is not seen. In a transplant setting with EBER positivity and light-chain restriction, findings are consistent with monomorphic PTLD, plasmacytoma-like type.

ddx.vs: Plasmablastic lymphoma is dominated by immunoblast-like cells with large central nucleoli and very high proliferation rather than recognizable mature plasma cells.
Morphology is identical; transplant history, EBER positivity and absence of marrow disease/M-protein favor PTLD.
Reactive plasma cells are small, mature and polytypic by kappa/lambda ISH, without sheets of atypical binucleate forms.

ddx.dx: Anaplastic or immunoblastic large B-cell lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Those tumors retain CD20/PAX5 expression and a large-cell component, whereas plasmacytoma-like PTLD is CD20-negative and MUM1/CD138-positive.

62544.recognize_zh: 兒童骨髓切片中造血細胞與脂肪細胞交錯，中央有一群成熟中的紅血球系前驅細胞島（深色小圓核），左側可見小型、雙核的巨核細胞，另有少量含鐵血黃素沉積；此紅系島加上小型異常巨核細胞的組合，符合 RCC。
features: Hematopoietic tissue interspersed with numerous adipocytes
Central erythroid island of maturing normoblasts with dark round nuclei
Small megakaryocytes, including one with two separate round nuclei
Relatively sparse granulocytic precursors
Scattered golden-brown hemosiderin deposits
62544.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows hematopoietic tissue interspersed with adipocytes, containing a prominent erythroid island of maturing normoblasts. Megakaryocytes are small, and one shows two widely separated round nuclei. Granulopoiesis is relatively sparse, and scattered hemosiderin deposits are present. Overall cellularity cannot be judged from this high-power field alone. In a child with persistent cytopenias, the patchy erythroid islands and small megakaryocytes are suggestive of refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia lacks erythroid islands with left-shifted maturation and shows no megakaryocytic dysplasia.
Morphology overlaps, so chromosome breakage and germline genetic studies are needed.
MDS-EB requires increased blasts (≥5% in marrow), which are not evident in this field and should be assessed with CD34 staining.

62480.recognize_zh: CD21 染色把擴大的白髓結節整個標示成深棕色、緻密的濾泡樹突細胞網（FDC meshwork），結節間區域則陰性，顯示腫瘤沿著原有濾泡結構擴張，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Large, expanded nodules with dense, strong CD21-positive meshwork-like staining throughout
Sharply demarcated nodule borders with a CD21-negative intervening zone
Meshwork pattern consistent with follicular dendritic cell networks, possibly with some CD21 expression by neoplastic B cells
Internodular red pulp largely negative
62480.describe_en: CD21 immunohistochemical stain on spleen at low power shows large, expanded nodules filled with dense CD21-positive meshworks, consistent with expanded follicular dendritic cell networks, sharply separated from CD21-negative internodular tissue. The intensity and extent of staining across the entire nodule suggest that the neoplastic infiltrate occupies and expands pre-existing follicles, and some marginal zone B cells may themselves be CD21 positive. Findings support a follicle-based lymphoid proliferation compatible with splenic marginal zone lymphoma in context.

ddx.vs: Follicular lymphoma also shows expanded CD21-positive FDC meshworks, but the neoplastic cells are CD10 and BCL6 positive.
AITL shows irregular, extrafollicular proliferation of FDC meshworks around high endothelial venules, with a PD1/CXCL13-positive T-cell population.
Reactive follicles have compact CD21 networks confined to germinal centers, not diffusely expanded confluent nodules.

62416.recognize_zh: 剛果紅染色（一般光學顯微鏡）下，纖維脂肪組織中數個血管壁與管腔周圍有塊狀、無定形的鮭魚粉紅色沉積物，與周圍淡粉色膠原明顯不同；這是類澱粉（amyloid）的剛果紅親和性，需再以偏光確認黃綠色雙折射。
features: Amorphous salmon-pink to orange-red Congophilic deposits
Deposits located within walls of medium-sized blood vessels
Pale pink surrounding collagen and fibroadipose stroma for contrast
Scattered spindle stromal nuclei and small vessels in background
Bright-field view (birefringence must be confirmed under polarized light)
62416.describe_en: Congo red stain of fibroadipose tissue shows amorphous salmon-pink to orange-red deposits within the walls of several medium-sized blood vessels. The deposits contrast with the pale pink background collagen. Under polarized light these deposits showed apple-green birefringence (see companion image), confirming amyloid. In a patient with plasma cell myeloma the findings are consistent with vascular AL amyloid deposition; subtyping by mass spectrometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Fibrin may stain pink but lacks apple-green birefringence under polarized light.
Hyaline change is homogeneous eosinophilic on H&E but is not Congophilic or birefringent.
Elastic fibers and red cells can pick up Congo red nonspecifically but do not show true apple-green birefringence.

exam.answer_en: AL amyloidosis in plasma cell myeloma — Congophilic salmon-pink amorphous deposits in vessel walls (bright-field Congo red)
pearls_zh: 考法：明視野 Congo red 指血管壁橘紅色無定形物，問下一步：必須在偏光下確認 apple-green birefringence，單看紅色不足以診斷。
Myeloma 病人出現 amyloid：常見表現為 nephrotic syndrome、限制性心肌病變、巨舌、眼眶周圍紫斑、周邊神經病變與自主神經失調。
分型是治療前提：AL 需針對漿細胞克隆治療（如 daratumumab 為基礎合併 CyBorD），ATTR 則是完全不同的治療，須以 mass spectrometry 分型。
Congo red 建議切片較厚（約 5–10 µm）以提高敏感度；thioflavin T/S 螢光染色亦可顯示 amyloid 但特異性較低。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 fibrinoid necrosis、hyaline arteriolosclerosis 或彈性纖維的非特異染色誤當 amyloid；它們在偏光下沒有 apple-green 雙折射。

quiz.q: 這是什麼染色？圖中血管壁橘紅色沉積物需再用何種方式確認為 amyloid？
quiz.a: Congo red；偏光顯微鏡下呈 apple-green birefringence

62352.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片／印片中可見體積大（約為旁邊嗜中性球的兩倍以上）的異常淋巴樣細胞，核圓、染色質細緻、核質比高，胞質為窄而深藍的嗜鹼性邊緣，與成熟嗜中性球形成對比。
features: Two-panel composite of Romanowsky-stained bone marrow aspirate/imprint smears
Large lymphoid cells, roughly two to three times the size of admixed neutrophils
High N:C ratio with round to slightly irregular nuclei and finely dispersed to vesicular chromatin
Narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm; cytoplasmic vacuoles are not clearly resolved at this resolution
Admixed segmented neutrophils and a thick proteinaceous background with red cell debris
62352.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate and imprint smears (two panels) show a population of large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, and a narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with segmented neutrophils. Discrete cytoplasmic vacuolation is not well resolved in these images. The cells are distinctly larger than mature neutrophils, favoring a large-cell lymphoid process over a lymphoblastic one. With CD20 and CD10 positivity, findings are compatible with marrow involvement by a CD10-positive large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Blasts are usually smaller with scant, less basophilic cytoplasm, and are TdT+ or CD34+ with myeloid markers, rather than CD20+ CD10+ mature B cells.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing prominent lipid vacuoles and have MYC rearrangement with near-100% Ki-67.

ddx.dx: Plasmablastic lymphoma or plasma cell neoplasm
ddx.vs: Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof and abundant basophilic cytoplasm, and are CD20-negative CD138+ MUM1+.

62288.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一團紅血球前驅細胞（erythroid island），細胞體積大、核染色質呈開放篩網狀或細點棋盤狀，細胞質深藍，較成熟的細胞仍保留不成熟染色質，旁邊一個小而緻密的晚期細胞可作大小對照，符合巨母紅血球性變化。
features: Cluster of erythroid precursors forming an erythroid island in the center of the field
Large basophilic erythroblast with coarse stippled 'checkerboard' open chromatin and a deep blue cytoplasmic rim
Several smaller erythroblasts with open sieve-like chromatin and basophilic to polychromatic cytoplasm
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony; occasional pale nuclear indentation/Golgi zone
Small dense pyknotic late erythroblast for size comparison; oval macrocytes in background
62288.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of erythroid precursors forming an erythroid island. The precursors are enlarged and display open, stippled sieve-like to checkerboard chromatin with deeply basophilic to early polychromatic cytoplasm, so that nuclear maturation lags behind cytoplasmic maturation. A small dense late erythroblast nearby provides a size comparison, and the background contains oval macrocytes. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic erythropoiesis, supporting megaloblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proerythroblasts with vacuolated cytoplasm and marked atypia, lacking the maturing spectrum within erythroid islands.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin, whereas these cells have central nuclei with deep blue cytoplasm lacking a Golgi hof.
MDS megaloblastoid erythropoiesis is accompanied by dysplasia in other lineages and clonal cytogenetics with normal B12/folate.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia — erythroid island of enlarged erythroblasts with open checkerboard/sieve-like chromatin and asynchrony
pearls_zh: 考法：指中央大型 basophilic erythroblast 的染色質，問形容詞：open、sieve-like 或 checkerboard（點狀）染色質，與正常同階段的緻密染色質對比。
Megaloblastic 變化在補充治療後很快消退；若已開始補充 B12/folate 才抽骨髓，可能看不到典型形態，判讀時需詢問治療時序。
Macrocytosis 鑑別：MCV 很高（常 >110 fL）較支持 megaloblastic；非 megaloblastic 原因包括酒精、肝病、hypothyroidism、reticulocytosis、MDS。
Pernicious anemia 為自體免疫性胃炎，需注意合併其他自體免疫疾病，並有胃 neuroendocrine tumor 與胃癌風險。
exam.pitfall_zh: 紅血球島中成群大型前驅細胞易被誤計為母細胞增加：它們有深藍細胞質與同系成熟梯度，應歸入紅血球系；配合 B12/folate 值判讀。

quiz.q: 圖中央成群的紅血球前驅細胞排列成什麼結構？其核染色質呈何種特徵？
quiz.a: Erythroid island；開放點狀的 sieve-like/checkerboard 染色質（megaloblastic）

62160.recognize_zh: 淋巴結 H&E 切片中散在多團粗大、不透光的黑色顆粒狀色素，位於組織球內並遮蓋細胞核，周圍是小淋巴球，符合碳末沉積巨噬細胞（anthracotic macrophages）。
features: Clusters of coarse, opaque black granular pigment filling histiocyte cytoplasm and obscuring nuclei
Fine dust-like black particles scattered in adjacent stroma and cells
Pigment is non-refractile black rather than golden-brown
Background of small mature lymphocytes with preserved nodal parenchyma
Paler sinus/stromal area with histiocytes and vessels at right
62160.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a background of small mature lymphocytes with scattered histiocytes laden with coarse, opaque black granular pigment that obscures their nuclei, along with fine pigment dust in the adjacent tissue. The pigment is jet black without a golden-brown hue, and no atypical cells or granulomas are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with anthracotic pigment-laden macrophages, a common incidental finding in hilar and mediastinal lymph nodes.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin is golden-brown and refractile and stains blue with Prussian blue, whereas anthracotic pigment is jet black and iron-negative.
Melanin is brown-black within atypical cells with prominent nucleoli and is S100/SOX10/HMB45 positive, whereas anthracotic macrophages are bland CD68-positive histiocytes.
Tattoo pigment can look identical in black but may be multicolored and involves nodes draining tattooed skin rather than thoracic nodes.
Formalin pigment is a fine brown-black birefringent extracellular deposit in bloody areas rather than coarse aggregates inside macrophages.

61968.recognize_zh: 中倍 H&E 可見毛囊漏斗部（角質填充）周圍與真皮中密集的淋巴球浸潤，以小淋巴球為主，表皮僅有輕微淋巴球外滲，無明顯 Pautrier 微膿瘍；毛囊周圍的真皮小淋巴球密集浸潤符合 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病的表現。
features: Dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate surrounding a keratin-filled follicular infundibulum
Infiltrate composed predominantly of small, dark lymphocytes with scattered slightly larger cells
Thin band of papillary dermal collagen separates much of the infiltrate from the epidermis
Mild lymphocyte exocytosis into the follicular epithelium without Pautrier microabscesses
Overlying epidermis with orthokeratosis, otherwise unremarkable
No necrosis or ulceration
61968.describe_en: H&E section of skin shows a dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate surrounding a keratin-filled follicular infundibulum and extending into the adjacent dermis. The infiltrate is composed predominantly of small lymphocytes with scattered slightly larger cells, separated from the epidermis in most areas by a thin band of papillary dermal collagen. There is only mild lymphocyte exocytosis into the follicular epithelium, without Pautrier microabscesses, necrosis or ulceration. Findings are consistent with a dense small-cell dermal lymphoid infiltrate compatible with primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder, pending immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Folliculotropic MF shows atypical T cells infiltrating the follicular epithelium, often with follicular mucinosis, and multiple follicle-based plaques clinically.
