Pseudolymphoma typically has a mixed infiltrate with eosinophils, plasma cells and germinal centers and polyclonal T cells.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: The marginal zone entity is B-cell predominant with monocytoid cells and monotypic plasma cells, which IHC for CD20 and light chains reveals.

61904.recognize_zh: 低倍下真皮膠原纖維間佈滿密集的淋巴樣細胞浸潤，呈血管周圍與附屬器周圍分布並延伸到深層真皮；這種深而密的真皮淋巴浸潤是水痘樣淋巴增生性疾病（HV-LPD）與一般光敏性皮膚炎的差別線索，細胞形態需高倍確認。
features: Dense lymphoid infiltrate diffusely permeating the reticular dermis between collagen bundles
Accentuation around vessels and adnexal structures, including a cuff around a pale vacuolated adnexal structure at left center
Infiltrate extends deep into the dermis rather than being confined to the superficial perivascular plexus
Cells appear small to medium at this magnification; cytologic atypia cannot be assessed
No epidermis or ulcer included in the field
61904.describe_en: Low-power sections of skin show a dense lymphoid infiltrate diffusely involving the reticular dermis, dissecting between collagen bundles with accentuation around vessels and adnexal structures. The infiltrate extends deep into the dermis. The infiltrating cells appear small to medium-sized, but cytologic atypia cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the setting of vesiculopapular lesions on sun-exposed skin and an EBER-positive cytotoxic T/NK-cell infiltrate, the findings are consistent with hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: PMLE shows marked papillary dermal edema with a superficial and deep perivascular infiltrate of small reactive lymphocytes that are EBER-negative, without dense diffuse dermal permeation.

ddx.dx: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type, involving skin
ddx.vs: Cutaneous ENKTL shows larger atypical cells with angiodestruction and extensive necrosis, typically in older patients without a photodistributed vesicular eruption.
These show interface change with mucin (lupus) or wedge-shaped infiltrates with eosinophils (bite), and the lymphocytes are EBER-negative.

61840.recognize_zh: 肺泡灌洗液（BAL）抹片中央是一大團深藍色、泡沫狀/蜂巢狀的無細胞樣團塊，邊緣呈細小點狀空泡，周圍零星巨噬細胞；這種肺泡泡沫狀滲出物（foamy alveolar cast）是肺囊蟲（Pneumocystis jirovecii）的典型線索，個別囊體在此倍率不易辨認。
features: Large, dense, deep blue amorphous aggregate with a foamy, finely bubbly (honeycomb) texture
Granular, stippled edges composed of tiny punctate structures
Individual cysts/trophic forms not clearly resolvable at this magnification
Few scattered alveolar macrophages and inflammatory cells at the periphery
Clean background without abundant neutrophils
61840.describe_en: Bronchoalveolar lavage cytospin stained with a Romanowsky stain shows a large, dense, deep blue, foamy to honeycombed acellular aggregate with finely stippled edges, accompanied by scattered alveolar macrophages. Individual cysts and trophic forms cannot be resolved with certainty at this magnification, and the foamy exudate should be confirmed with Grocott methenamine silver (GMS), immunofluorescence, or PCR. Findings are highly suggestive of Pneumocystis jirovecii infection.

ddx.vs: PAP material is granular, PAS-positive lipoproteinaceous debris with dense bodies, lacking the bubbly cyst-filled texture and GMS-positive cup-shaped cysts.
Mucus forms elongated, streaming, lightly stained strands with entrapped cells rather than dense foamy casts with punctate organisms.
Histoplasma yeasts are intracellular within macrophages, 2–4 µm with a clear halo and budding, rather than extracellular clusters in a foamy cast.
Particulate debris is refractile or polarizable and lacks the organized foamy exudate and GMS-positive cyst walls.

exam.answer_en: Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia — foamy, honeycombed alveolar cast in BAL on Romanowsky stain
pearls_zh: 考法：指這團深藍泡沫/蜂巢狀無細胞團塊問「最可能的病原？」答 Pneumocystis jirovecii；再問確認染色：GMS 染囊壁（黑色杯狀/壓扁乒乓球狀），Giemsa/Diff-Quik 染囊內滋養體核點。
其他確認法：direct immunofluorescence 或 PCR（PCR 高敏感度但可能偵測到定植）；血清 β-D-glucan 常升高可輔助。
高危族群：HIV CD4 <200/µL、長期類固醇、化療/移植及血液腫瘤病人；首選治療與預防為 TMP-SMX，HIV 病人中重度低氧時加用類固醇。
Pneumocystis 無法常規培養，且對一般抗黴菌藥（如 azole）無效，這是常考陷阱。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為 pulmonary alveolar proteinosis 的蛋白質物質或黏液：PAP 為均質顆粒狀、PAS+、GMS 陰性無囊體；PJP 泡沫團塊內有細點狀囊體，GMS 陽性。

quiz.q: BAL 抹片中這團深藍泡沫狀團塊最可能是什麼病原？要看到囊壁應加做哪種染色？
quiz.a: Pneumocystis jirovecii；Grocott methenamine silver (GMS) stain。

61776.recognize_zh: 視野中多個小而圓、染色質濃縮深紫的單一核細胞，周邊有一圈灰藍到粉紅的血紅素化細胞質（黃色箭頭），大小接近紅血球，並可見一個雙核型，這是有核紅血球（NRBC），數量多時需校正白血球計數。
features: Multiple nucleated red blood cells (arrows) with small round, dense pyknotic nuclei and a rim of grey-blue to pink hemoglobinized cytoplasm
Orthochromatic and polychromatic normoblast stages, including one binucleate/budding form (upper right)
Red cells show anisocytosis with target cells, polychromatic cells and some teardrop/irregular forms
One larger mononuclear cell with dense nucleus and scant basophilic cytoplasm (possible lymphocyte or earlier erythroid precursor)
Numerous platelets and platelet clumps plus fine stain precipitate in the background
61776.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous circulating nucleated red blood cells, predominantly orthochromatic and polychromatic normoblasts with condensed round nuclei, including a binucleate form. The background red cells display anisopoikilocytosis with target cells and polychromasia, and platelets are abundant with small clumps and some stain precipitate. No blasts are identified in this field. Because automated analyzers may count NRBCs as leukocytes, the WBC count should be corrected (corrected WBC = total nucleated count x 100 / (100 + NRBC per 100 WBC)). Findings are consistent with marked normoblastemia; the underlying cause (hemolysis, hemoglobinopathy, marrow infiltration, hypoxia or asplenia) requires clinical correlation.

ddx.vs: Lymphocytes have a thin rim of pale sky-blue cytoplasm without hemoglobinization and a less pyknotic, slightly clumped nucleus, whereas NRBC cytoplasm matches the color of surrounding red cells.
NRBCs there are accompanied by left-shifted granulocytes (myelocytes, metamyelocytes) and teardrop cells, which must be actively sought to distinguish from isolated erythroid stress.
Megaloblastic NRBCs show nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open sieve-like chromatin, and dyserythropoiesis shows nuclear budding, multinuclearity and irregular lobes in many cells.
Overlying platelets are small, granular and lie in a different focal plane rather than forming a single dense central nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Marked normoblastemia — numerous circulating orthochromatic/polychromatic nucleated red blood cells requiring WBC correction
pearls_zh: 考法：指箭頭處小而深染的單核細胞問「這是淋巴球嗎？」答 NRBC（orthochromatic normoblast），並要求算 corrected WBC＝WBC×100/(100＋NRBC/100 WBC)。
常見成因：嚴重溶血與 hemoglobinopathy（如 thalassemia major）、骨髓浸潤/骨髓纖維化的 leukoerythroblastic picture、嚴重缺氧或敗血症、脾切除後，以及新生兒生理性。
若同時見到 myelocyte 等左移顆粒球與 teardrop cells，應想到 leukoerythroblastosis 需找骨髓浸潤或 PMF；背景 target cells 則提示 hemoglobinopathy。
加護病房成人血中出現 NRBC 與較差預後相關；現代分析儀多能分開計數 NRBC，但舊機型或警示時仍需人工確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為小淋巴球：NRBC 核圓、染色質極濃縮近乎固縮，周圍是灰藍到粉紅的血紅素化胞質且邊界圓滑；淋巴球胞質為清澈天藍、核常有淺凹。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指的細胞是什麼？若 WBC 為 20×10^9/L、每 100 WBC 見到 100 個此細胞，校正後 WBC 為多少？
quiz.a: Nucleated red blood cells（normoblasts）；20×100/(100+100)=10×10^9/L。

61712.recognize_zh: 這是分子檢測圖：上方為全基因組拷貝數散點圖（log2 fold change），紅圈標示 17 號染色體 TP53 位點拷貝數缺失；下方兩張 IGV 讀段截圖分別顯示 TP53 p.H179R 錯義突變與 c.782+2T>G 剪接位點突變，代表 TP53 雙等位失活。
features: Top: genome-wide copy-number plot of log2 fold change by chromosome with dashed gain/loss thresholds
Red circle on chromosome 17 marks TP53 copy-number loss (values below baseline)
Additional apparent segmental losses on chromosome 5 and a focal region of chromosome 13 below the threshold
Bottom left: IGV read pileup showing a variant column annotated TP53 p.H179R (missense)
Bottom right: IGV read pileup showing TP53 c.782+2T>G (canonical splice-donor variant)
Combination indicates multi-hit (biallelic) TP53 alteration
61712.describe_en: Molecular figure from next-generation sequencing. The upper panel is a genome-wide copy-number plot of log2 fold change by chromosome, with a circled region on chromosome 17 indicating TP53 copy-number loss; segmental losses are also suggested on chromosome 5 and part of chromosome 13, although exact boundaries cannot be read from this image. The lower panels are IGV read-alignment views showing two TP53 variants, a missense p.H179R and a canonical splice-site c.782+2T>G, with high variant read representation. Together these indicate multi-hit TP53 inactivation, which in blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm is uncommon and associated with adverse prognosis; the more typical BPDCN alterations (TET2, ASXL1, ZRSR2, loss of 9p21/CDKN2A, 12p13/ETV6, 13q) should be sought.

ddx.dx: Therapy-related myeloid neoplasm or AML/MDS with mutated TP53
ddx.vs: Multi-hit TP53 with 5q/17p loss is the hallmark of TP53-mutated AML/MDS, so lineage must be established by immunophenotype (CD4/CD56/CD123/TCF4 versus MPO/CD34/CD117).
A variant allele frequency near 50% persisting in non-hematopoietic tissue indicates germline origin, which requires testing of skin fibroblasts or other constitutional DNA.

61648.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見一個核形不規則、胞質充滿粗大紫紅色嗜苯胺藍顆粒（azurophilic granules）而遮蓋核輪廓的異常前骨髓細胞，是急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）在血中出現的線索。
features: Single abnormal promyelocyte with irregular, folded nucleus partly obscured by granules
Cytoplasm densely packed with coarse purple-red azurophilic granules
Faint linear cytoplasmic inclusions suspicious for Auer rods
Background red cells in thick area with rouleaux-like stacking; platelets sparse
No mature neutrophils in the field
61648.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single abnormal promyelocyte with an irregular, folded nucleus and cytoplasm densely filled with coarse azurophilic granules that partly obscure the nuclear outline; faint linear inclusions suggestive of Auer rods are present. Platelets appear decreased in this field and no mature neutrophils are seen. In the appropriate setting (pancytopenia, coagulopathy), findings are suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation of PML::RARA by FISH or PCR is required.

ddx.vs: Normal promyelocytes have a round nucleus with a perinuclear Golgi hof and evenly distributed granules, without the bilobed nucleus, obscuring granules, or Auer rods.
The hypogranular variant shows bilobed 'butterfly' nuclei with sparse fine granules, unlike the heavily granulated cytoplasm here.
AML with maturation has blasts with single Auer rods and a spectrum of maturing neutrophils rather than hypergranular promyelocytes; PML::RARA is absent.
Toxic granulation occurs in mature segmented neutrophils, not in an immature cell with a folded non-segmented nucleus.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia in blood — circulating hypergranular abnormal promyelocyte with folded nucleus and suspected Auer rods
pearls_zh: 考法：指這顆顆粒粗大遮蓋核的細胞問名稱：abnormal promyelocyte；並追問「下一步最重要的處置？」懷疑 APL 即立刻給 ATRA，不等基因確認。
確認：t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2) PML::RARA，以 FISH 或 RT-PCR 快速檢測；WHO 5th 以 PML::RARA 定義，不需芽細胞門檻。
急症：DIC 合併過度纖溶為早期死亡主因；立即查 PT、aPTT、fibrinogen、D-dimer，積極補充血小板與 cryoprecipitate/fibrinogen。
Flow：CD33 強陽性、CD13 不均、CD117 可陽性，HLA-DR−、CD34−、CD11b−；MPO 細胞化學強陽性。
治療與風險：WBC ≤10×10^9/L 為非高危，ATRA＋arsenic trioxide 為標準；需監測 differentiation syndrome（處置為 dexamethasone）與 ATO 的 QTc 延長。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為反應性左移的正常 promyelocyte 或毒性顆粒：正常前骨髓細胞核圓有核周淡區 Golgi zone、顆粒不覆蓋整個核且無 Auer rods；APL 細胞核摺疊似雙葉、顆粒粗密並可見 Auer rods。

quiz.q: 周邊血這顆核摺疊、胞質塞滿粗大紫紅顆粒的細胞是什麼？懷疑此診斷時，在等待 PML::RARA 結果前應立即做什麼？
quiz.a: Abnormal promyelocyte（APL）；立即開始 ATRA 並處理凝血異常（DIC）。

61584.recognize_zh: 左下細胞核有凹陷／摺疊、染色質極細緻，細胞質雖因推片破碎但仍是典型單核母細胞（monoblast）；右上細胞有灰藍色豐富細胞質、偽足樣突起與較成熟的圓核，是未成熟單核球。
features: Two large mononuclear cells, both several times the size of red cells
Lower-left cell: folded/indented nucleus with very fine, lacy chromatin; cytoplasm disrupted and smeared (artifact)
Upper-right cell: round-to-slightly-indented nucleus with slightly more condensed chromatin and faint nucleoli
Upper-right cell: abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular outline and pseudopod-like projections, no obvious granules
Background crenated red cells (echinocytes, likely drying artifact) and platelet clumps
61584.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two large circulating monocytic precursors. The lower-left cell has a large indented to folded nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin; its cytoplasm is disrupted by smearing artifact, but the nuclear features are those of a monoblast. The upper-right cell has abundant gray-blue agranular cytoplasm with irregular pseudopod-like borders and a round nucleus with slightly condensed chromatin and faint nucleoli, consistent with an immature monocyte (promonocyte). Background red cells are crenated, and platelet clumps are present. Findings are consistent with circulating monoblasts/promonocytes as seen in acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia; nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry are recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Mature monocytes have more condensed, folded chromatin without nucleoli, whereas monoblasts/promonocytes retain fine chromatin and nucleoli.
Myeloblasts have scant cytoplasm, may show Auer rods and are MPO-positive, while monoblasts have abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, folded nuclei and are NSE-positive/MPO-weak.
Circulating cells are predominantly mature/abnormal monocytes with blasts plus promonocytes <20%.
Reactive lymphocytes have cytoplasm that scallops around red cells and lack folded nuclei with lacy chromatin.

exam.answer_en: Acute monoblastic/monocytic leukemia — circulating monoblast (fine chromatin, folded nucleus) and promonocyte with gray-blue cytoplasm and pseudopods
pearls_zh: 考法：要你分辨兩顆細胞—左下為 monoblast，右上為 promonocyte/immature monocyte；promonocyte 在 AML 計算時視為 blast equivalent。
細胞化學：nonspecific esterase（α-naphthyl butyrate/acetate）陽性且可被 NaF 抑制；monoblast 的 MPO 常陰性或弱陽性，不能因 MPO 陰性就排除 AML。
Flow：CD14、CD64、CD11b、CD36、CD4（弱）、lysozyme；monoblast 可 CD34 陰性。遺傳常見 KMT2A rearrangement（如 t(9;11) KMT2A::MLLT3）或 NPM1 突變。
臨床：高白血球與 leukostasis、牙齦增生、皮膚浸潤（leukemia cutis）、CNS 侵犯、DIC 與腫瘤溶解症候群風險高。
exam.pitfall_zh: Promonocyte 常被誤算為成熟單核球或反應性單核球，造成 blast 低估；promonocyte 染色質較細緻、核有細緻摺痕，成熟單核球染色質較粗且有空泡。

quiz.q: 圖中右上那顆有灰藍色胞質與偽足的細胞，在計算 AML blast 百分比時算不算？為什麼？
quiz.a: 算；它是 promonocyte，屬 blast equivalent

61520.recognize_zh: CD20 只標到散在的小型 B 淋巴球（清楚的細胞膜染色），而畫面中央那顆大型多葉核細胞完全不染；大型異型細胞 CD20 陰性、背景 B 細胞陽性作為內部對照，符合古典何杰金淋巴瘤的 HRS 細胞表現型。
features: Large multilobated atypical cell in the center is CD20 negative
Scattered small lymphocytes with crisp membranous CD20 staining serve as an internal positive control
Most background cells, including spindle stromal cells and many lymphocytes, are CD20 negative
No sheets of CD20-positive large cells
61520.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 shows membranous staining in scattered small B lymphocytes, which serve as an internal positive control. A large multilobated atypical cell in the center of the field is negative, as are the majority of background cells, including stromal spindle cells. There are no sheets of CD20-positive large cells. Findings support a CD20-negative Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cell phenotype, consistent with classical Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis subtype.

ddx.vs: LP cells are strongly and uniformly CD20 positive within nodules of small B cells, whereas the HRS cell here is CD20 negative.
The scattered large cells of THRLBCL are CD20 strongly positive in a T-cell-rich background.
ALCL is also CD20 negative, so separation relies on PAX5 (dim in cHL, negative in ALCL), CD15, T-cell antigens, and ALK.

61456.recognize_zh: MPO 細胞化學染色中，箭頭所指的細胞胞質布滿深藍色顆粒狀陽性反應（成熟嗜中性球，作為內部陽性對照），左下另一顆細胞亦為陽性；急性未分化白血病的母細胞應為 MPO 陰性，但本視野中陰性母細胞不明顯。
features: Arrowed cell with strong, coarse granular MPO reaction filling the cytoplasm around a pale nucleus
Second strongly positive granulocytic cell at lower left, partly obscured
Background dominated by red cells and fat spaces on a light counterstain
Few if any MPO-negative nucleated blasts clearly visible in this cropped field
Scattered fine positive granules/debris in the background
61456.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear stained for myeloperoxidase shows a mature neutrophil (arrow) with strong granular cytoplasmic positivity, serving as an internal positive control, and a second positive granulocyte at lower left. The remainder of this cropped field consists mainly of red cells and fat spaces, and MPO-negative blasts are not well demonstrated in the image. In a case of acute undifferentiated leukemia, blasts are expected to be MPO-negative (<3% positive) with no lineage-specific markers by flow cytometry. The stain is technically adequate given the positive internal control.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Blasts are MPO-negative by cytochemistry (<3%) but express myeloid antigens (CD13/CD33/CD117) or MPO by flow, unlike AUL.
Blasts are also MPO-negative but express CD19 with CD79a/CD22/CD10 or cytoplasmic CD3.
Blasts meet criteria for two lineages (e.g., MPO plus CD19 or cCD3), whereas AUL lacks lineage-defining markers.

61392.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 可見兩顆大型多核／多葉的巨細胞，核膜清楚、染色質空泡狀並有嗜酸性核仁，形似 Reed-Sternberg 細胞，周圍是小淋巴球、漿細胞、組織球、嗜中性球與內皮細胞混合的發炎背景。
features: Large giant cells with multilobated or overlapping nuclei, vesicular chromatin and distinct eosinophilic nucleoli (Reed-Sternberg-like)
Abundant amphophilic cytoplasm around the giant cells
Scattered intermediate-sized immunoblasts with single nucleoli
Mixed background of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, histiocytes and neutrophils
Activated endothelial cells, extravasated red cells and vacuolated, edematous stroma
61392.describe_en: High-power examination shows scattered large atypical cells with multilobated nuclei, vesicular chromatin, prominent eosinophilic nucleoli and abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, closely resembling Reed-Sternberg cells. These are accompanied by occasional immunoblasts within a polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasma cells, histiocytes and neutrophils in an edematous, vascular stroma. Sheets of large cells are not seen. In the context of a mucocutaneous ulcer, the findings are suggestive of EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer, and immunophenotyping (CD30, CD15, CD20, PAX5) with EBER ISH is required to distinguish it from classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; cHL HRS cells are CD15+, CD20-negative with weak PAX5 and involve lymph nodes, whereas EBVMCU is a sharply circumscribed ulcer with CD20+ often CD15-weak large cells.
Hallmark cells with kidney-shaped nuclei grow cohesively in sinuses or sheets and are CD30+ T/null cells lacking PAX5.
Enlarged cells show a single large intranuclear owl-eye inclusion with halo and granular cytoplasmic inclusions, often in endothelial cells, rather than multilobated nuclei with multiple nucleoli.

61328.recognize_zh: 單一中型母細胞，核圓形略偏心、染色質細緻，細胞質淡藍無明顯顆粒；在核右緣可見一條細長深色針狀構造，疑為 Auer 小體（Auer rod），但本圖中非常細小，辨識需謹慎。
features: Single intermediate-sized mononuclear cell with high N:C ratio
Round to oval, slightly eccentric nucleus with fine chromatin
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm without obvious azurophilic granules
Thin, dark, needle-like linear inclusion along the right nuclear margin, suggestive of an Auer rod
Background normocytic red cells and scattered platelets
61328.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single intermediate-sized blast with a round, slightly eccentric nucleus, finely dispersed chromatin, and a moderate rim of pale blue cytoplasm lacking obvious granules. A thin, dark, needle-shaped linear inclusion is present along the right nuclear border, most suggestive of an Auer rod, although it is subtle and partly overlies the nucleus at this magnification. Red cells and platelets are unremarkable. If the inclusion is confirmed as an Auer rod (e.g., by MPO staining), the finding establishes myeloid lineage and is consistent with acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: Lymphoid cells never contain Auer rods and are MPO-negative.

ddx.dx: Overlying debris or platelet fragment artifact
ddx.vs: Artifact lies in a different focal plane and is MPO-negative, whereas a true Auer rod is intracytoplasmic, azurophilic, and MPO-positive.
APL cells have bilobed nuclei and heavy granulation or bundles of multiple Auer rods (faggot cells) rather than a single rod in an agranular blast.

exam.answer_en: Circulating blast with a probable Auer rod — suggests acute myeloid leukemia; subtle, confirm with MPO
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會問「母細胞核旁那條細針狀物是什麼？」答 Auer rod；有 Auer rod 即表示 myeloid lineage，排除 ALL。
本圖 Auer rod 細小且部分與核重疊，判讀時可用 MPO 或 Sudan black B 染色確認，Auer rod 會強陽性。
單一細長 Auer rod 常見於 AML with maturation 及 t(8;21) RUNX1::RUNX1T1；多條成束則指向 APL。
確立 AML 後仍需骨髓評估、流式（CD34、CD117、CD13、CD33、MPO）與遺傳檢查（如 NPM1、FLT3、CEBPA）以分類。
exam.pitfall_zh: 細小 Auer rod 易與重疊的血小板碎片、染色沉澱或核摺痕混淆；真正 Auer rod 位於細胞質、與細胞同焦平面、呈紫紅針狀且 MPO 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中母細胞核右緣的細長針狀構造若為 Auer rod，可排除哪一類急性白血病？用什麼染色確認？
quiz.a: 排除 ALL（確立 myeloid lineage）；MPO 或 Sudan black B 染色

61264.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中有一團黏聚成合胞體樣的大型細胞，共享大片淡藍色細胞質、細胞界線不清，核大小不一、圓形至有切迹或腎形、染色質細緻並有小核仁，明顯比周圍造血細胞大；這種黏聚成團的非造血細胞即轉移性癌（此例為乳癌）。
features: Cohesive syncytial-appearing cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells with indistinct cell borders
Abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm with a few small clear vacuoles
Round to oval, indented or reniform nuclei with moderate anisonucleosis
Finely granular chromatin with small nucleoli; no mitoses evident
Background of poorly spread red cells; eyepiece photograph with pink cast and soft focus
61264.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive, syncytial cluster of large cells that are clearly distinct from hematopoietic elements. The cells have abundant pale blue cytoplasm with occasional small vacuoles, indistinct borders, and round to indented nuclei with moderate size variation, fine chromatin and small nucleoli. Gland formation or signet-ring cells are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma involving the bone marrow, in keeping with the reported breast primary; confirmation with trephine biopsy and immunohistochemistry (cytokeratin, GATA3, ER) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Osteoblasts are uniform with eccentric round nuclei and a Golgi zone away from the nucleus, without anisonucleosis or nuclear indentation.
An osteoclast is a single cell with many uniform, evenly spaced nuclei in granular cytoplasm and a defined outer border.
Megakaryocytes have one large lobulated nucleus with granular pink cytoplasm and platelet budding rather than multiple separate nuclei.

ddx.dx: Metastatic lobular carcinoma versus other adenocarcinoma primaries
ddx.vs: Morphology cannot establish the primary site; GATA3/ER/mammaglobin favor breast, TTF-1 lung and CDX2 gastrointestinal origin.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic carcinoma (breast) in bone marrow — cohesive syncytial cluster of large non-hematopoietic cells with anisonucleosis
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這團黏聚大細胞，問「是造血細胞嗎？」答：否，是非造血的轉移性癌細胞團；需與 osteoblast、osteoclast、巨核細胞區分。
IHC 確認：cytokeratin（AE1/AE3）陽性、CD45 陰性；乳癌來源支持標記為 GATA3、ER、mammaglobin。
乳癌 lobular 型常以單個細胞散布（可呈 signet-ring）且 E-cadherin 陰性，在骨髓中容易漏看，切片 cytokeratin 染色有助偵測。
骨髓轉移常見血液線索：leukoerythroblastic picture（有核紅血球與未成熟顆粒球）與 teardrop cells；抽吸可能 dry tap，應同時做切片。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為 osteoblast 群；osteoblast 核一致、偏心、Golgi 區離核，癌細胞則核大小不一、有切迹或腎形、呈合胞體樣黏聚，且 cytokeratin 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中黏聚成團的大細胞最可能是什麼？周邊血常出現哪一種組合變化提示骨髓浸潤？
quiz.a: 轉移性癌（乳癌）；leukoerythroblastic picture（有核紅血球、未成熟顆粒球，常伴 teardrop cells）

61200.recognize_zh: 中央一顆幾乎與紅血球同大的圓形血小板，內含粗大紫紅色顆粒、邊緣淡染，旁邊另有數顆正常大小的小血小板可對照，屬於巨大血小板，符合 Bernard-Soulier 症候群。
features: Giant platelet with a diameter nearly equal to adjacent red cells
Coarse purple-red granules distributed throughout, with a finely fringed pale periphery
Several normal-sized small platelets nearby for comparison
Normochromic red cells, some overlapping; image is high magnification with limited resolution
61200.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a giant platelet approximately equal in size to the neighboring red cells, containing coarse granules and a pale fringed periphery. Several normal-sized platelets are present nearby, and the red cells are normochromic. Findings indicate macrothrombocytes and, in the setting of thrombocytopenia, are consistent with Bernard-Soulier syndrome; confirmation with ristocetin-induced aggregation and platelet GPIb-IX flow cytometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: MYH9 disorders show Dohle-like inclusions in neutrophils and normal ristocetin aggregation.
ITP shows only mildly enlarged platelets and normal GPIb-IX expression.
Gray platelets are large but agranular and pale grey, unlike this granular giant platelet.

exam.answer_en: Bernard-Soulier syndrome — giant platelet nearly equal to red cell size with coarse granules, beside normal-sized platelets
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指中央這顆與紅血球同大的顆粒性結構，問「是否為血小板？大小代表什麼？」→ giant platelet，搭配慢性血小板低與出血傾向，考 BSS。
鑑別巨大血小板的三個觀察點：中性球是否有 Döhle-like inclusion（MYH9）、血小板顆粒是否缺乏（gray platelet syndrome）、紅血球是否異常。
BSS 的 ristocetin 聚集缺失無法以正常血漿矯正，這點與 von Willebrand disease（缺的是血漿 vWF，可矯正）區分。
處置：避免 aspirin/NSAIDs；出血時輸血小板（反覆輸注可能產生同種抗體）、tranexamic acid、desmopressin；不應以脾切除治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤診為 ITP：ITP 為後天、血小板僅輕度變大且大小不一、GPIb-IX 正常；BSS 自幼即有、血小板多接近紅血球大小，ristocetin 聚集缺失。

quiz.q: BSS 與 von Willebrand disease 都有 ristocetin 聚集異常，加入正常血漿後結果有何不同？
quiz.a: vWD 可被矯正（缺血漿 vWF）；BSS 無法矯正（缺血小板 GPIb-IX-V）

61136.recognize_zh: 九格合成圖：H&E 為瀰漫、單一的小至中型不規則核淋巴細胞；腫瘤細胞 CD20+、CD5+，且 CD3 大量陽性、CD3/CD20 雙染共表現，CD2 僅少數陽性；SOX11 核陽性但 cyclin D1 陰性（僅散在內部對照），即 cyclin D1 陰性、帶異常 CD3 的被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Panel A-B (H&E): effaced lymph node with a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with irregular, angulated nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Panel C-D: tumor cells diffusely positive for CD20 and CD5
Panel E-F: extensive CD3 staining, with CD3/CD20 double stain showing coexpression on the same neoplastic cells
Panel G: CD2 marks only scattered reactive T cells, supporting aberrant isolated CD3 expression
Panel H-I: diffuse nuclear SOX11 positivity; cyclin D1 negative in tumor cells with scattered positive internal control cells
61136.describe_en: Composite figure of a lymph node biopsy. H&E sections show architectural effacement by a diffuse, monotonous population of small to medium lymphoid cells with irregular nuclear contours and scant cytoplasm. Immunostains show the neoplastic cells to be CD20-positive and CD5-positive with aberrant CD3 expression, confirmed by CD3/CD20 double staining, while CD2 highlights only scattered background T cells. Tumor nuclei are SOX11-positive and cyclin D1-negative, with appropriate internal control staining. Findings are consistent with cyclin D1-negative mantle cell lymphoma with aberrant CD3 expression; CCND2/CCND3 rearrangement studies may provide further support.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL has round nuclei with proliferation centers and is CD23/LEF1-positive and SOX11-negative.
PTCL lacks CD20 coexpression and shows loss of other pan-T antigens with T-cell receptor clonality rather than B-cell clonality.
Classic MCL shows nuclear cyclin D1 and t(11;14) CCND1 rearrangement, both absent here.
MZL cells have more cytoplasm, monocytoid or plasmacytoid features and are usually CD5-negative and SOX11-negative.

61136.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, CD5, CD3, CD2, SOX11, cyclin D1

61072.recognize_zh: 數個紅血球內佈滿粗大、分布均勻的深藍紫色顆粒（粗嗜鹼性點彩，coarse basophilic stippling），其餘紅血球大致正常大小，是鉛中毒時核糖體 RNA 未被分解的典型表現。
features: Scattered red cells with numerous coarse, evenly distributed blue-purple punctate inclusions (coarse basophilic stippling)
Stippled cells are of normal to slightly small size
Background red cells largely normocytic with central pallor; occasional target cells and a few crenated cells
Adequate platelets scattered in the field
No leukocytes in the field
61072.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with coarse, evenly distributed basophilic stippling in several cells within a single field. The remaining red cells are predominantly normocytic with preserved central pallor, with occasional target cells and crenated cells. Platelets are present and appear adequate. Findings are consistent with coarse basophilic stippling, which in the appropriate clinical setting is suggestive of lead poisoning; confirmation requires blood lead level measurement.

ddx.vs: Thalassemia shows stippling with marked microcytosis, hypochromia and many target cells, and normal blood lead.
Morphology is similar; this inherited hemolytic anemia is confirmed by low enzyme activity with normal lead levels.
Pappenheimer bodies are fewer, clustered at the cell periphery and stain with Prussian blue, unlike diffuse evenly spaced stippling.
Precipitate lies on top of and between cells and varies in focal plane, rather than being confined within specific red cells.

exam.answer_en: Coarse basophilic stippling — aggregated ribosomal RNA in red cells, suggestive of lead poisoning
pearls_zh: 考法：指紅血球內均勻分布的藍紫色點問名稱，追問機轉：鉛抑制 pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase，核糖體 RNA 無法分解而聚集。
鉛也抑制 ALA dehydratase 與 ferrochelatase，造成 zinc protoporphyrin 上升、小球性貧血，骨髓可見 ring sideroblasts。
確診靠 blood lead level；臨床可有腹絞痛、周邊運動神經病變（wrist drop）、牙齦鉛線，兒童影響神經發展。
其他粗點彩原因：thalassemia、先天 P5'N 缺乏、megaloblastic anemia、MDS。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Pappenheimer bodies 混淆；Pappenheimer 顆粒少、聚集於周邊且 Prussian blue 陽性，basophilic stippling 則均勻散布全細胞、鐵染色陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球內的藍色小點叫什麼？鉛中毒時主要是抑制哪個酵素所致？
quiz.a: Basophilic stippling；pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase

61008.recognize_zh: 低倍血片白血球顯著增加且左移（大量骨髓球、後骨髓球、帶狀核）；右下插圖上方細胞質充滿粗大深紫顆粒（毒性顆粒或粗顆粒前驅細胞），下方嗜中性球細胞質淡而幾乎無顆粒、核分葉不足，呈發育不良（dysgranulopoiesis），支持 aCML。
features: Marked neutrophilic leukocytosis with numerous immature granulocytes (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands)
Inset (upper): granulocyte with abundant coarse dark purple cytoplasmic granules and indented nucleus (toxic-type granulation)
Inset (lower): neutrophil with pale, nearly agranular cytoplasm and hyposegmented, clumped nucleus (dysplastic)
No conspicuous basophilia or monocytosis in the low-power field
Normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
61008.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with a left-shifted granulocytic series including myelocytes, metamyelocytes, band forms and segmented neutrophils. The high-power inset shows a granulocyte with coarse, dark cytoplasmic granulation resembling toxic granulation and a neutrophil with hypogranular pale cytoplasm and a hyposegmented nucleus, indicating dysgranulopoiesis. Basophils and monocytes are not conspicuously increased, and red cells are unremarkable. In a BCR::ABL1-negative patient, the combination of neutrophilic leukocytosis, circulating immature granulocytes and dysgranulopoiesis is consistent with atypical CML (MDS/MPN with neutrophilia).

ddx.vs: Reactive neutrophilia shows toxic granulation and Döhle bodies but not hypogranular, hyposegmented (pseudo-Pelger) neutrophils.
CML has basophilia and a myelocyte peak without dysplasia, and BCR::ABL1 is present.
CNL shows mature neutrophils often with toxic granulation, but immature granulocytes are <10% and dysgranulopoiesis is absent.
MDS shares dysgranulopoiesis but typically presents with cytopenias rather than marked leukocytosis.

60944.recognize_zh: 血片中除了一顆偏心核、細胞質嗜鹼性的漿細胞外，箭頭指出多個血紅素被擠到細胞一側、另一側呈透明空泡狀的水泡細胞/偏心紅血球（blister cells、eccentrocytes），提示 G6PD 缺乏症的氧化性溶血。
features: Circulating plasma cell with round eccentric nucleus, clumped chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
Multiple eccentrocytes/blister cells: hemoglobin condensed to one side with a clear, membrane-bound crescent on the other (arrows)
Some hemighost-like cells with only a thin rim of membrane on the pale side
Scattered spherocyte-like dense cells and occasional target-like cells
Other red cells normochromic with central pallor
60944.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. Numerous red cells show hemoglobin retracted to one side, leaving a clear crescent bounded by membrane (blister cells, eccentrocytes and hemighosts), along with occasional dense spherocytic forms. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia accompanied by oxidative hemolysis, suggestive of glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency; a G6PD assay (preferably after the hemolytic episode) and Heinz body preparation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are few, polyclonal and not accompanied by marrow clonal plasma cells or paraprotein.
These have less eccentric nuclei and less abundant cytoplasm and express CD19/CD20 with IgM paraprotein rather than CD138.
Spherocytes are uniformly dense without the eccentric clear blister area typical of oxidant injury.

ddx.dx: Unstable hemoglobinopathy or drug-induced oxidant hemolysis with normal G6PD
ddx.vs: Morphology is similar, so separation relies on G6PD activity assay and hemoglobin stability testing.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell leukemia with oxidative hemolysis — circulating plasma cells plus blister cells/eccentrocytes suggesting G6PD deficiency
pearls_zh: 考法：本圖要你指出兩個重點：偏心核、嗜鹼性細胞質的循環漿細胞（→ plasma cell leukemia），以及血紅素擠向一側的 blister cell/eccentrocyte（→ 氧化性溶血）。
PCL 定義：IMWG 2021 與 WHO 5th 已將門檻降為周邊血克隆漿細胞 ≥5%；預後差，需做 flow 確認克隆性與 FISH 細胞遺傳學（PCL 常見 t(11;14)，並評估 del(17p)、1q gain 等高風險異常）。
G6PD 缺乏為 X-linked，台灣有新生兒篩檢；急性溶血期網狀紅血球多，G6PD 活性可假性正常，宜於恢復後複驗或做定量。Heinz body 需 supravital 染色。
氧化性藥物需注意：rasburicase、primaquine、dapsone、methylene blue；治療 PCL 使用 rasburicase 預防腫瘤溶解前應先確認 G6PD。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 blister cell/eccentrocyte 誤認為 spherocyte 或推片假影：eccentrocyte 一側有被膜包住的透明新月區、血紅素偏向對側；spherocyte 則是小而緻密且無中央淡染區，全細胞均勻。

quiz.q: 圖中箭頭所指、血紅素偏向一側並留下透明區的紅血球叫什麼？它提示哪種酵素缺乏？在血液腫瘤治療中哪個預防腫瘤溶解的藥物必須先篩檢？
quiz.a: Blister cell/eccentrocyte；G6PD deficiency；rasburicase

60880.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一條水平走向、內襯扁平內皮細胞的小動脈，其兩側緊貼一至數層核卵圓、胞質淡紅的早期顆粒球前驅細胞，較成熟的中性球與紅系細胞則分布在較遠處，示範正常的血管旁（periarteriolar）顆粒球生成位置。
features: Small arteriole with thin pink wall and flattened endothelial nuclei coursing horizontally across the field
Perivascular cuff of immature granulocytic precursors with oval to indented nuclei, fine chromatin and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Maturing neutrophils, eosinophil precursors with bright orange-red granules, and erythroid clusters with small dark round nuclei located away from the vessel
Macrophages containing golden-brown pigment and phagocytosed debris
Normocellular marrow with interspersed adipocytes; no clusters of blasts in central marrow
60880.describe_en: Hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow biopsy at intermediate power shows normocellular trilineage hematopoiesis. A small arteriole courses horizontally through the field and is cuffed by immature granulocytic precursors with oval nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, while more mature neutrophils, eosinophilic precursors and erythroid islands are located farther from the vessel. Scattered macrophages contain golden-brown pigment consistent with hemosiderin. No abnormal clusters of immature cells, fibrosis or infiltrate are identified. Findings illustrate the normal periarteriolar localization of granulocytic precursors.

ddx.dx: Abnormal localization of immature precursors (ALIP) in myelodysplastic neoplasm
ddx.vs: ALIP refers to clusters of myeloblasts/promyelocytes in central intertrabecular marrow away from both trabeculae and arterioles, whereas these precursors hug the vessel wall.
Lymphoma cells would be a monotonous atypical population filling or cuffing vessels without admixed eosinophilic granulocytic maturation.
Mast cell aggregates are often perivascular or paratrabecular but consist of spindled cells with clear to pale cytoplasm, admixed eosinophils and fibrosis, and are CD117/tryptase/CD25 positive.

60816.recognize_zh: CD30 染色中，右側大量大型細胞呈強的膜狀與核旁 Golgi 點狀陽性，左側則多為陰性小淋巴球；在 EBV 陽性黏膜皮膚潰瘍（EBVMCU）中，這群 CD30 陽性的何杰金樣大細胞是典型表現。
features: Numerous large cells with strong membranous and paranuclear Golgi-pattern CD30 staining
Positive cells concentrated in a dense zone (right) with scattered positive cells toward the left
Background small lymphocytes and endothelial/stromal cells negative
Positive cells vary in size, including large immunoblast- and Hodgkin-like forms
60816.describe_en: CD30 immunohistochemistry shows strong membranous and Golgi-pattern staining in a significant subset of large atypical cells, which are densely aggregated in one area and scattered elsewhere, while background small lymphocytes are negative. The positive cells range from immunoblast-like to Hodgkin-like large forms. In the appropriate context of a sharply circumscribed mucosal or cutaneous ulcer in an immunosuppressed patient with EBER-positive cells, this pattern is consistent with EBV-positive mucocutaneous ulcer.

ddx.vs: cHL forms a mass or nodal disease rather than a circumscribed ulcer, and HRS cells typically lose B-cell markers, whereas EBVMCU large cells retain CD20/Oct-2 and are polymorphic.
EBV+ DLBCL forms destructive masses of sheets of large cells beyond a limited ulcer and does not regress with reduction of immunosuppression.
ALCL shows uniform strong CD30 in nearly all tumor cells with a T-cell or null phenotype and is EBV-negative.
These cutaneous CD30+ proliferations are T-cell derived (CD4+) and EBER-negative.

60752.recognize_zh: A 圖一群細胞的細胞質與核上覆蓋大量粗大深紫黑色嗜鹼性顆粒，核形不規則、部分像是顆粒脫落的不成熟嗜鹼性球；B 圖骨髓抹片有許多芽細胞、含顆粒的嗜鹼性前驅細胞，以及多核分離的異常細胞，提示伴嗜鹼性分化的骨髓分化不良相關 AML。
features: Panel A: cluster of large immature cells with abundant cytoplasm studded with coarse dark purple-black basophilic granules overlying the nuclei, some with partial degranulation
Panel A: irregular, folded to lobulated nuclei with open chromatin
Panel B: marrow aspirate with numerous blasts showing fine chromatin, variable basophilic cytoplasm and occasional fine granules
Panel B: a cell packed with coarse dark granules (immature basophil) among the blasts
Panel B: dysplastic cell with multiple separated round nuclei (lower left) and a background of cytolysis/stain debris
60752.describe_en: Composite of smears shows a cluster of large immature cells with irregular folded nuclei and abundant cytoplasm containing coarse, dark purple-black basophilic granules that overlie the nuclei (A). The bone marrow aspirate (B) shows increased blasts with fine chromatin and variable basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with immature basophils with coarse granules and a dysplastic cell with multiple separated nuclei. Blast percentage and multilineage dysplasia cannot be accurately quantified from these fields. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes showing prominent basophilic differentiation, pending cytogenetic/molecular correlation and exclusion of BCR::ABL1.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia in blast phase
ddx.vs: Also shows blasts with marked basophilia, but is defined by BCR::ABL1/Philadelphia chromosome, which must be excluded.
Is a primary AML with predominant basophilic blasts without myelodysplasia-related cytogenetic/molecular changes or antecedent MDS.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with associated myeloid neoplasm
ddx.vs: Mast cells are spindled or oval with granules, express CD117/tryptase with CD25/CD2 and KIT D816V, whereas basophils are CD123+/CD203c+ and tryptase-weak.
Frequently shows basophilia with multilineage dysplasia, so karyotype is required to separate it from AML-MR.

60624.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆體積遠大於周邊細胞的巨大細胞，核呈多葉狀、胞質充滿紫紅色異染顆粒（metachromatic granules），免疫染色 CD117、CD25 與 tryptase 皆陽性，確認為巨大多葉肥大細胞（promastocyte）。
features: Giant cell many times the size of adjacent myeloid cells with multilobated/multiple overlapping nuclei
Abundant cytoplasm densely packed with purple-red metachromatic granules that spill into the surrounding background
Background marrow with dysplastic features including hypolobated/abnormally segmented neutrophils, blasts and immature myeloid cells
Immunostains: giant cell positive for CD117 and CD25 (red chromogen) and tryptase (brown)
Nuclear detail partly obscured by granules
60624.describe_en: The bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant cell with multilobated nuclei and abundant cytoplasm filled with coarse metachromatic granules, with granules scattered in the adjacent background. Surrounding hematopoietic cells include immature myeloid forms and granulocytes with abnormal nuclear segmentation. Immunocytochemistry shows the giant cell to be positive for CD117, CD25 and tryptase. Findings are consistent with giant multilobated atypical mast cells (promastocytes) in the setting of acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes; evaluation for an associated systemic mastocytosis (KIT D816V) is warranted.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have fine pink granules with platelet budding and are CD61/CD42b-positive but tryptase- and CD25-negative.
Basophils are smaller with water-soluble dark granules obscuring a lobated nucleus, and are tryptase-weak and CD117-negative.
Osteoclasts have many separate uniform nuclei and agranular or finely granular cytoplasm without tryptase positivity.
Mast cell leukemia requires ≥20% atypical mast cells on aspirate rather than isolated giant mast cells within an AML.

60688.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片骨小樑之間的造血組織被成片的上皮性腫瘤取代，細胞排列成小而密集的腺泡與篩孔樣（cribriform）結構，周圍伴隨纖維化間質，是轉移性攝護腺腺癌侵犯骨髓造成類 TTP 的微血管病變性溶血。
features: Marrow space between bony trabeculae replaced by cohesive nests of epithelial tumor cells
Tumor cells forming numerous small, crowded glands and cribriform/fused acinar structures
Uniform small to medium nuclei with relatively monotonous appearance at this magnification; nucleoli not resolvable
Surrounding desmoplastic, edematous fibrous stroma with loss of normal hematopoiesis and fat
Adjacent bone trabeculae without obvious osteoblastic rimming visible in this field
60688.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E) shows replacement of the intertrabecular marrow space by cohesive nests of epithelial cells arranged in crowded small glands and cribriform structures, set within a desmoplastic fibrous stroma. Normal hematopoietic elements and marrow fat are largely absent in the involved areas. Nuclear detail such as prominent nucleoli is not resolvable at this magnification. Findings are consistent with metastatic adenocarcinoma, and in the clinical context of prostate cancer (confirmed by NKX3.1/PSA immunostaining) with marrow infiltration, this explains a microangiopathic picture that can mimic thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura.

ddx.dx: Metastatic adenocarcinoma of other origin (e.g., colorectal, breast, lung)
ddx.vs: Glandular metastases look similar on H&E; site is assigned by immunohistochemistry (NKX3.1, PSA, PSAP for prostate versus CDX2, GATA3, TTF-1).
Neuroendocrine carcinoma forms solid sheets of small cells with nuclear molding and crush artifact rather than well-formed glands and cribriform structures.
TTP marrow lacks tumor and may show microthrombi only; severe ADAMTS13 deficiency (<10%) confirms TTP, whereas marrow carcinoma causes MAHA with normal ADAMTS13.
Lymphoma infiltrates are discohesive lymphoid cells without gland formation and are CD45 positive, keratin negative.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic prostatic adenocarcinoma in bone marrow — gland-forming epithelial nests in desmoplastic stroma replacing marrow, cause of TTP-like MAHA
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指骨髓切片內成巢、形成小腺體/cribriform 的上皮細胞，問「這是造血細胞嗎？」→ 非造血，轉移性腺癌。
骨髓轉移癌可造成 microangiopathic hemolytic anemia 與血小板低下而像 TTP；ADAMTS13 活性通常未嚴重缺乏（TTP 為 <10%），血漿置換效果差。
線索：周邊血 leukoerythroblastic picture（nRBC 與幼稚顆粒球）、ALP 升高；前列腺癌也常合併慢性 DIC。
IHC：keratin 陽性確認上皮來源，NKX3.1、PSA、PSAP 支持前列腺來源。
exam.pitfall_zh: 臨床最常誤判為 TTP 而只做血漿置換：若有 leukoerythroblastic 血液像、ADAMTS13 未嚴重缺乏或已知惡性腫瘤，應做骨髓切片找轉移癌。

quiz.q: 圖中骨髓內形成腺體的細胞巢是什麼？哪兩個 IHC 可支持前列腺來源？
quiz.a: 轉移性前列腺腺癌；NKX3.1 與 PSA（或 PSAP）

60560.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的紅血球略帶藍灰色（多染性），細胞質內有一條細長、沿著細胞邊緣內側繞行的紫色環狀細線，這就是 Cabot 環（Cabot ring）；周邊另可見一個淚滴狀紅血球。
features: Single slightly polychromatic red cell (arrow) containing a thin, reddish-violet, circular ring lying just inside the cell membrane
Ring is threadlike and continuous, without a central dot or granular beading
Background red cells are mostly normochromic with little central pallor; mild anisocytosis
Occasional poikilocyte including a teardrop cell (lower right)
No Howell-Jolly body or leukocytes in this field
60560.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows red cells with mild anisocytosis and occasional poikilocytes, including a teardrop cell. One slightly polychromatic red cell contains a thin, circular, violet-staining ring inclusion paralleling the cell membrane, characteristic of a Cabot ring. No Howell-Jolly body, parasites, or nucleated red cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with a Cabot ring, a marker of disordered or stressed erythropoiesis such as severe hemolytic or megaloblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: A malaria ring trophozoite is small (about one-third of the cell) with a discrete blue cytoplasmic ring and a red chromatin dot, whereas a Cabot ring is a thin, dot-less thread tracing the full cell periphery.
Babesia forms are small intraerythrocytic rings or tetrads with chromatin dots and no pigment, not a single membrane-hugging thread.
Drying artifact is refractile and changes with focus, while a Cabot ring stains violet and remains in focus as a true inclusion.

exam.answer_en: Cabot ring — thin circular violet ring paralleling the membrane of a polychromatic red cell, indicating stressed erythropoiesis
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍下只有一顆紅血球內有沿膜走行的細圓環，考官問「這是寄生蟲嗎？」→ 不是，是 Cabot ring。
Cabot ring 出現在年輕、多染性紅血球，反映骨髓造血加速或無效造血；嚴重 megaloblastic anemia 最典型。
同一視野的 teardrop cell 提示可能有骨髓浸潤、骨髓纖維化或 megaloblastic/thalassemia 等造血異常，應一併描述。
若病人有旅遊史仍須做 thick/thin smear 排除瘧疾，不能只憑單一環狀構造下結論。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為乾燥造成的折光假影：假影在調焦時會發亮變化、大小不一且常見於多顆細胞；Cabot ring 為染色的紫色細線，僅見於少數多染性紅血球。

quiz.q: 圖中沿紅血球膜走行的紫色細環稱為什麼？最典型出現在哪種貧血？
quiz.a: Cabot ring；megaloblastic anemia（亦見於嚴重溶血性貧血）

60432.recognize_zh: 低倍 H&E 中央可見一個大而圓、周圍有深藍色小淋巴球環繞的結節，結節內部則被許多不規則淡粉紅色區塊（組織球與 LP 細胞）打散成斑駁的「蛀蝕狀（moth-eaten）」外觀，周圍還有其他類似結節，指向 NLPHL。
features: Lymph node with architecture replaced by large, vaguely circumscribed macronodules
Central macronodule with a peripheral rim of dark small lymphocytes and a mottled interior
Irregular pale eosinophilic patches within the nodules (histiocytes and scattered large cells) producing a moth-eaten pattern
Similar vague nodules at the top and periphery; scattered small vessels between nodules
No sclerosis or necrosis; individual LP cells not resolvable at this magnification
60432.describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows replacement of the normal architecture by large, vaguely circumscribed nodules. The central macronodule is outlined by a dark rim of small lymphocytes and its interior is broken up by numerous irregular pale areas, imparting a moth-eaten appearance; similar nodules are present at the periphery. There is no fibrosis, necrosis or normal follicular pattern. Cytologic confirmation of LP cells requires high power and immunostains, but this macronodular moth-eaten pattern is suggestive of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: PTGC nodules are large but few, set among reactive follicles, and lack LP cells and extensive histiocyte-rich pale patches.
FL follicles are smaller, more uniform and back-to-back without the mottled internal histiocytic pattern, and are CD10/BCL2-positive.
Nodular LRCHL can mimic this pattern and requires immunostains showing CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells with weak OCT2/BOB1 for distinction.

60368.recognize_zh: 抹片上一群大小一致、互相擠壓成團的母細胞，核圓、染色質細緻均勻、細胞質少且偏嗜鹼性，沒有顆粒或 Auer rod，背景幾乎看不到成熟造血細胞，符合淋巴母細胞（lymphoblast）浸潤骨髓。
features: Sheets and cohesive-appearing clusters of monotonous small-to-intermediate blasts (roughly 1.5-2x a red cell)
High N:C ratio with scant to moderate pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Round to slightly molded nuclei with finely dispersed, homogeneous chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
No cytoplasmic granules or Auer rods identified
Scattered smudged/disrupted cells; few recognizable maturing myeloid or erythroid precursors
60368.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows clusters and sheets of monotonous small-to-intermediate blasts that crowd out normal hematopoietic elements. The blasts have a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, round to slightly molded nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant pale basophilic agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are seen, and several smudged cells are present. Morphology alone cannot assign lineage; in conjunction with immunophenotyping (CD19+, CD10+, CD79a+, TdT+, CD34-), findings are consistent with B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Myeloblasts can look identical and agranular, so lineage requires flow cytometry (CD13/CD33/CD117, MPO) rather than morphology.
Morphologically indistinguishable; T-ALL expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and lacks CD19/CD79a on immunophenotyping.
Hematogones rarely form sheets, show a spectrum of maturation (CD34/TdT to CD20) on flow, and do not efface the marrow.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and are TdT-negative with surface light chain expression.

exam.answer_en: B-lymphoblastic leukemia (CD34-negative) — sheets of monotonous agranular lymphoblasts; lineage proven by CD19+/CD10+/cCD79a+/TdT+ flow despite absent CD34
pearls_zh: 考法：看到無顆粒、無 Auer rod 的單一芽細胞群，要回答「形態無法定 lineage，需 flow」；CD34 陰性不能排除 blast，TdT 陽性仍支持 precursor lymphoid neoplasm。
CD34 陰性的 B-ALL 要想到 TCF3::PBX1［t(1;19)］：典型表型為 CD10+、CD19+、cytoplasmic μ 陽性、CD34 陰性或弱；需以 FISH/RT-PCR 確認。
KMT2A 重排 B-ALL（常見於嬰兒）典型為 CD10 陰性、常帶 CD15 等 myeloid 標記，屬高風險；與 CD10+ 的 TCF3::PBX1 形成對比考點。
B-ALL 必做風險分層：BCR::ABL1、KMT2A、ETV6::RUNX1、hyperdiploidy/hypodiploidy 等遺傳分群，加上治療後 MRD，決定治療強度。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 AML（尤其 minimal differentiation）或 Burkitt；AML 需 MPO/myeloid 抗原陽性，Burkitt 細胞質深藍帶 lipid vacuoles、TdT 陰性且表現 surface light chain，本圖 blast 胞質淡藍無空泡。

quiz.q: 這群芽細胞 flow 顯示 CD19+、CD10+、TdT+ 但 CD34 陰性，最應優先排除哪一個重現性遺傳異常？
quiz.a: t(1;19)(q23;p13) TCF3::PBX1（典型 CD34 陰性、cytoplasmic μ 陽性）。

60176.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的顆粒球前驅細胞（前骨髓細胞、骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀核）成熟有序、顆粒充足、核型正常，看不到明顯發育異常或母細胞增加，說明此病例的發育異常只侷限於其他系列（單系發育異常）。
features: Orderly maturing granulocytic precursors: promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band forms
Normal abundant azurophilic/specific granulation of the cytoplasm
Normal nuclear shapes for maturation stage; no pseudo-Pelger or hypogranular forms
No blasts identified in this field
Single small dark cell consistent with a lymphocyte or late erythroblast
60176.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing neutrophil precursors, including promyelocytes, myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band forms, with normal granulation and appropriate nuclear maturation. Significant dysgranulopoiesis such as hypogranulation or pseudo-Pelger-Huët nuclei is not present, and blasts are not increased in this field. This image documents the absence of granulocytic dysplasia, which in context supports myelodysplastic syndrome with single-lineage dysplasia involving another lineage.

ddx.vs: Distinguishing requires ≥10% dysplastic cells in the affected lineage, persistent cytopenia and exclusion of reactive causes, not granulocytic morphology alone.
MLD requires ≥10% dysplastic cells in two or more lineages, whereas granulocytes here lack dysplasia.
MDS-EB requires ≥5% marrow blasts, while blasts here are <5%.

60112.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD61 免疫染色中，大量棕色陽性細胞密集散佈，從大型巨核細胞到許多小型單核的陽性細胞（小巨核細胞或巨核母細胞）都有，並伴隨陽性碎片，顯示巨核細胞系明顯增生。
features: Numerous CD61-positive cells diffusely distributed throughout the marrow
Wide size range: occasional large megakaryocytes and many small mononuclear positive cells
Small positive cells likely represent micromegakaryocytes and megakaryoblasts
Abundant CD61-positive cytoplasmic fragments and platelet debris
Background CD61-negative hematopoietic cells with blue hematoxylin counterstain
60112.describe_en: CD61 immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow trephine highlights a marked increase in megakaryocytic lineage cells distributed throughout the marrow. Positive cells range from occasional large megakaryocytes to many small mononuclear forms, consistent with micromegakaryocytes and megakaryoblasts, with abundant positive cytoplasmic fragments. The stain confirms megakaryocytic lineage expansion, which in a child with Down syndrome supports myeloid leukemia associated with Down syndrome (acute megakaryoblastic type).

ddx.vs: TAM shares CD61-positive megakaryoblasts and GATA1 mutation but presents in the neonatal period and often regresses.
Reactive hyperplasia consists of mature, normally sized megakaryocytes without numerous small mononuclear CD61-positive blasts.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma)
ddx.vs: Cohesive tumor cells in neuroblastoma are CD61 negative, while megakaryoblasts express CD61/CD41.

25360.recognize_zh: 血片中大量中大型、胞質深嗜鹼性的異常淋巴細胞，組織切片呈片狀中大型細胞並見分裂象；FISH 分別顯示 MYC 斷裂分離與 MYC/IGH 融合、IGH/BCL2 融合及 BCL6 斷裂，證實為 MYC、BCL2、BCL6 三重重排的高惡性度 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Blood/aspirate smear with numerous medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Tissue H&E with diffuse sheets of medium-to-large cells with vesicular nuclei, small nucleoli and mitotic figures
FISH: MYC break-apart probe showing split orange and green signals
FISH: MYC/IGH dual-fusion and IGH/BCL2 dual-fusion probes showing fusion signals (arrows)
FISH: BCL6 break-apart probe showing split signals
25360.describe_en: Peripheral smear shows a leukemic population of medium-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratios, finely dispersed chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The tissue section shows a diffuse infiltrate of medium-to-large cells with vesicular nuclei, small nucleoli and frequent mitoses. Interphase FISH demonstrates MYC rearrangement (break-apart split and MYC::IGH fusion), IGH::BCL2 fusion and BCL6 rearrangement. In a patient with prior follicular lymphoma, findings are consistent with transformation to high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC, BCL2 and BCL6 rearrangements (triple-hit), presenting in leukemic phase.

ddx.vs: Burkitt shows MYC rearrangement without BCL2 rearrangement and uniformly vacuolated medium-sized cells; FISH for BCL2 separates them.
Lymphoblasts are TdT positive and surface immunoglobulin negative, whereas this lymphoma is TdT negative mature B-cell with BCL2 rearrangement.
Morphology may overlap, and only FISH absence of concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangement defines DLBCL NOS.
Blastoid MCL is cyclin D1/SOX11 positive with t(11;14) rather than MYC/BCL2 rearrangements.

16976.recognize_zh: 視野中血小板稀少，唯一的一顆血小板體積大（約紅血球直徑的一半以上）、顆粒明顯，紅血球形態正常；血小板低下合併巨大血小板，放在 Bernard-Soulier 症候群脈絡下即為其特徵性的巨血小板。
features: Single large granular platelet at upper left, roughly half to two-thirds the diameter of adjacent RBCs
Platelet shows central purple granulomere with paler hyalomere
Marked scarcity of platelets elsewhere in the field
Red cells normocytic and normochromic without poikilocytosis or schistocytes
No leukocytes in view to assess for Dohle-like inclusions
16976.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows decreased platelets, with a single enlarged platelet measuring roughly half to two-thirds the diameter of a red cell and containing a distinct central granulomere. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without fragmentation. No leukocytes are present in this field to evaluate for neutrophil inclusions. Findings are consistent with macrothrombocytopenia, compatible with Bernard-Soulier syndrome in the appropriate clinical context; confirmation requires absent ristocetin-induced aggregation not corrected by normal plasma and reduced GPIb-IX-V by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: ITP platelets are variably large but not uniformly giant, the disorder is acquired, and ristocetin aggregation and GPIb expression are normal.
MYH9 disorders show giant platelets with blue Dohle-like inclusions in neutrophils and normal ristocetin aggregation.
Gray platelets are large but pale grey and agranular due to absent alpha granules, unlike the granular platelet here.
Glanzmann thrombasthenia has normal platelet count and size, with absent aggregation to all agonists except ristocetin.

exam.answer_en: Bernard-Soulier syndrome — macrothrombocytopenia with a giant granular platelet approaching red cell size
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著接近紅血球大小的血小板問「巨大血小板＋出血傾向要做哪個檢查？」答：platelet aggregation 顯示 ristocetin 聚集缺失，其他 agonist 正常。
BSS 為 GPIb-IX-V 複合體（vWF 受體）缺陷，基因為 GP1BA、GP1BB 或 GP9，典型為體染色體隱性；flow 可見 CD42a/CD42b 表現降低。
Ristocetin 聚集缺失加入正常血漿後「不矯正」→BSS；可被矯正則指向 von Willebrand disease。
自動計數器常把巨大血小板計為紅血球而低估血小板數；多次輸注血小板後可產生抗 GPIb 抗體，嚴重出血時可考慮 rFVIIa。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤診為慢性 ITP 而接受類固醇或脾切除；BSS 血小板普遍巨大、自幼發病並有 ristocetin 聚集缺失，ITP 則 GPIb 表現與聚集正常。

quiz.q: 圖中巨大血小板若病人自幼出血，哪一種血小板聚集劑的反應會缺失？缺陷的是哪個糖蛋白？
quiz.a: Ristocetin；GPIb-IX-V（CD42）

16272.recognize_zh: 照片呈現移植後皮膚硬化型慢性 GVHD 的多種表現：斑駁的色素沉著與脫失、腹部發亮緊繃的硬皮、前臂皮下凹凸不平的波紋狀（筋膜炎）、雙手無法合掌的「祈禱徵」，以及小腿足部硬化合併潰瘍。
features: Panel A: mottled hyper- and hypopigmented patches with lichen sclerosus-like texture on the upper arm
Panel B: dyspigmented, shiny, bound-down skin of both forearms and hands
Panel C: erythematous, taut, glossy indurated plaques over the abdomen
Panel D: rippled, cobblestone/'cellulite-like' surface of the forearm indicating deep fascial involvement
Panel E: positive prayer sign with inability to fully oppose the palms due to joint contracture
Panel F: sclerotic, hyperpigmented lower leg and foot with erosions, crusts and ulceration
16272.describe_en: Clinical photographs show the spectrum of sclerotic-type chronic graft-versus-host disease of the skin. Superficial involvement appears as mottled dyspigmentation with lichen sclerosus-like changes (panels A–B) and taut, glossy erythematous sclerotic plaques on the abdomen (panel C). Deeper involvement is shown by a rippled, dimpled forearm contour consistent with fasciitis (panel D) and restricted joint mobility demonstrated by a positive prayer sign (panel E). Advanced disease produces sclerosis of the lower leg with erosions and ulceration (panel F). These are clinical, not histologic, images; findings are consistent with sclerotic chronic cutaneous GVHD, which meets NIH diagnostic criteria (sclerotic features, fasciitis, joint contracture).

ddx.vs: Systemic sclerosis typically begins acrally with Raynaud phenomenon, sclerodactyly and nailfold capillary changes and specific autoantibodies (Scl-70, anticentromere), without a history of allogeneic transplantation.
Morphea forms discrete indurated plaques with a lilac border in patients without transplant and lacks the widespread poikiloderma and fasciitis of GVHD.
Eosinophilic fasciitis produces a similar groove sign and peau d'orange but occurs after exertion with peripheral eosinophilia and spares the fingers and face, outside the transplant setting.
NSF follows gadolinium exposure in renal failure and involves extremities with brawny induration, sparing the face, without transplant history.

15120.recognize_zh: A 圖雙小腿皮膚發紅、緊繃發亮並有大型結痂潰瘍；B 圖胸肩部色素沉著與色素脫失交錯的斑駁外觀；C 圖手臂皮膚緊繃並見沿靜脈走向的凹溝（箭頭，groove sign）與肘關節攣縮（大箭頭），皆為硬皮病樣（sclerodermatous）慢性移植物抗宿主病的表現。
features: A: shiny, erythematous, bound-down skin of both lower legs with large crusted ulcers and scattered erosions
B: mottled hyperpigmented and hypopigmented (depigmented) patches over the upper chest and shoulders
C: taut skin of the arm with linear depressions along superficial veins (groove sign, small arrows)
C: restricted elbow extension suggesting joint contracture from fasciitis (large arrowhead)
Clinical photographs only; no histology
15120.describe_en: Composite clinical photographs of sclerotic chronic graft-versus-host disease. Panel A shows shiny, erythematous, indurated skin of both lower legs with large crusted ulcers, typical of deep sclerosis prone to breakdown. Panel B shows a mottled pattern of hyperpigmentation and depigmentation over the upper chest and shoulders. Panel C shows taut skin of the upper extremity with linear depressions along superficial veins (groove sign, arrows) and limited elbow extension (arrowhead), consistent with fasciitis and joint contracture. Sclerotic features, morphea-like lesions and fasciitis are diagnostic manifestations of chronic GVHD by NIH criteria.

ddx.vs: Systemic sclerosis typically begins with Raynaud phenomenon and acral sclerodactyly with specific autoantibodies (anti-Scl-70, anticentromere), without a history of allogeneic transplantation.
Eosinophilic fasciitis also shows the groove sign but spares hands/face, shows peripheral eosinophilia and fascial eosinophils, and occurs without transplantation.
Idiopathic morphea forms circumscribed ivory plaques with a lilac border, without extensive multifocal involvement, ulceration or other organ cGVHD features.
NSF occurs in renal failure after gadolinium exposure and involves the extremities with CD34-positive fibrocytes on biopsy.

captions: A: Sclerotic lower legs with large ulcers
B: Mottled hyper- and hypopigmentation of chest and shoulders
C: Groove sign along veins (arrows) and elbow contracture (arrowhead)

2960.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒球前驅細胞大量停在前骨髓細胞階段（大細胞、核偏位、核周淡染、細胞質有顆粒），幾乎不見分葉中性球，並有明顯嗜酸性前驅細胞與單核球，為 Kostmann 症候群典型的前骨髓細胞成熟停滯。
features: Many large promyelocytes with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof, basophilic cytoplasm, and azurophilic granules
Near absence of metamyelocytes, bands, and segmented neutrophils
Eosinophilic precursors with orange-red granules are conspicuous
Monocytes and scattered lymphocytes present
Erythroid precursors present with small dark round nuclei
Blasts are not increased; no Auer rods
2960.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with prominent promyelocytes showing eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hofs, basophilic cytoplasm, and azurophilic granules, with a striking lack of later-stage neutrophils including metamyelocytes, bands, and segmented forms. Eosinophilic precursors and monocytes are conspicuous, and erythroid precursors are present. Blasts are not increased and Auer rods are absent. Findings show granulocytic maturation arrest at the promyelocyte stage and, in a child with severe chronic neutropenia, are consistent with severe congenital neutropenia (Kostmann syndrome).

ddx.vs: APL replaces the marrow with atypical hypergranular promyelocytes with reniform or bilobed nuclei and faggot cells, carries PML::RARA, and lacks preserved erythroid and eosinophilic elements.

ddx.dx: Early marrow regeneration after neutropenic insult
ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows a synchronized promyelocyte wave that proceeds to full neutrophil maturation within days.
Cyclic neutropenia shows arrest only during the nadir with normal maturation between cycles every ~21 days, whereas SCN arrest is persistent.
Myelokathexis shows abundant hypersegmented, pyknotic mature neutrophils retained in the marrow rather than promyelocyte arrest.

exam.answer_en: Kostmann syndrome (severe congenital neutropenia) — promyelocyte maturation arrest with absent metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
pearls_zh: 考法：數一數有沒有 metamyelocyte、band、segmented neutrophil；「有前骨髓細胞卻沒有後期中性球」即 maturation arrest。
定義與臨床：出生後數月內即有極重度中性球減少（ANC 常 < 0.5×10^9/L），反覆臍炎、口腔潰瘍、肺炎與皮膚膿瘍。
與 cyclic neutropenia 區分：兩者皆可為 ELANE 變異，但 cyclic neutropenia 約每 21 天週期性下降，需一週數次連續追蹤 ANC 數週才看得出來。
與 WHIM syndrome 區分：WHIM 為 CXCR4 增益突變，骨髓中性球成熟但滯留（myelokathexis，核呈細絲相連的過度分葉），並非成熟停滯。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被當成感染或化療後骨髓「再生早期」（也以前驅細胞為主）；再生期數天內就會出現後期階段，SCN 則持續停滯並有先天病史，需重複檢查與基因檢測。

quiz.q: 這張骨髓抹片缺乏哪些階段的顆粒球？此發現的專有名詞是什麼？
quiz.a: Metamyelocyte、band 與分葉中性球；maturation arrest（promyelocyte 階段成熟停滯）

13712.recognize_zh: 上方周邊血可見三個胞質深藍、核圓的原始紅血球樣細胞；下方血液分析儀散佈圖顯示網狀紅血球區（LFR/MFR/HFR）幾乎無點、而有核紅血球（NRBC）區點數密集，代表大量未成熟紅系細胞進入血液卻無法成熟為網狀紅血球，即紅血球成熟阻斷。
features: Three circulating immature cells with round nuclei, fine to slightly clumped chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm with irregular borders, consistent with early erythroblasts
Background red cells normochromic with mild anisocytosis; no polychromatophilic cells evident
Reticulocyte scattergram (left): dense mature RBC cluster with very sparse events in the LFR, MFR and HFR reticulocyte gates
NRBC scattergram (right): large, dense NRBC population clearly separated from the white cell cluster
Discordance between abundant nucleated erythroid cells and near-absent reticulocytes
13712.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating immature cells with round nuclei and intensely basophilic cytoplasm, consistent with early erythroid precursors, against a background of normochromic red cells without polychromasia. The accompanying automated analyzer plots show a prominent nucleated red cell population in the NRBC channel, while the reticulocyte channel contains very few events in the low, medium and high fluorescence reticulocyte gates. This combination indicates release of immature erythroid cells without effective terminal maturation. In a patient with prior polycythemia vera, findings are consistent with transformation to acute erythroid leukemia with a block in red cell maturation; marrow examination with E-cadherin/CD71 immunostaining and TP53 analysis is recommended.

ddx.dx: Leukoerythroblastic reaction (marrow infiltration or post-PV myelofibrosis)
ddx.vs: Leukoerythroblastosis shows mostly late orthochromatic NRBCs with teardrop cells and left-shifted myeloid cells, and reticulocytes are usually preserved.
Megaloblastic anemia shows macro-ovalocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, and the marrow precursors mature with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony rather than arresting at the pronormoblast stage.

ddx.dx: Acute megakaryoblastic or other AML with basophilic blasts
ddx.vs: Megakaryoblasts show cytoplasmic blebs and CD41/CD61 positivity, whereas erythroid blasts are CD71, E-cadherin and glycophorin positive.

3792.recognize_zh: 左邊一顆大型組織球細胞質內包著五顆完整的有核細胞（含顆粒球前驅細胞），右邊另一顆組織球吞噬了許多圓形深染的小淋巴球大小細胞；多顆完整細胞被吞入就是噬血現象，背景有大量小淋巴球（CLL）。
features: Large histiocyte (left) containing about five intact engulfed nucleated cells within abundant pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm
Engulfed cells retain nuclear detail, including granulated myeloid precursors
Second histiocyte (right) containing numerous small round dense nuclei of lymphocyte or nucleated red cell size
Background small mature lymphocytes with condensed chromatin
Scattered granulocytic precursors with azurophilic granules
3792.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows two macrophages with active phagocytosis of intact hematopoietic cells. One contains approximately five well-preserved nucleated cells, including granulated myeloid precursors, within vacuolated cytoplasm, while the other harbors numerous small dense round nuclei consistent with lymphocytes or nucleated red cells. The background contains many small mature lymphocytes and maturing granulocytes. Findings represent hemophagocytosis; in a patient with CLL and compatible clinical criteria this supports secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Emperipolesis occurs within megakaryocytes with lobulated nuclei and granular cytoplasm, not within single-nucleated vacuolated histiocytes.
Tingible body macrophages contain fragmented apoptotic nuclear debris, not multiple intact cells with preserved nuclear and cytoplasmic detail.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes show emperipolesis of lymphocytes but are S100 positive and rarely involve marrow, without HLH laboratory criteria.
Tumor cell cannibalism occurs in atypical cohesive malignant cells, whereas these phagocytes have bland histiocytic nuclei.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis in CLL (HLH) — two histiocytes engulfing intact nucleated cells, including granulocyte precursors and lymphocyte-sized cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會分別指左、右兩顆組織球，問胞質內被吞的是哪類細胞（左：顆粒球前驅細胞；右：小淋巴球大小細胞），並問多顆「完整」細胞被吞的意義。
HLH-2004 診斷：HLH 相關基因致病變異，或 8 項中符合 ≥5 項（發燒、脾腫大、≥2 系血球低下、高三酸甘油酯/低纖維蛋白原、組織噬血現象、NK 活性低、ferritin ≥500 ng/mL、sCD25 升高）。
成人次發性 HLH 誘因以感染（尤其 EBV）、惡性腫瘤（淋巴瘤）、自體免疫（MAS）為主；CLL 病人出現 HLH 應查 EBV、其他感染，並排除 Richter transformation。
骨髓噬血現象對 HLH 既不必要也不足以單獨確診；成人可用 HScore 輔助評估。治療＝積極處理誘因＋ HLH 導向治療（dexamethasone、etoposide 為基礎）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為組織球吞噬凋亡碎屑（tingible body macrophage）或重疊細胞：噬血現象的被吞細胞形態完整、核與胞質可辨且常有透明暈，碎屑則大小不一且無完整細胞結構。

quiz.q: 左側組織球吞入的細胞屬於哪一系？背景的大量小淋巴球最可能代表什麼疾病？
quiz.a: 顆粒球前驅細胞（myeloid precursors）；CLL。

1360.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中箭頭指出數顆成熟樣淋巴球，核圓、染色質呈塊狀、細胞質淡藍；整個視野血小板極少，並可見少數淚滴狀紅血球，符合 CLL 合併血小板低下。
features: Arrowed lymphocytes with round nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin; no conspicuous nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm in the arrowed cells
An additional small mature lymphocyte with scant cytoplasm
Platelets markedly decreased, only rare small platelets seen
Mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional teardrop and elongated red cells
1360.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several lymphocytes (arrows) with round nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and moderate pale blue cytoplasm, together with a small mature lymphocyte. Platelets are markedly reduced, with only rare small forms in the field. Red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis including occasional teardrop and elongated forms. In a patient with known chronic lymphocytic leukemia, the findings are consistent with CLL-associated thrombocytopenia; immune thrombocytopenia versus marrow infiltration requires further evaluation.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes have more abundant, deeper blue cytoplasm scalloped around red cells and a heterogeneous population, with polyclonal flow cytometry.
Villous lymphocytes show polar cytoplasmic projections and are typically CD5- CD23-.
Would show platelet clumps or satellitism rather than true scarcity of platelets.
Suggested by leukoerythroblastic changes (nucleated red cells, immature myeloid cells) in addition to teardrop cells.

1936.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中顆粒球前驅細胞明顯變大，可見巨大後骨髓細胞與巨大帶狀核（giant metamyelocytes / bands），紅系前驅細胞核染色質呈細緻篩網狀、核質發育不同步（nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony），這組合是巨母細胞性貧血的典型骨髓表現。
features: Giant metamyelocytes and giant band neutrophils with large horseshoe-shaped nuclei and abundant granular cytoplasm
Enlarged erythroid precursors with finely stippled, open 'sieve-like' chromatin despite maturing cytoplasm (nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony)
Cells with deeply basophilic cytoplasm rims and large round nuclei consistent with megaloblasts
Occasional hypersegmented or abnormally lobated neutrophil forms
Hypercellular particle-rich aspirate with numerous precursors
1936.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous enlarged hematopoietic precursors. Erythroid precursors are megaloblastic, with large nuclei containing finely dispersed sieve-like chromatin that lags behind cytoplasmic maturation. Granulocytic precursors include giant metamyelocytes and giant band forms with large horseshoe-shaped nuclei. No increase in blasts is evident in this field. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic hematopoiesis, as in vitamin B12 or folate deficiency.

ddx.vs: MDS shows megaloblastoid erythroids with other dysplasia (ring sideroblasts, hypolobated micromegakaryocytes, pseudo-Pelger cells) and normal B12/folate, whereas true megaloblastic anemia corrects with vitamin replacement.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of pronormoblasts with a marked left shift, rather than megaloblastic maturation across all stages with giant bands.
Morphology is identical, so the distinction relies on medication history and normal B12/folate levels.

exam.answer_en: Megaloblastic anemia — giant metamyelocytes/bands and megaloblastic erythroid precursors with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony (marrow aspirate)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著馬蹄形大核的細胞問「這是什麼」（giant metamyelocyte / band），再問整體診斷；顆粒球系與紅系同時變大是 megaloblastic 的全系列 DNA 合成障礙證據。
機轉：B12 或 folate 缺乏使 thymidine 合成受阻，DNA 複製延遲而 RNA/血紅素合成正常，造成核質發育不同步與骨髓內無效造血。
必查：serum B12、folate，並以 methylmalonic acid（僅 B12 缺乏上升）與 homocysteine（兩者皆上升）區分；無效造血使 LDH 顯著上升、indirect bilirubin 升高、haptoglobin 下降。
藥物也會造成相同形態：methotrexate、hydroxyurea、azathioprine、部分 antiretroviral；nitrous oxide 可使 B12 失活，是常考病史線索。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤判為 MDS 或 erythroid leukemia；MDS 的 megaloblastoid 變化伴隨 pseudo-Pelger、低分葉小巨核細胞等多系發育不良且維生素正常，而 giant metamyelocytes 支持真正維生素缺乏。

quiz.q: 圖中馬蹄形大核、胞質含顆粒的巨大細胞是什麼？它代表哪一類貧血？
quiz.a: Giant metamyelocyte / giant band；megaloblastic anemia（B12 或 folate 缺乏）

2384.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中可見數團深藍色、緊密黏合的腫瘤細胞團塊，與周圍分散的造血細胞截然不同，這種黏合性細胞團是轉移性神經母細胞瘤（metastatic neuroblastoma）侵犯骨髓的線索。
features: Several tight, cohesive clusters of dark-blue small cells distinct from dispersed marrow cells
Cells within clusters show nuclear crowding and molding with scant cytoplasm
A larger elongated central aggregate and smaller clusters at the left and right edges
Background of dispersed hematopoietic cells and red cell streaks
Rosettes or neuropil cannot be assessed at this low magnification
2384.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows several tightly cohesive clusters of small, dark-blue cells with nuclear crowding, contrasting with the surrounding dispersed hematopoietic cells and red cells. The largest aggregate is elongated and centrally located, with smaller clumps at the edges of the field. Homer Wright rosettes, neuritic fibrillary material and fine nuclear detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a metastatic small round cell tumor, compatible with neuroblastoma; confirmation with biopsy immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Clumped marrow particles contain a mixture of maturing lineages and fat, whereas tumor clusters are monotonous with nuclear molding.
Other small round cell tumors can form clusters and are separated by desmin/myogenin or CD99/NKX2.2 immunostaining.
Leukemic blasts are discohesive and diffusely replace the marrow rather than forming tight cohesive clusters.

2768.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓抽吸抹片在紅血球背景中出現一條緻密、互相黏著的深紫色細胞帶，由小圓形細胞組成並夾有淡藍色纖維狀基質，這種黏著性非造血細胞團提示轉移性腫瘤（神經母細胞瘤）。
features: Low-power field with a dense, elongated band of cohesive small round cells
Uniform cells with high N:C ratio and dark nuclei; detail limited at this magnification
Faint pale blue fibrillary matrix within the aggregate
Background of abundant red cells with sparse dispersed nucleated cells
2768.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large, dense, cohesive aggregate of small round cells streaked across the slide, set against a blood-rich background with few dispersed hematopoietic cells. The clustered cells appear monotonous with high N:C ratios, and a faint pale blue fibrillary matrix is seen within the aggregate. Nuclear and cytoplasmic detail cannot be fully assessed at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of metastatic small round cell tumor, consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: A normal particle contains a heterogeneous mix of maturing myeloid, erythroid cells, megakaryocytes and fat rather than a monotonous cohesive cell population.
Blasts are dispersed singly throughout the smear rather than forming cohesive clumps.

ddx.dx: Other metastatic small round blue cell tumors (Ewing sarcoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These also form clumps and require immunophenotyping (CD99/NKX2.2, myogenin) because low-power morphology cannot separate them.

2640.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸顆粒普魯士藍（Prussian blue）染色，整個顆粒被大量深藍綠色的含鐵血黃素占滿，周圍紅血球呈橘棕色，表示儲存鐵明顯增加；若放在缺鐵的情境，此圖其實是「鐵充足」的對照，而非缺鐵。
features: Large marrow particle diffusely laden with dark blue-green hemosiderin
Iron deposits are coarse and confluent throughout the particle
Background red cells stain orange-brown with the counterstain
Thick particle and focus limit assessment of individual macrophages and sideroblasts
2640.describe_en: Prussian blue-stained bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large marrow particle diffusely and densely laden with coarse, confluent blue-green hemosiderin, set against orange-brown red cells. Storage iron is markedly increased (approximately grade 4+ to 5+ in this field). Individual macrophages and erythroid precursors cannot be evaluated for sideroblasts in this thick, slightly out-of-focus particle. These findings exclude iron deficiency and indicate abundant storage iron, as seen in iron overload, anemia of inflammation, or ineffective erythropoiesis; thin areas should be examined for ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows absent stainable iron in particles, the opposite of this image.
Overload produces markedly increased particle iron like this, with supporting history of transfusion or high ferritin/transferrin saturation.
Requires identification of ring sideroblasts (at least 5 perinuclear granules encircling a third of the nucleus) in erythroid precursors in thin areas.
Macrophage iron is normal to increased with decreased sideroblasts and low serum iron with normal or high ferritin.

1168.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散在多顆大型組織球，核小而偏心，細胞質豐富淡藍並呈纖維狀、像揉皺的衛生紙（crumpled tissue paper），這是 Gaucher 細胞的典型外觀。
features: Multiple large macrophages, much larger than surrounding hematopoietic cells
Low N:C ratio with small, eccentric round to oval nuclei
Abundant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with fibrillar, striated 'crumpled tissue paper' texture
No discrete vacuoles or engulfed cells within the cytoplasm
Background of cellular marrow with myeloid and erythroid precursors and red cells
1168.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows cellular marrow with numerous scattered large histiocytes. These cells have small eccentric nuclei and abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm with a fibrillary, wrinkled 'crumpled tissue paper' appearance, without foamy vacuoles or ingested cells. The background hematopoietic elements are present. Findings are consistent with Gaucher cells; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay and GBA1 genotyping is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells look identical on light microscopy; separation requires the clinical context and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have soap-bubble, uniformly vacuolated cytoplasm rather than fibrillar striations.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain blue-green granules of ceroid rather than a pale fibrillar cytoplasm.
MAC histiocytes show negative-image striations that are acid-fast positive, and occur in immunocompromised patients.

exam.answer_en: Gaucher disease — large histiocytes with small eccentric nuclei and fibrillar 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm (Gaucher cells)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著胞質像揉皺衛生紙的大細胞問名稱、缺乏的酵素與確診方法；答 Gaucher cell、glucocerebrosidase（GBA1 基因），以白血球或 dried blood spot 酵素活性確診。
特殊染色：Gaucher cell PAS 陽性、TRAP 陽性，常有 Prussian blue 鐵陽性；Niemann-Pick 細胞則為泡沫狀空泡胞質。
臨床：肝脾腫大、血小板減少、骨痛與 bone crisis、股骨遠端 Erlenmeyer flask deformity；病人罹患 MGUS/myeloma 與 Parkinson disease 風險增加。
治療：enzyme replacement（imiglucerase 等）或 substrate reduction（eliglustat、miglustat）；骨髓檢查非確診必要，看到 Gaucher cell 仍需酵素與基因檢測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 pseudo-Gaucher cells 混淆：CML、myeloma、thalassemia 等高細胞轉換狀態可出現形態相同的細胞，但酵素活性正常；區分需靠臨床與 glucocerebrosidase 活性。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質呈揉皺衛生紙狀的細胞是什麼？缺乏何種酵素？
quiz.a: Gaucher cell；glucocerebrosidase（acid β-glucosidase，GBA1）

1104.recognize_zh: 周邊血中幾顆小型淋巴球，核染色質濃密並有細溝狀摺痕，右上方細胞核呈摺疊狀，胞質極少，符合小型 Sézary 細胞；此倍率下腦回狀（cerebriform）核只能部分辨識。
features: Small lymphoid cells, near red-cell size, with very high N:C ratio
Dense chromatin with subtle nuclear grooves/folds (best seen in upper cell)
Scant, pale-blue agranular cytoplasm
No nucleoli visible
Background red cells with prominent central pallor; no other abnormal cells
1104.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered small lymphoid cells with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, dense chromatin and subtle nuclear grooves and folds, one showing a distinctly convoluted nuclear outline. The cytoplasm is scant and agranular without nucleoli. The cerebriform detail is only partially resolved at this magnification. Findings are compatible with circulating small Sézary cells; diagnosis requires flow cytometry (CD4+ with loss of CD7 and/or CD26, CD4:CD8 ≥10) and a clonal TCR rearrangement matching the skin.

ddx.vs: Normal lymphocytes have smooth round nuclei without grooves; flow loss of CD7/CD26 separates Sézary cells.
