CLL cells have round nuclei with coarse 'soccer-ball' chromatin, smudge cells, and CD5+/CD23+ B-cell phenotype.
ATLL cells are larger with multilobated 'flower' nuclei and patients are HTLV-1 positive.

4240.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中數顆細胞質充滿大而均一顆粒的粒細胞，核多為雙葉或帶狀，是嗜酸性球（eosinophils）；右下方一顆細胞破裂、顆粒散出。背景紅血球大小不一，有橢圓形與淚滴狀紅血球。
features: Several granulocytes with cytoplasm packed with coarse, uniform, refractile granules
Bilobed to band-shaped nuclei with condensed chromatin
Granules appear lilac-pink in this stain, less orange than typical
A disrupted eosinophil at lower right with dispersed granules
Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with ovalocytes and occasional teardrop forms
4240.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several eosinophils with bilobed or band-form nuclei and cytoplasm packed with coarse uniform granules, one of which is disrupted with scattered free granules. The granules stain lilac-pink rather than bright orange in this preparation. Red cells show anisopoikilocytosis with ovalocytes and occasional teardrop cells. Findings are consistent with eosinophilia; the cause (reactive versus clonal) cannot be determined from morphology alone.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine and purple-black with multilobed nuclei, while eosinophil granules are larger, uniform and refractile with bilobed nuclei.
Basophil granules are dark purple-black, variable in size and overlie the nucleus.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: Clonal eosinophilia may show hypogranular or hypersegmented eosinophils and requires FISH/molecular testing for PDGFRA, PDGFRB, FGFR1 or PCM1::JAK2.

4112.recognize_zh: 抹片中央有一團緊密黏附的小圓藍細胞，核圓至卵圓、互相擠壓成形（nuclear molding），細胞質稀少且邊界不清，周圍帶淡粉紅纖維狀物質，與散在的造血細胞明顯不同，提示轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Cohesive cluster of small to medium round blue cells
Round to oval nuclei with fine granular chromatin and nuclear molding
Scant, indistinct cytoplasm forming a syncytial-appearing aggregate
Pale pink fibrillary material at the periphery of the cluster
Background blood-rich smear with scattered normal leukocytes
4112.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a tight cohesive aggregate of small to medium-sized round cells with round to oval nuclei, fine granular chromatin, nuclear molding and scant indistinct cytoplasm, with faint fibrillary pink material at its edges, in a blood-rich background with scattered normal leukocytes. The cohesive growth distinguishes these cells from hematopoietic elements. Findings are suggestive of metastatic neuroblastoma; confirmation with biopsy immunohistochemistry and clinical correlation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are dispersed singly without cohesion, molding or fibrillary matrix.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and abundant cytoplasm, and megakaryocytes are large and lobulated.

ddx.dx: Other small round cell tumors (Ewing, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These require immunostains (CD99/NKX2.2, desmin/myogenin) versus PHOX2B/synaptophysin to separate.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic neuroblastoma — cohesive cluster of small round blue cells with nuclear molding and fibrillary material
pearls_zh: 考法：指著黏附成團、核互相擠壓（nuclear molding）的細胞問「是造血細胞嗎？」答否，屬轉移性小圓藍細胞腫瘤，兒童首想 neuroblastoma。
兒童小圓藍細胞腫瘤鑑別：neuroblastoma、Ewing sarcoma（CD99、EWSR1 rearrangement）、rhabdomyosarcoma（myogenin、desmin）、lymphoblastic lymphoma（TdT、CD45）。
Neuroblastoma IHC：PHOX2B、synaptophysin、chromogranin 陽性、CD45 陰性；flow 可見 CD56+ CD45− 族群。
預後：MYCN amplification、年齡與組織學分類（INPC）影響風險分層；診斷時需測尿中 catecholamine 代謝物（VMA/HVA）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 lymphoblast 群或 megakaryocyte 叢：腫瘤細胞呈黏附團塊與 nuclear molding，造血細胞在抹片上則散在分布。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞團若做 flow，CD45 與 CD56 預期為何？
quiz.a: CD45 陰性、CD56 陽性

4048.recognize_zh: 視野中有多個三角形、盔甲狀（helmet cell）與尖角狀的紅血球碎片（箭頭），即裂紅血球（schistocyte），同時血小板很少，符合血栓性微血管病變（如 TTP）的微血管病性溶血。
features: Numerous schistocytes including triangular fragments (arrow), helmet cells and keratocyte-like forms with sharp angles
Fragments lack central pallor and are smaller than intact red cells
Occasional larger bluish polychromatophilic red cell (left center)
Echinocyte/crenated cell present at right
Markedly reduced platelets in the field
4048.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous schistocytes, including triangular fragments, helmet cells, and angular forms with sharp points, among otherwise normochromic red cells. A polychromatophilic red cell is present, and platelets are markedly decreased. The combination of fragmented red cells and thrombocytopenia indicates intravascular mechanical red cell destruction. Findings are consistent with microangiopathic hemolytic anemia, which in the appropriate clinical setting suggests thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura; urgent ADAMTS13 activity testing, LDH, haptoglobin, and coagulation studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Also shows schistocytes and thrombocytopenia but with prolonged PT/aPTT, low fibrinogen and elevated D-dimer, while TTP has normal coagulation tests.
Morphology is identical, so separation relies on predominant renal failure, Shiga toxin or complement abnormalities and ADAMTS13 activity above 10%.
Schistocytes occur with a prosthetic valve history and usually normal platelet counts.

ddx.dx: Bite/blister cells in oxidative hemolysis (G6PD deficiency)
ddx.vs: Bite cells show a semicircular notch with hemoglobin retracted, and Heinz bodies are present, rather than sharp-angled fragments with thrombocytopenia.

exam.answer_en: Microangiopathic hemolytic anemia (e.g., TTP) — numerous schistocytes including triangular fragments and helmet cells with thrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：指著三角形、盔甲狀碎片問名稱，再問下一步；答 schistocytes，需立即查血小板、LDH、haptoglobin、reticulocyte、凝血功能與 ADAMTS13。
TTP：ADAMTS13 活性 <10% 支持診斷；在結果出來前，臨床高度懷疑（如 PLASMIC score 高）就應開始 plasma exchange。
免疫性 TTP 治療：plasma exchange + corticosteroids，可加 caplacizumab 與 rituximab；避免預防性輸注血小板。
鑑別：DIC 有 PT/aPTT 延長與 fibrinogen 下降；STEC-HUS 以腎衰竭與腹瀉為主；另考慮 aHUS、惡性高血壓、機械瓣膜。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把抹片製作造成的碎片或 bite cells、echinocytes 當成 schistocytes；真正 schistocytes 有尖角、無中央淡染，應在適當薄區判讀並配合溶血指標。

quiz.q: 圖中箭頭所指紅血球碎片的名稱為何？懷疑 TTP 時確認用的檢查是？
quiz.a: Schistocyte（triangular/helmet cell）；ADAMTS13 activity

3856.recognize_zh: 單一顆異常早幼粒細胞的細胞質內含有大量交錯、成束排列的 Auer 小體，並覆蓋在細胞核上，就是急性前骨髓細胞白血病的「柴束細胞」（faggot cell）。
features: Single large abnormal promyelocyte
Numerous Auer rods arranged in crisscrossing bundles ('faggots')
Rods and granules overlying and partially obscuring the nucleus
Densely granular pink-purple cytoplasm
Slightly irregular cell outline; image focus limits fine chromatin detail
3856.describe_en: High-power view shows a single abnormal promyelocyte whose cytoplasm is packed with numerous Auer rods arranged in crisscrossing bundles, overlying the nucleus together with dense azurophilic granules. Fine chromatin detail is limited by focus. This cell represents a classic faggot cell, a finding highly suggestive of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent PML::RARA confirmation and coagulation assessment are recommended.

ddx.vs: Non-APL AML typically shows single Auer rods in blasts rather than dense bundles of rods in a heavily granulated promyelocyte.
Normal promyelocytes have round eccentric nuclei with a Golgi hof and coarse granules but never contain Auer rods.
Pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi inclusions are large round granules, not slender rod-shaped bundles.

exam.answer_en: Faggot cell — abnormal promyelocyte packed with crisscrossing bundles of Auer rods, diagnostic clue for acute promyelocytic leukemia
pearls_zh: 考法：單一顆細胞放大圖，直接問細胞名稱（faggot cell）與對應疾病（APL），再追問染色體：t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2) PML::RARA。
Faggot cell 名稱來自 Auer rod 如「柴束」般交錯；經典 hypergranular APL 常見，microgranular 型則較少但仍可找到。
APL 立即臨床意義：DIC 與纖溶亢進出血，形態懷疑時立刻給 ATRA、補足 fibrinogen 與血小板，不等分子結果。
WHO 5th 與 ICC 中 APL 以 PML::RARA 定義，不需 blast ≥20% 門檻；flow 典型 CD34−、HLA-DR−、CD117+、CD33 強陽性。
標準治療 ATRA＋ATO；高風險（WBC >10×10⁹/L）常需加化療（如 anthracycline 或 gemtuzumab ozogamicin）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把顆粒密集重疊誤看成 Auer rod 或把非 APL 的 AML 單根 Auer rod 當 faggot；faggot cell 需多根交錯成束，且在濃厚顆粒的早幼粒樣細胞中。

quiz.q: 這種細胞質內塞滿交錯 Auer rod 束的細胞叫什麼？對應的融合基因為何？
quiz.a: Faggot cell；PML::RARA（APL）

3920.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中的巨噬細胞細胞質裡可見被吞噬的紅血球、一顆帶顆粒的有核細胞與深染核碎片，另有一個大空泡，是吞噬血球現象（hemophagocytosis）的例子。
features: Macrophage with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and irregular outline
Engulfed red cell within a cytoplasmic vacuole
Engulfed granulated nucleated cell with an adjacent dense dark nuclear fragment
Large clear cytoplasmic vacuole
Scattered small dark pyknotic debris in the cytoplasm
Background myeloid precursors and lymphocytes
3920.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a macrophage with abundant grey-blue cytoplasm containing a phagocytosed red cell, an engulfed granulated nucleated cell with a dense pyknotic nuclear fragment, a large clear vacuole and scattered small dark debris. The background contains maturing myeloid precursors and lymphocytes. Findings demonstrate hemophagocytosis, which is nonspecific and should be correlated with clinical and laboratory criteria for hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain only apoptotic nuclear debris, not intact ingested red cells or granulocytes.
Overlapping cells lie on the surface without a surrounding vacuolar halo, whereas phagocytosed cells sit within distinct vacuoles.

ddx.dx: Macrophage with intracellular organisms (e.g., Histoplasma, Leishmania)
ddx.vs: Organisms are small uniform 2–4 µm bodies (with kinetoplasts in Leishmania), not whole blood cells.

3728.recognize_zh: 腹水細胞離心抹片背景是大量嗜中性球，中間有一群大型異常細胞，細胞核大而不規則、染色質細緻，細胞質深藍色、邊緣有泡狀突起（blebs），右下還有一顆正在分裂的大細胞（有絲分裂像）；這些大型深藍細胞質的淋巴樣細胞提示淋巴瘤侵犯腹膜積液。
features: Cluster of large atypical cells, several times the size of neutrophils
Large irregular or folded nuclei with fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Moderate to abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with blebs/projections
Mitotic figure in a large cell with basophilic cytoplasm
Background dominated by segmented neutrophils, some vacuolated, and scattered small lymphocytes
Few RBCs; no cohesive mesothelial sheets with windows
3728.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of peritoneal fluid shows a background of numerous neutrophils with scattered small lymphocytes. There is a loose aggregate of large atypical cells with irregular, sometimes folded nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and moderate to abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs; a mitotic figure is present in a similar large cell. The cells lack the cohesive sheets, intercellular windows and two-tone cytoplasm of mesothelial cells. Findings are suggestive of involvement by a large-cell lymphoma; flow cytometry and cell-block immunostains are needed to confirm lineage and exclude reactive mesothelial cells or carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells form cohesive clusters with intercellular windows, central round nuclei and dense two-tone cytoplasm with a lacy border, and are calretinin/WT1 positive.
Carcinoma forms three-dimensional cohesive balls or acini with molding and mucin vacuoles, and is keratin/MOC31/BerEP4 positive and CD45 negative.
PEL cells are immunoblastic/plasmablastic, CD20/CD45 weak or negative with HHV-8 (LANA) positivity, requiring immunostains rather than morphology alone to separate from DLBCL.

3600.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指是分葉核嗜中性球細胞質下緣一小塊淡藍色、無顆粒的區域，即杜勒小體（Döhle body）；細胞質內散在細紫色顆粒，旁邊有數顆血小板，是典型的反應性嗜中性球變化。
features: Segmented neutrophil with 3–4 lobes and clumped chromatin
Small, pale blue, agranular inclusion at the peripheral cytoplasm (arrow)
Cytoplasm with fine to moderately prominent purple granules
No cytoplasmic vacuoles
Adjacent platelets, including a large platelet, abutting the cell
Normocytic red cells in background
3600.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing a small, pale blue, agranular inclusion at the periphery of the cytoplasm (arrow), consistent with a Döhle body. The cytoplasm contains fine to moderately prominent granules without vacuoles. Several platelets, including a large form, lie adjacent to the cell, and background red cells are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a Döhle body, a reactive change typically associated with infection, inflammation or cytokine therapy.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger, sharper and elongated, present in nearly all neutrophils, and associated with giant platelets and thrombocytopenia.
Anaplasma morulae are dark purple, stippled, mulberry-like clusters rather than pale homogeneous blue patches.
Vacuoles are clear, punched-out spaces, whereas Döhle bodies are solid light-blue cytoplasmic areas.

exam.answer_en: Döhle body — small pale blue agranular inclusion at the cytoplasmic periphery of a segmented neutrophil (arrow)
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭題，考官問「箭頭指的是什麼、臨床意義」，答 Döhle body，屬反應性變化，常見於感染、發炎、燒傷、懷孕或 G-CSF 治療。
旁邊的大血小板是陷阱：若看到大血小板就要問「是否所有嗜中性球都有包涵體、血小板數是否低」，以排除 MYH9-related disorder。
Anaplasma phagocytophilum 感染在嗜中性球內形成 morula（深紫色桑椹狀點狀團），是蜱媒感染的考點，需與 Döhle body 區分。
Döhle body 在 G-CSF 使用後常見，同時可見毒性顆粒與 left shift，不一定代表感染。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Anaplasma morula；morula 是深紫色、帶點狀質地的桑椹狀團塊，Döhle body 則是淡藍色、均質、無顆粒的斑塊。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指嗜中性球周邊的淡藍色小斑塊是什麼？列舉一個非感染性成因。
quiz.a: Döhle body；懷孕、燒傷或 G-CSF 治療

3664.recognize_zh: 一顆大型成熟巨核細胞（megakaryocyte），分葉核位於左上，淡紫色顆粒狀細胞質中央清楚包著兩顆完整的帶狀／分葉核嗜中性球，這就是 emperipolesis。
features: Large mature megakaryocyte with abundant finely granular pale lilac cytoplasm
Hyperlobulated, dense megakaryocyte nucleus displaced to one side
Two intact neutrophilic granulocytes (band/segmented nuclei) lying within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm
Engulfed cells retain normal morphology without degradation, unlike phagocytosis
Background of maturing granulocytes, lymphocytes and red cells
3664.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large mature megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and a lobulated nucleus. Two intact neutrophilic granulocytes are seen within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm without evidence of degradation, representing emperipolesis. The surrounding marrow shows maturing granulocytic elements. Emperipolesis is a nonspecific finding that can be seen in normal and reactive marrows and is increased in some myeloproliferative neoplasms (notably primary myelofibrosis) and gray platelet syndrome.

ddx.vs: The engulfing cell is a histiocyte with a single oval nucleus and the ingested cells are often degraded, whereas here the host is a lobulated megakaryocyte and the neutrophils are intact.

ddx.dx: Overlying cells on the megakaryocyte (smear artifact)
ddx.vs: Superimposed cells lie in a different focal plane and often extend beyond the cytoplasmic border, whereas true emperipolesis shows cells fully enclosed within the cytoplasm.
Involves large S100-positive histiocytes with vesicular nuclei engulfing lymphocytes, not megakaryocytes.

exam.answer_en: Emperipolesis — intact neutrophils within the cytoplasm of a mature megakaryocyte
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指巨核細胞內的完整中性球，問 emperipolesis 與 phagocytosis 的差別；答被包入的細胞保持完整存活、未被分解。
巨核細胞 emperipolesis 可見於正常或反應性骨髓，但在 primary myelofibrosis 中增加，被認為與 TGF-β 釋放及纖維化相關。
Gray platelet syndrome（NBEAL2 突變）也有明顯中性球 emperipolesis，伴灰色無顆粒的大血小板與骨髓纖維化。
Rosai-Dorfman disease 的 emperipolesis 發生在組織球（S100+、CD68+、CD1a−）內，吞入的主要是淋巴球與漿細胞。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 HLH 的 hemophagocytosis；噬血現象發生於巨噬細胞且被吞入細胞已被消化降解，emperipolesis 則是在巨核細胞內看到完整、未被破壞的中性球。

quiz.q: 這顆巨核細胞內包著完整的中性球，這種現象叫什麼？在哪一種 MPN 中特別增加？
quiz.a: Emperipolesis；primary myelofibrosis（亦見於 gray platelet syndrome）。

3536.recognize_zh: 高倍下充滿中到大型芽細胞，細胞質少、核形明顯不規則並有扭曲或摺疊（convoluted），染色質細緻；旁邊可見一個嗜酸性球與小淋巴球作為大小對照，符合 T 淋巴芽細胞白血病。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio and scant basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Markedly irregular nuclear contours with folds, convolutions, and indentations
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli small and inconspicuous in most cells
Occasional cells with elongated or tailed cytoplasm
Residual eosinophilic myelocyte and small mature lymphocytes for size comparison
3536.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of medium to large blasts with scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, and markedly irregular, convoluted nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. Rare residual eosinophilic precursors and small lymphocytes are present. No Auer rods are identified. Findings are consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia; the convoluted nuclei are compatible with, but not specific for, T-lymphoblastic leukemia, which requires flow cytometric confirmation.

ddx.vs: B lymphoblasts overlap morphologically, so lineage must be established by flow cytometry (CD19/CD79a vs cytoplasmic CD3).
Monoblasts/promonocytes have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles and are nonspecific esterase positive.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of peripheral T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Mature T-cell lymphoma cells have condensed chromatin and are TdT-negative, CD34-negative.

3472.recognize_zh: 骨小樑旁的骨髓腔被成巢狀（nests）排列的上皮樣細胞取代，細胞有中等量淡嗜伊紅細胞質、卵圓形空泡狀核與小核仁，巢與巢之間有裂隙，完全不見正常造血細胞，符合轉移性癌侵犯骨髓。
features: Marrow space replaced by cohesive nests of epithelioid cells separated by clefts
Oval to elongated vesicular nuclei with mild to moderate pleomorphism and small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale eosinophilic cytoplasm with indistinct cell borders
Adjacent bony trabecula (upper left) without intervening normal hematopoiesis
No obvious gland formation or mucin in this field
3472.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section shows an adjacent bony trabecula with the intertrabecular space replaced by nests of cohesive epithelioid tumor cells. The cells have oval vesicular nuclei, small nucleoli and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, and the nests are separated by retraction clefts. Normal hematopoietic elements are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma; in the stated clinical setting, metastatic breast carcinoma with confirmation by cytokeratin, GATA3 and HER2 immunostains is appropriate.

ddx.vs: Melanoma shows discohesive cells with prominent macronucleoli, intranuclear inclusions or pigment and is cytokeratin negative but S100/SOX10 positive.
Myeloma forms diffuse sheets of discohesive plasma cells with eccentric clock-face nuclei rather than cohesive nests with retraction clefts.
ALCL cells have horseshoe nuclei and are CD30/CD45 positive and keratin negative, whereas carcinoma nests are keratin positive.

3280.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓抹片滿布大小一致、核深染、細胞質極少的小型成熟淋巴球，並散見淡紫色、邊界模糊的污跡細胞（smudge cell），正常造血細胞明顯減少，符合 CLL 骨髓侵犯。
features: Diffuse, monotonous population of small lymphocytes dominating the field at low power
Round, densely hyperchromatic nuclei with very scant cytoplasm
Scattered smudge cells with pale, smeared purple chromatin
Few residual myeloid cells, including occasional granulated forms
Red cells show drying artifact (crenated and irregular shapes)
3280.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows marked predominance of small, uniform lymphocytes with round, dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm, replacing much of the normal hematopoiesis. Numerous smudge cells are scattered throughout, while granulocytic and erythroid precursors are sparse. Red cells display drying artifact. No significant population of large cells is seen at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma; immunophenotyping is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: MCL may look similar at low power but typically has more irregular nuclei, fewer smudge cells, and is CD23- cyclin D1+ on ancillary studies.
LPL shows admixed plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with mast cells, and MYD88 L265P, rather than a uniform small lymphocyte population with smudge cells.
Hematogones have homogeneous smooth chromatin and show a maturing CD10/CD34/TdT spectrum on flow instead of monotypic CD5+ CD23+ B cells.
A hemodiluted sample shows few spicules and a high neutrophil proportion, whereas this field is densely replaced by lymphocytes.

exam.answer_en: CLL/SLL in marrow aspirate — monotonous small lymphocytes replacing hematopoiesis, with scattered smudge cells
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍圖考「整體印象」：單一族群小淋巴球取代正常造血 + smudge cell，先答 CLL，再說需 flow 確認。
Smudge cell 技巧：抹片前加 albumin 可減少人為破碎，使淋巴球計數與 prolymphocyte 評估更準確。
分期：Rai 與 Binet 以淋巴結、肝脾腫大、貧血與血小板低來分；骨髓浸潤造成的血球低下屬進展期，是治療指徵之一。
WHO 5th 中 B-prolymphocytic leukemia 不再獨立成類，原歸類病例多重新分入 CLL 進展型或 MCL 等其他實體。
exam.pitfall_zh: 低倍下易誤認為 hematogone hyperplasia 或 LPL；hematogone 染色質平滑、無 smudge cell 且 flow 呈成熟連續型態。

quiz.q: 低倍骨髓抹片見單一族群小淋巴球與散在污跡細胞，最可能診斷為何？
quiz.a: CLL/SLL 骨髓侵犯

3152.recognize_zh: 周邊血中一顆大型未成熟骨髓系細胞，染色質細緻、腎形核一側有明顯核周淡染區（Golgi hof），胞質嗜鹼性；旁邊的嗜中性球核分葉不佳且顆粒偏少，在骨髓纖維化中代表白血球母細胞性（leukoerythroblastic）變化。
features: Large immature myeloid cell with fine chromatin and an indented, reniform nucleus
Moderate basophilic blue cytoplasm with a pale paranuclear Golgi zone (hof)
Few or no visible cytoplasmic granules; no Auer rods
Adjacent neutrophil with a hypolobated, band-like nucleus of clumped chromatin and pale sparsely granular cytoplasm
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis and a few platelets
3152.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large immature myeloid cell with fine chromatin, an indented reniform nucleus, basophilic cytoplasm and a pale paranuclear Golgi zone, consistent with a blast or early promyelocyte. An adjacent neutrophil has a hypolobated nucleus with clumped chromatin and relatively pale, sparsely granular cytoplasm. Red cells show mild anisocytosis. In the setting of primary myelofibrosis, circulating immature myeloid cells are part of the leukoerythroblastic picture; the percentage of circulating blasts should be quantified because an increase signals accelerated or blast phase.

ddx.vs: Reactive left shift shows toxic granulation and Döhle bodies with rare immature forms, lacks teardrop cells and nucleated red cells, and is not accompanied by marrow fibrosis.
CML shows a marked leukocytosis with myelocyte peak and basophilia and carries BCR::ABL1, which must be excluded in any MPN work-up.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with more condensed lacy chromatin and gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm without a discrete Golgi hof.

3088.recognize_zh: 這張圖並非成熟紅血球內的點狀體，而是一顆有核紅血球（核圓、染色質塊狀、胞質灰紫色）胞質內有數個小而圓、深紫色的核碎片，即有核紅血球中的Howell-Jolly小體樣包涵體。
features: Single nucleated cell with round central-to-eccentric nucleus and coarsely clumped (checkerboard) chromatin
Moderate gray-lilac (polychromatophilic) cytoplasm
Several small, round, dense dark purple cytoplasmic inclusions adjacent to the nucleus, resembling Howell-Jolly bodies
Scattered small cytoplasmic vacuoles and irregular cell border
Adjacent elongated red cells
3088.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at very high magnification shows a single nucleated cell with a round nucleus, coarsely clumped chromatin, and gray-lilac polychromatophilic cytoplasm, most consistent with a polychromatic normoblast. The cytoplasm contains several small, round, dense dark purple inclusions adjacent to the nucleus, resembling Howell-Jolly bodies (nuclear fragments), along with small vacuoles. Classic Howell-Jolly bodies in mature anucleate red cells are not shown in this field. Findings are suggestive of Howell-Jolly body-like nuclear fragments in a nucleated red cell, as seen with dyserythropoiesis, megaloblastic change, or hyposplenism.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are smaller, multiple, irregular granules clustered at the periphery and are Prussian blue positive.
Plasma cells have a markedly eccentric nucleus with a perinuclear hof and deep blue rather than gray-lilac cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Phagocytosed nuclear debris in a monocyte/macrophage
ddx.vs: Phagocytes have larger size, folded nuclei, and debris within vacuoles rather than free round fragments.

3024.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一個小型成熟淋巴球，核染色質濃密成塊，核中央有一道明顯的線狀裂溝把核分成兩半，細胞質只有薄薄一圈淡藍色，這就是核裂淋巴球（clefted lymphocyte）。
features: Small lymphocyte, slightly larger than adjacent RBCs
High N:C ratio with a thin crescent of pale blue cytoplasm
Single sharp linear nuclear cleft dividing the nucleus with a notch at the margin
Dense, coarsely clumped mature chromatin; no nucleoli
Background RBCs with rouleaux-like overlap; smudged platelet fragment nearby
3024.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small mature lymphocyte with scant pale blue cytoplasm and coarsely clumped chromatin. The nucleus has a sharp, deep linear cleft that nearly bisects it, with an indentation at the nuclear margin. No nucleoli or cytoplasmic granules are seen. A single clefted lymphocyte is a nonspecific finding; when numerous, clefted small lymphocytes raise the possibility of leukemic follicular lymphoma, and they may also be seen in CLL/SLL or reactive states such as pertussis, so flow cytometry is required for classification.

ddx.vs: FL cells are typically deeply cleaved and clonal CD10+/BCL2+ B cells, which cannot be separated from other clefted lymphocytes without flow cytometry.
Typical CLL cells have round nuclei with block-like chromatin; a clonal CD5+/CD23+ phenotype confirms CLL even if occasional cells are clefted.
MCL cells show irregular or notched nuclei and are CD5+/CD23-/cyclin D1+, distinguishing them from CLL and FL.
Pertussis produces polyclonal clefted small lymphocytes in young children with cough, not a clonal B-cell population.

2896.recognize_zh: 高倍 LAP 染色：兩顆中性球核呈紅色分葉，細胞質布滿中等密度的藍色顆粒但核仍清楚可見，大約屬於 2–3 分的陽性強度。
features: Two segmented neutrophils with red-counterstained multilobed nuclei
Moderately dense, fine blue granular reaction product throughout the cytoplasm
Nuclear outlines remain clearly visible (not obscured)
Unstained red cells forming aggregates in background
2896.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear stained for leukocyte alkaline phosphatase shows two segmented neutrophils with moderately dense, evenly distributed blue cytoplasmic granules. The red-stained nuclear lobes remain clearly discernible through the reaction product. These cells illustrate intermediate positivity, approximately 2+ to 3+ on the 0 to 4+ LAP scoring scale.

ddx.vs: 1+ cells show only scattered, sparse faint granules with most cytoplasm unstained.
4+ cells show intense confluent dark blue staining that obscures the nucleus.

2704.recognize_zh: 下方中央一顆紅血球周邊排著一圈細小、深藍紫色的顆粒，顆粒成群分布而非均勻散布整顆細胞，這就是 Pappenheimer 小體（含鐵顆粒）；旁邊還有淡染的低色素細胞。
features: Red cell with multiple small dark basophilic granules clustered along its periphery
Granules are coarse dots rather than fine diffuse stippling
Occasional hypochromic red cells with thin pink rim (dimorphic-appearing population)
Polychromatic cell with streaky bluish cytoplasm and poikilocytes (elongated/teardrop fragments)
Slightly out-of-focus high-power image limits fine detail
2704.describe_en: High-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows a mixed red cell population with occasional hypochromic cells, a polychromatic cell, and scattered poikilocytes. One red cell contains multiple small, dark basophilic granules clustered toward its periphery, consistent with Pappenheimer bodies; the image is slightly out of focus. Basophilic stippling distributed evenly through the cell is not seen. Findings are consistent with Pappenheimer bodies (siderotic granules), which should be confirmed as iron by Prussian blue staining and prompt consideration of sideroblastic anemia, post-splenectomy state, or hemoglobinopathy.

ddx.vs: Basophilic stippling consists of fine or coarse ribosomal granules evenly distributed throughout the entire cell and is Prussian blue-negative, whereas Pappenheimer bodies are few, clustered at the periphery and iron-positive.
A Howell-Jolly body is usually a single, larger, round, dense nuclear remnant rather than a cluster of small granules.
An overlying platelet shows a halo and a granular purple center in a different focal plane, not tiny discrete dots within the red cell edge.

exam.answer_en: Pappenheimer bodies — red cell with clustered small dark basophilic granules at the periphery in a dimorphic-appearing population
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指紅血球內靠邊緣成群的小黑點問「這是什麼、成分為何、如何確認」——答 Pappenheimer bodies，含鐵的 siderotic granules，以 Prussian blue 染色確認。
名詞：含 iron granules 的無核紅血球稱 siderocyte；有核紅血球含鐵顆粒稱 sideroblast；ring sideroblast 為 ≥5 顆鐵顆粒環繞核周 ≥1/3。
病因：sideroblastic anemia（先天 ALAS2 等、MDS with SF3B1、酒精、isoniazid、lead、copper deficiency/zinc excess）、脾切除或 hyposplenism、thalassemia、溶血性貧血。
本片 dimorphic（正常＋低色素）紅血球族群是 sideroblastic anemia 的經典周邊血線索，應進一步做骨髓 iron stain。
脾臟正常時會移除這些顆粒（pitting），故脾切除後 Pappenheimer bodies 與 Howell-Jolly bodies 常同時增加。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 basophilic stippling 混淆：stippling 為 RNA/核糖體，細小顆粒均勻散布全細胞且 Prussian blue 陰性；Pappenheimer bodies 較粗、少數、成群靠邊緣且含鐵。

quiz.q: 紅血球邊緣成群的小深藍顆粒若為 Pappenheimer bodies，用哪種染色可證實其含鐵？
quiz.a: Prussian blue（Perls）iron stain

2512.recognize_zh: 中倍周邊血液中淋巴球數量增加，多為小型、核深染且輪廓不規則的淋巴球，另有一顆單核球與一顆嗜中性球作比較，符合 Sézary 細胞增多；本倍率下腦迴狀核紋細節有限。
features: Increased numbers of small lymphocytes scattered across the field
Hyperchromatic nuclei with dense chromatin and irregular, indented contours in several cells
Scant cytoplasm; a few cells slightly larger with a bilobed or elongated nucleus
A monocyte and a segmented neutrophil for comparison
Normocytic red cells and adequate platelets; cerebriform detail limited at this magnification
2512.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at intermediate power shows an increase in small lymphocytes with dense hyperchromatic nuclei, scant cytoplasm and irregular or indented nuclear contours, with a few slightly larger cells having elongated or bilobed nuclei. A monocyte and a segmented neutrophil are present, and red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Fine cerebriform grooves cannot be fully resolved at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of circulating Sézary cells, requiring flow cytometric confirmation of a CD4+ T-cell population with CD7/CD26 loss.

ddx.vs: CLL cells have round nuclei with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, and are CD5+/CD23+ B cells rather than CD4+ T cells.
ATLL shows polylobated flower cells and HTLV-1 serology positivity.
Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with more abundant cytoplasm and lack a clonal immunophenotype.

2448.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中一個原始淋巴球，核質比極高、胞質只剩左側一小片淡藍色，細胞核有明顯凹陷／缺刻、染色質細緻；T 淋巴母細胞常見這種核摺痕，但仍須流式確認。
features: Single blast slightly larger than surrounding red cells
High N:C ratio with a small crescent of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Nucleus with a distinct indentation (notch) on one side
Fine, homogeneous chromatin without prominent nucleoli
Background red cells with an occasional target cell and echinocyte
2448.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating blast with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, a small crescent of agranular pale blue cytoplasm, homogeneous fine chromatin and a prominent nuclear indentation. No granules, Auer rods or nucleoli are evident. The red cells show only occasional target cells and an echinocyte. Findings are consistent with a circulating lymphoblast, and the nuclear convolution is compatible with T-lymphoblastic leukemia, to be confirmed by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Nuclear indentation is not lineage specific; CD19/CD79a versus cytoplasmic CD3 expression determines lineage.
Sézary cells have condensed, cerebriform chromatin rather than fine blastic chromatin and are TdT negative.
Monocytic precursors have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, folded nuclei with nucleoli and are nonspecific esterase positive.

2320.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血中有兩顆細緻染色質、淡藍色細胞質的大型母細胞，旁邊一顆細胞質塞滿粗大圓形顆粒的幼稚顆粒球（嗜鹼性或嗜酸性系），母細胞與異常顆粒球並存，符合 CML 急性轉化。
features: Two large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and faint nucleoli
Moderate pale blue cytoplasm, one with a clear perinuclear zone
Adjacent immature granulocyte with abundant coarse round cytoplasmic granules and small vacuoles
Background red cells include target cells and a cell with a refractile ring artifact
2320.describe_en: High-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows two large blasts with fine chromatin, faint nucleoli and moderate pale blue cytoplasm. Adjacent is an immature granulocyte with numerous coarse, round cytoplasmic granules, likely of basophil or eosinophil lineage. Background red cells include target cells and a refractile drying artifact. In a patient with CML, BCR-ABL1-positive, findings are consistent with blast phase.

ddx.vs: Abnormal eosinophils in inv(16) have large dark basophilic granules with a monocytic component, and the entity lacks BCR-ABL1.
Blasts with coarse basophilic granules without BCR-ABL1 or prior CML favor acute basophilic leukemia.
APL promyelocytes have bilobed nuclei, dense azurophilic granules and Auer rod bundles with PML::RARA, rather than coarse round granules.

2192.recognize_zh: 雙下肢多發、界限不清的紅褐至紫色皮下結節與斑塊，對稱分布於大腿與小腿，部分表面有結痂與色素沉著，呈多發性脂膜炎樣病灶；此為臨床照，需切片確診。
features: Multiple erythematous to violaceous-brown subcutaneous nodules and plaques
Bilateral, fairly symmetric involvement of thighs and lower legs
Ill-defined borders with post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation
Few small crusted or scaly surface lesions; no large ulcers
Gross clinical image without histologic detail
2192.describe_en: Clinical photograph of the lower extremities shows multiple, bilateral, ill-defined erythematous to violaceous-brown subcutaneous nodules and plaques involving the thighs and lower legs, with post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation and a few small crusted surface lesions. No large ulcers are evident. The distribution and appearance are those of a multifocal panniculitis. The image is compatible with subcutaneous panniculitis-like T-cell lymphoma but is not diagnostic; deep incisional biopsy including subcutis with immunophenotyping is required.

ddx.vs: Erythema nodosum produces tender pretibial nodules that resolve without ulceration and shows septal panniculitis rather than lobular atypical lymphoid infiltrates.
Lupus profundus favors face, arms and buttocks, heals with lipoatrophy, and histologically shows follicles and plasma cells.
PCGD-TCL tends to produce ulcerated necrotic plaques and is TCR-gamma positive on biopsy.

1616.recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結被膜正下方排列著數個次級濾泡，中央是淡染的生發中心、外圍有深染外套區，其下則為均勻的副皮質區，是正常淋巴結皮質結構的教學圖。
features: Thin capsule and subcapsular sinus along the top of the section
Superficial cortical secondary follicles with pale germinal centers
Darker rims of small lymphocytes (mantle zones) around the germinal centers
Deeper paracortex with a more uniform, slightly mottled lymphoid population and small vessels
Preserved architecture without effacement
1616.describe_en: Low-power section of lymph node shows an intact capsule with an underlying subcapsular sinus. The superficial cortex contains widely spaced secondary follicles with pale germinal centers surrounded by darker mantle zones, and the deeper paracortex consists of a more uniform lymphoid population with small vessels. The architecture is preserved, with no crowding of follicles or diffuse effacement. Findings are consistent with normal lymph node cortex and paracortex.

ddx.vs: FL shows numerous crowded, uniform follicles throughout cortex and medulla with thin or absent mantles, whereas here a few well-spaced follicles are confined to the outer cortex.
Reactive follicular hyperplasia shows increased numbers of variably sized follicles with large polarized germinal centers, a quantitative difference from this normal cortex.

60304.recognize_zh: 紅血球大小一致，直徑與中央小淋巴球的核相近，具有約占三分之一的中央淡染區，形狀大致正常，是正常大小紅血球（normocytic RBCs）的比較標準。
features: Red cells uniform in size, approximately the diameter of the small lymphocyte nucleus
Central pallor occupying about one-third of the cell diameter (normochromic)
Minimal anisocytosis and poikilocytosis
Single small lymphocyte with dense chromatin and scant cytoplasm used as size reference
Few platelets in background; no inclusions or fragments seen
60304.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells that are uniform in size and shape, approximately equal in diameter to the nucleus of a small lymphocyte, with central pallor occupying about one-third of the cell. There is no significant anisopoikilocytosis, and no spherocytes, target cells, schistocytes or inclusions are seen. A small mature lymphocyte is present. Findings are consistent with normocytic, normochromic red cells.

ddx.vs: Microcytic red cells are noticeably smaller than the small lymphocyte nucleus and often hypochromic, unlike these cells.
Macrocytes are clearly larger than the small lymphocyte nucleus and may be oval, whereas these cells are equal in size to it.

60048.recognize_zh: 上方嗜中性球的細胞質邊緣可見數個淡藍灰色、界線模糊的斑塊狀包涵體（Döhle bodies），下方帶狀核細胞頂端也有一小塊，同時兩顆細胞的顆粒偏粗、偏深（toxic granulation），符合 Döhle 小體。
features: Pale gray-blue, ill-defined cytoplasmic patches located near the cell membrane of the upper neutrophil
A similar small blue inclusion at the upper edge of the lower band neutrophil
Coarse, dark purple toxic granulation in both cells
Lower cell has an unsegmented band nucleus, consistent with a left shift
Background red cells with mild anisocytosis and an occasional crenated cell
60048.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils, one with a bilobed/segmenting nucleus and one band form, both containing coarse, dark toxic granulation. The upper neutrophil has several pale blue-gray, poorly demarcated cytoplasmic inclusions at the cell periphery, and a smaller similar inclusion is present in the band. Findings are consistent with Döhle bodies accompanied by toxic granulation and a left shift, suggesting infection, inflammation, pregnancy, burns or G-CSF therapy.

ddx.vs: MYH9 inclusions are larger, more sharply defined and spindle-shaped, occur without toxic granulation and are accompanied by giant platelets and thrombocytopenia.
Anaplasma morulae are dense, stippled, dark blue-purple berry-like clusters, whereas Döhle bodies are pale, homogeneous blue-gray patches.
Chédiak-Higashi cells contain giant discrete red-purple or gray granules throughout the cytoplasm rather than peripheral pale blue patches.
Alder-Reilly granules are large dark granules present in all leukocytes without Döhle bodies or clinical infection, whereas this image shows peripheral blue patches with toxic change.

exam.answer_en: Döhle bodies with toxic granulation — pale blue-gray peripheral cytoplasmic inclusions in neutrophils with coarse dark granules and a band form
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指嗜中性球細胞質邊緣的淡藍灰斑塊，問名稱與成分，並要你一起指出 toxic granulation 與 left shift。
Döhle body 為殘留的 rough endoplasmic reticulum（ribosomes），反映快速成熟；常與 toxic granulation、細胞質空泡同時出現。
常見原因：細菌感染、敗血症、燒傷、妊娠、G-CSF 治療；細胞質空泡化在敗血症時更有提示意義。
May-Hegglin（MYH9-related disorder）的包涵體為 MYH9 蛋白聚集，較大、呈紡錘形、出現在大多數顆粒球，並合併巨大血小板與血小板低下，但無 toxic granulation。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 May-Hegglin 包涵體混淆：Döhle body 小、邊界模糊、伴 toxic granulation 與感染背景；MYH9 包涵體較大清楚、合併 giant platelets 與慢性血小板低下。

quiz.q: 嗜中性球細胞質邊緣這些淡藍灰色斑塊叫什麼？由什麼構成？
quiz.a: Döhle bodies；殘留的 rough endoplasmic reticulum（ribosomal RNA）

144.recognize_zh: 血片中可見多個兩端尖細的鐮刀狀紅血球（sickle cells），HPLC 在 D-window（43.6%）與 S-window（33.8%）出現兩個緊鄰交錯的高峰且幾乎無 HbA0，配合母親為 HbS trait、父親為 HbD-Punjab trait，即為 HbSD 雙異合子鐮刀症。
features: Peripheral smear with scattered sickled (drepanocytic) red cells with pointed ends, plus boat-shaped and irregularly contracted forms
Mild anisopoikilocytosis with occasional target cells and small dense cells; red cells otherwise normochromic
HPLC: two adjacent overlapping variant peaks in the D-window (43.6%, RT 4.09 min) and S-window (33.8%, RT 4.36 min), HbF 12.6%, HbA2 3.5%, negligible HbA0
Alkaline cellulose acetate electrophoresis: patient lane (arrow) with a dominant slow band in the S/D/G position and no HbA band
Sodium metabisulphite sickling test: numerous sickled and holly-leaf deoxygenated red cells
Parental HPLC: mother with S-window peak 26.1% (HbAS); father with D-window peak 30.8% (HbAD-Punjab)
144.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with moderate poikilocytosis, including scattered sickle cells and occasional target cells; no nucleated red cells are seen in this field. Cation-exchange HPLC demonstrates two closely eluting variant peaks in the D-window (43.6%) and S-window (33.8%) with HbF 12.6%, HbA2 3.5% and essentially no HbA0, and alkaline electrophoresis shows a single dominant band in the S/D/G region because HbS and HbD-Punjab co-migrate at pH 8.6. The metabisulphite sickling test is positive, and parental studies show HbS trait in the mother and HbD-Punjab trait in the father. Findings are consistent with compound heterozygous HbSD-Punjab disease.

ddx.vs: HbSS shows a single dominant S-window peak without a separate D-window peak, and both parents carry HbS; alkaline electrophoresis alone cannot separate them because HbD co-migrates with HbS.
HbS/beta-thal shows microcytic hypochromic indices, an elevated HbA2 (>3.5%) and a single S-window peak, whereas this case is normocytic with a distinct D-window peak.
These lack a positive sickling test and sickle cells on smear, and HPLC shows only a D-window peak without an S-window component.
HbSC shows a C-window peak eluting later than HbS on HPLC, a distinct band in the C/E/O/A2 position on alkaline electrophoresis, and HbC crystals or target cells on smear.

captions: Peripheral blood smear with sickle cells
Patient HPLC: twin D-window (43.6%) and S-window (33.8%) peaks, HbF 12.6%
Alkaline cellulose acetate electrophoresis: patient lane (arrow) with slow S/D/G band and no HbA
Positive sodium metabisulphite sickling test
Mother HPLC: S-window 26.1% (sickle cell trait)
Father HPLC: D-window 30.8% (HbD-Punjab trait)

exam.answer_en: Compound heterozygous HbSD-Punjab disease — sickle cells on smear, adjacent D- and S-window peaks with no HbA on HPLC
pearls_zh: 考法：血片指鐮刀狀紅血球，再給 HPLC 問兩個相鄰高峰是什麼；答案是 HbS + HbD-Punjab，並由父母各帶一個 trait 證實。
鹼性電泳 HbD 與 HbS 同位置（S/D/G），單看會誤當 HbSS；需以 HPLC 或酸性（citrate agar）電泳區分，酸性下 HbD 與 HbA 同位。
HbD-Punjab 會與 HbS 聚合，所以 HbSD 臨床屬鐮刀型疾病，可有血管阻塞疼痛與溶血；HbAD 帶因者則無症狀。
Metabisulphite 鐮變試驗或 solubility test 只證明有 HbS，不能分辨 trait、SS、SD 或 S/β-thal。
exam.pitfall_zh: 鹼性電泳只見 S 位單帶易誤診為 HbSS；HPLC 可見 D-window 與 S-window 兩峰，加上父母分別為 HbS 與 HbD trait 可區分。

quiz.q: 為何鹼性電泳無法區分 HbSS 與 HbSD？應改用哪些方法？
quiz.a: HbD 與 HbS 在鹼性電泳同位置；改用 HPLC 或酸性（citrate agar）電泳並做家族研究

80.recognize_zh: 淋巴結竇內擴張，充滿大型組織球，細胞質豐富淡染、核圓且泡狀、核仁明顯，細胞質內可見多個完整的淋巴球與漿細胞被包住（伸入運動 emperipolesis）；S100 染色使大型組織球呈陽性並勾勒出其內被吞入的淋巴球，典型的 Rosai-Dorfman 病。
features: Low power: lymph node with dilated sinuses filled by pale-staining histiocytes, contrasting with dark lymphocyte-rich medullary cords
Very large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic to foamy cytoplasm and indistinct cell borders
Round to oval vesicular nuclei with a single distinct nucleolus and minimal atypia
Emperipolesis: multiple intact lymphocytes and plasma cells, some surrounded by a clear halo, within histiocyte cytoplasm
Background of numerous plasma cells, lymphocytes and occasional neutrophils
S100 IHC: strong nuclear and cytoplasmic staining of the large histiocytes, outlining engulfed unstained lymphocytes
80.describe_en: Sections of the cervical lymph node show marked sinus expansion by sheets of pale-staining histiocytes separating lymphoplasmacytic cords. At high power, the histiocytes are very large with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with distinct nucleoli, without significant atypia or mitotic activity. Many histiocytes contain intact lymphocytes and plasma cells within their cytoplasm (emperipolesis), and the background contains numerous plasma cells. S100 immunostain is strongly positive in the large histiocytes and highlights the engulfed, unstained lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease, nodal type.

ddx.vs: Reactive sinus histiocytes are smaller, lack conspicuous emperipolesis and are S100-negative, whereas Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are large, show emperipolesis and are S100-positive.

LCH cells are smaller with grooved, coffee-bean nuclei, accompanied by eosinophils, and express CD1a and langerin, whereas Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes have round nuclei, emperipolesis and are CD1a-negative.

HLH histiocytes phagocytose erythrocytes and degenerated cells and are S100-negative, whereas emperipolesis in RDD involves intact viable lymphocytes and plasma cells within S100-positive histiocytes.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells have huge eosinophilic macronucleoli and are CD30/CD15-positive in a mixed background, whereas RDD histiocytes have small nucleoli, emperipolesis and S100 positivity.

captions: H&E low power: lymph node with dilated sinuses filled with pale histiocytes between lymphoid cords
H&E high power: large histiocyte containing a cluster of intact lymphocytes (emperipolesis)
H&E high power: numerous large pale histiocytes with vesicular nuclei, several showing emperipolesis
H&E high power: histiocytes engulfing multiple lymphocytes and plasma cells, with background plasma cells
S100 IHC: large positive histiocyte outlining engulfed unstained lymphocytes

exam.answer_en: Rosai-Dorfman disease, nodal — sinuses distended by large S100+ histiocytes showing emperipolesis of intact lymphocytes and plasma cells
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指組織球胞質中包著完整淋巴球的現象問名稱——emperipolesis；S100 染色可把被吞入、未染色的淋巴球勾勒出來。
免疫表型：S100+、CD68+、CD163+，CD1a−、langerin−，藉此與 LCH 區分。
典型臨床：年輕人無痛性雙側大量頸部淋巴結腫大，伴發燒、多株性高丙種球蛋白血症；多數自限性。
部分病例帶 MAP2K1/KRAS 等 MAPK 路徑突變，WHO 5th 將 RDD 列為組織球腫瘤；背景漿細胞可見 IgG4+ 增加，勿誤判 IgG4 相關病。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為反應性竇組織球增生（S100 陰性、無明顯 emperipolesis）或 LCH（咖啡豆狀核溝、嗜酸性球、CD1a/langerin 陽性）。

quiz.q: 組織球細胞質內可見完整淋巴球的現象稱為什麼？這些組織球 S100 陽性還是陰性？
quiz.a: Emperipolesis；S100 陽性

16.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中血小板明顯增多，常見血小板聚集與大型血小板，紅血球與白血球大致正常；骨髓切片與抹片可見成群、體積巨大、核高度分葉（鹿角狀 staghorn）的成熟巨核細胞，未見明顯纖維化，符合原發性血小板增多症（ET）。
features: Marked thrombocytosis on peripheral smear with platelet clumps, large and giant platelets and variable granulation
Unremarkable red cells without teardrop cells or leukoerythroblastosis; normal-appearing neutrophil
Increased, loosely clustered large-to-giant megakaryocytes with abundant mature eosinophilic cytoplasm
Deeply lobulated, hyperlobulated (staghorn) megakaryocyte nuclei without bulbous hyperchromatic atypia
Aspirate with giant hyperlobulated megakaryocytes and background of maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors
No overt reticulin or collagen fibrosis visible on H&E (not formally assessable without reticulin stain)
16.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked thrombocytosis with frequent platelet clumps and numerous large and giant platelets, a possible megakaryocyte fragment, and red cells without significant poikilocytosis, teardrop forms or nucleated red cells; the neutrophils appear morphologically unremarkable. The bone marrow core biopsy is cellular with trilineage hematopoiesis and increased megakaryocytes that are loosely clustered and predominantly large to giant, with abundant mature cytoplasm and deeply lobulated staghorn-like nuclei; small hypolobated or bizarre cloud-like megakaryocytes are not prominent. The aspirate smear confirms giant megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated nuclei. Overt fibrosis is not appreciated on these sections, although a reticulin stain is required for grading. Findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical and molecular (JAK2/CALR/MPL) context.

ddx.vs: Prefibrotic PMF shows a hypercellular marrow with granulocytic proliferation and dense clusters of atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic, bulbous, cloud-like nuclei and abnormal N:C ratio, rather than the mature staghorn megakaryocytes seen here.

PV shows panmyelosis with erythroid predominance and pleomorphic megakaryocytes of varying size, with elevated hemoglobin/red cell mass, whereas ET abnormalities are largely restricted to large mature megakaryocytes.
CML megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated (dwarf forms) with marked granulocytic hyperplasia and basophilia, and BCR::ABL1 must be excluded in every thrombocytosis workup.
Reactive thrombocytosis (iron deficiency, inflammation, post-splenectomy) shows megakaryocytes that are increased but normal in size and lobation without clustering, and lacks MPN driver mutations.

captions: PB: marked thrombocytosis with a large platelet clump
PB: numerous large platelets with variable granulation
PB: thrombocytosis with a large granular cell, possibly a megakaryocyte fragment, and platelet aggregates
PB: platelet clumps and large platelets next to a normal segmented neutrophil
BM biopsy H&E: increased loosely clustered large megakaryocytes
BM biopsy H&E: numerous giant megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated nuclei in a cellular marrow
BM biopsy H&E, high power: giant megakaryocyte with deeply lobulated staghorn nucleus
BM aspirate: two giant megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated nuclei
BM aspirate, high power: giant megakaryocyte with multilobated nucleus and abundant granular cytoplasm

exam.answer_en: Essential thrombocythemia — marked thrombocytosis with giant platelets; loosely clustered large megakaryocytes with hyperlobulated staghorn nuclei, no fibrosis
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指體積巨大、核深度分葉如鹿角（staghorn）的巨核細胞問診斷，並問與 prefibrotic PMF 的巨核細胞差別。
WHO 5th 主要條件：血小板 ≥450×10⁹/L；骨髓以大型成熟、核過度分葉巨核細胞增生為主；不符 PV、PMF、CML、MDS；帶 JAK2、CALR 或 MPL 突變。
驅動突變頻率：JAK2 最多，其次 CALR，MPL 少數；三陰性者需排除反應性血小板增多。
臨床：血小板極高（>1000×10⁹/L）可致後天性 von Willebrand 症候群而出血，使用 aspirin 前應檢查；高風險者用 hydroxyurea。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤判的是 prefibrotic PMF：後者骨髓細胞量高伴顆粒球增生、巨核細胞緊密成簇且核呈雲朵狀深染、N:C 比異常，預後較差，務必做 reticulin。

quiz.q: ET 骨髓中核高度分葉、體積巨大的巨核細胞常被形容為什麼形狀？
quiz.a: 鹿角狀（staghorn）
